# From 2002 as baseline start-point wave 1
# Wave 1 (2002) Data Extraction — following Wave 2 (2004) standards
```{r}
# 1. Load data files
elsa_core_w1 <- read_dta(file.path(data_dir, "wave_1_core_data_v3.dta"))

has_mention <- function(df, mention_cols, code) {
  mat <- as.matrix(df[, mention_cols])
  present  <- apply(mat, 1, function(row) any(row == code, na.rm = TRUE))
  all_na   <- apply(mat, 1, function(row) all(row < 0 | is.na(row)))
  has_none <- apply(mat, 1, function(row) any(row == 96, na.rm = TRUE))
  result   <- if_else(present, 1L, if_else(all_na, NA_integer_, 0L))
  result   <- if_else(has_none & !present, 0L, result)
  result
}

# 2. Covariates (analogous to elsa_cov_2004)
# Key differences from W2:
#   edqual     (W1) vs w2edqual (W2) — same encoding
#   dimar      (W1) vs DiMar   (W2) — same encoding, different case
#   heska      (W1) vs HESka   (W2) — same encoding, different case
#   heala      (W1) vs scal7a  (W2) — different variable! frequency vs 7-day binary
#   heacta     (W1) vs HeActa  (W2) — same encoding, different case
#   scorg1,scorga2,scorg3-9 (W1) vs scorg01-scorg09 (W2) — different naming

elsa_cov_2002 <- elsa_core_w1 %>%
  transmute(
    idauniq    = idauniq,
    year       = 2002L,
    birth_year = if_else(indobyr > 0, as.numeric(indobyr), NA_real_),
    age_2002   = if_else(indager > 0, as.numeric(indager), NA_real_),

    # --- Gender (same as W2: indsex 1=Male 2=Female) ---
    Gender = case_when(indsex %in% c(1, 2) ~ as.integer(indsex), TRUE ~ NA_integer_),

    # --- Race (1=White, 2=Non-white → binary: 0=White, 1=Non-white) ---
    # W1 fqethnr has ~6,810 NAs (HSE subsample not asked); supplement with
    # aethnicr (same encoding from HSE archive) to recover coverage
    Race = case_when(
      fqethnr == 1 | aethnicr == 1 ~ 0L,
      fqethnr == 2 | aethnicr == 2 ~ 1L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # --- Education (edqual: same encoding as w2edqual) ---
    #   1=Degree+ / 2=Higher ed below degree / 3=A-Level
    #   4=O-Level / 5=CSE / 6=Foreign/other / 7=No qualification
    Education = case_when(
      is.na(edqual) | edqual < 0 ~ NA_integer_,
      edqual == 7 ~ 0L,
      edqual %in% c(4, 5, 6) ~ 1L,
      edqual %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 2L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # --- Marital status (dimar: same encoding as DiMar) ---
    Marital_status = case_when(
      dimar %in% c(2, 3) ~ 1L,
      dimar %in% c(1, 4, 5, 6) ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # --- Employment (wpdes: same encoding as W2) ---
    # 1=Retired, 2=Employed, 3=Self-employed, 4=Unemployed,
    # 5=Perm sick/disabled, 6=Looking after home, 96=Semi-retired (spontaneous).
    # 85/86/95 = "other / not codeable / irrelevant" → treat as NA (uninformative).
    Employment = case_when(
      wpdes %in% c(2, 3)              ~ 1L,
      wpdes %in% c(1, 4, 5, 6, 96)    ~ 0L,
      TRUE                            ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # --- Smoking (heska: same encoding as HESka) ---
    Smoking = case_when(heska == 1 ~ 1L, heska == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),

    # --- Alcohol (heala: frequency in past 12 months) ---
    # W2 uses scal7a (drank in last 7 days: 1=yes, 2=no)
    # W1 heala: 1=twice daily+, 2=daily, 3=once-twice/week → likely drank in last 7 days (1)
    #           4=once-twice/month, 5=special occasions, 6=not at all → (0)
    Alcohol = case_when(
      heala %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 1L,
      heala %in% c(4, 5, 6) ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # --- Physical activity (heacta: same encoding as HeActa) ---
    Physical_activity = case_when(
      heacta %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 1L,
      heacta == 4 ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # --- Social activity (scorg1,scorga2,scorg3-scorg9) ---
    # Note: W1 uses scorga2 (not scorg2), scorg9 = not a member of any
    Social_activity = case_when(
      scorg1==1|scorga2==1|scorg3==1|scorg4==1|scorg5==1|scorg6==1|scorg7==1|scorg8==1 ~ 1L,
      scorg9==1 ~ 0L,
      scorg1==0&scorga2==0&scorg3==0&scorg4==0&scorg5==0&scorg6==0&scorg7==0&scorg8==0 ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, year, birth_year, age_2002, Gender, Race, Education,
         Marital_status, Employment, Smoking, Alcohol,
         Physical_activity, Social_activity)


# 3. Sensory variables (analogous to sensory_var_2004)
# W1: hehear, heeye (lowercase, same encoding as W2)
# W1: heopt1-heopt5 mention format: code 1=glaucoma, 4=cataracts
# (W2 used derived heoptca, heoptgl from derived file)

opt_cols <- paste0("heopt", 1:5)

sensory_var_2002 <- elsa_core_w1 %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, hehear, heeye, hecat, all_of(opt_cols)) %>%
  mutate(
    # hehear: 1=excellent … 5=poor
    hearing_loss       = case_when(hehear %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 0L,
                                   hehear %in% c(4, 5)    ~ 1L,
                                   TRUE                   ~ NA_integer_),
    # heeye: 1=excellent … 5=poor, 6=registered/legally blind
    vision_overall     = case_when(heeye %in% c(1, 2, 3)    ~ 0L,
                                   heeye %in% c(4, 5, 6)    ~ 1L,
                                   TRUE                     ~ NA_integer_),
    cataract_diagnosis  = has_mention(pick(all_of(opt_cols)), opt_cols, 4),
    glaucoma_diagnosis  = has_mention(pick(all_of(opt_cols)), opt_cols, 1),
    cataract_surgery    = case_when(hecat == 1 ~ 1L,
                                    hecat == 2 ~ 0L,
                                    TRUE ~ NA_integer_)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, hearing_loss, vision_overall,
         cataract_diagnosis, glaucoma_diagnosis, cataract_surgery)


# 4. Dementia classification (same approach as W2)
# W1: hedib01-hedib10 mention format, code 8=Alzheimer's, code 9=Dementia
# W1: heiqb-heiqq IQCODE (lowercase, same encoding as W2)
# (W2 used derived hedibad, hedibde from derived file)

hedib_cols <- paste0("hedib", sprintf("%02d", 1:10))

elsa_cog_2002 <- elsa_core_w1 %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, all_of(hedib_cols), heiqb:heiqq) %>%
  mutate(
    # Extract Alzheimer's (code 8) and Dementia (code 9) from hedib mention
    alzheimer_dx = has_mention(pick(all_of(hedib_cols)), hedib_cols, 8),
    dementia_dx  = has_mention(pick(all_of(hedib_cols)), hedib_cols, 9),
    # Combined diagnosed dementia
    diagnosed_dementia = case_when(
      alzheimer_dx == 1 | dementia_dx == 1 ~ 1L,
      alzheimer_dx == 0 & dementia_dx == 0 ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    )
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    idauniq = idauniq,
    year = 2002L,
    diagnosed_dementia,
    iqcode_b = if_else(heiqb %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqb), NA_real_),
    iqcode_c = if_else(heiqc %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqc), NA_real_),
    iqcode_d = if_else(heiqd %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqd), NA_real_),
    iqcode_e = if_else(heiqe %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqe), NA_real_),
    iqcode_f = if_else(heiqf %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqf), NA_real_),
    iqcode_g = if_else(heiqg %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqg), NA_real_),
    iqcode_h = if_else(heiqh %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqh), NA_real_),
    iqcode_i = if_else(heiqi %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqi), NA_real_),
    iqcode_j = if_else(heiqj %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqj), NA_real_),
    iqcode_k = if_else(heiqk %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqk), NA_real_),
    iqcode_l = if_else(heiql %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiql), NA_real_),
    iqcode_m = if_else(heiqm %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqm), NA_real_),
    iqcode_n = if_else(heiqn %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqn), NA_real_),
    iqcode_o = if_else(heiqo %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqo), NA_real_),
    iqcode_p = if_else(heiqp %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqp), NA_real_),
    iqcode_q = if_else(heiqq %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqq), NA_real_)
  )

# Compute IQCODE mean using vectorized rowMeans (faster than rowwise)
iqcode_cols <- paste0("iqcode_", letters[2:17])
iqcode_mat  <- as.matrix(elsa_cog_2002[, iqcode_cols])

elsa_cog_2002 <- elsa_cog_2002 %>%
  mutate(
    iqcode_n_valid = rowSums(!is.na(iqcode_mat)),
    iqcode_mean    = if_else(iqcode_n_valid >= 1L, rowMeans(iqcode_mat, na.rm = TRUE), NA_real_),
    iqcode_dementia = case_when(
      is.na(iqcode_mean)  ~ NA_integer_,
      iqcode_mean >= 3.4  ~ 1L,
      iqcode_mean < 3.4   ~ 0L
    ),
    dementia = case_when(
      diagnosed_dementia == 1 | iqcode_dementia == 1 ~ 1L,
      diagnosed_dementia == 0 | iqcode_dementia == 0 ~ 0L,
      TRUE                                          ~ NA_integer_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, year, diagnosed_dementia, iqcode_mean, iqcode_n_valid,
       iqcode_dementia, dementia)

# Wave 1 (2002) Dementia Classification — observed counts
# Total participants in Wave 1: 12,099
# Total dementia cases:         114  (0.94% prevalence among non-missing)
#   Physician diagnosis only : 57   (of which 50 had no IQCODE data)
#   IQCODE ≥ 3.4 only        : 39
#   Both sources             : 18
# Missing dementia status:     10   (both sources unknown)
#
# Physician diagnosis (hedib mention codes 8 + 9):
#   Yes: 75   No: 12,014   Missing: 10
# IQCODE (16-item heiqb–heiqq):
#   174 respondents with ≥1 valid item (163 with all 16)
#   11,925 with no IQCODE data (no informant / proxy interview)
#   Mean 3.42  |  Median 3.13  |  IQR 3.00–3.79
#   ≥ 3.4 classification: Yes 57  No 117  NA 11,925

```




```{r}
# --- 1) Overall sample size ---
cat("=== Wave 1 (2002) Dementia Classification ===\n\n")
cat("Total participants in Wave 1:", nrow(elsa_cog_2002), "\n\n")

# --- 2) Physician diagnosis of dementia ---
cat("--- Physician Diagnosis (diagnosed_dementia) ---\n")
cat("  Yes (1):", sum(elsa_cog_2002$diagnosed_dementia == 1, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("  No  (0):", sum(elsa_cog_2002$diagnosed_dementia == 0, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("  NA     :", sum(is.na(elsa_cog_2002$diagnosed_dementia)), "\n\n")

# --- 3) IQCODE availability and distribution ---
cat("--- IQCODE (16-item) ---\n")
cat("  Respondents with >= 1 valid IQCODE item:",
    sum(elsa_cog_2002$iqcode_n_valid >= 1, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("  Respondents with all 16 valid items    :",
    sum(elsa_cog_2002$iqcode_n_valid == 16, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("  Respondents with 0 valid items (no IQCODE):",
    sum(elsa_cog_2002$iqcode_n_valid == 0, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("  IQCODE mean — summary statistics:\n")
print(summary(elsa_cog_2002$iqcode_mean))
cat("\n")

# --- 4) IQCODE >= 3.4 ---
cat("--- IQCODE Dementia (mean >= 3.4) ---\n")
cat("  Yes (1):", sum(elsa_cog_2002$iqcode_dementia == 1, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("  No  (0):", sum(elsa_cog_2002$iqcode_dementia == 0, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("  NA     :", sum(is.na(elsa_cog_2002$iqcode_dementia)), "\n\n")

# --- 5) Cross-tabulation: physician diagnosis x IQCODE ---
cat("--- Cross-tabulation: Physician Diagnosis x IQCODE >= 3.4 ---\n")
cross_tab <- table(
  Physician_Dx = factor(elsa_cog_2002$diagnosed_dementia,
                        levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No", "Yes")),
  IQCODE_3.4   = factor(elsa_cog_2002$iqcode_dementia,
                        levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No", "Yes")),
  useNA = "ifany"
)
print(cross_tab)
cat("\n")

# --- 6) Dementia source breakdown ---
elsa_cog_2002 <- elsa_cog_2002 %>%
  mutate(
    dementia_source = case_when(
      diagnosed_dementia == 1 & iqcode_dementia == 1 ~ "Both",
      diagnosed_dementia == 1 & (iqcode_dementia == 0 | is.na(iqcode_dementia)) ~ "Physician Dx only",
      (diagnosed_dementia == 0 | is.na(diagnosed_dementia)) & iqcode_dementia == 1 ~ "IQCODE only",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

cat("--- Dementia Source Breakdown (among dementia cases) ---\n")
source_tab <- elsa_cog_2002 %>%
  filter(dementia == 1) %>%
  count(dementia_source) %>%
  mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1))
print(source_tab)
cat("\n")

# --- 7) Final combined dementia count ---
cat("--- Final Combined Dementia (either source) ---\n")
cat("  Dementia Yes (1):", sum(elsa_cog_2002$dementia == 1, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("  Dementia No  (0):", sum(elsa_cog_2002$dementia == 0, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("  Dementia NA     :", sum(is.na(elsa_cog_2002$dementia)), "\n")
cat("  Prevalence (among non-NA):",
    round(100 * mean(elsa_cog_2002$dementia == 1, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "%\n\n")

# --- 8) Summary table ---
summary_dementia_w1 <- tibble(
  Source = c("Physician diagnosis only",
             "IQCODE >= 3.4 only",
             "Both sources",
             "Total dementia cases",
             "Total non-dementia",
             "Total missing"),
  N = c(
    sum(elsa_cog_2002$dementia_source == "Physician Dx only", na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(elsa_cog_2002$dementia_source == "IQCODE only", na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(elsa_cog_2002$dementia_source == "Both", na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(elsa_cog_2002$dementia == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(elsa_cog_2002$dementia == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(is.na(elsa_cog_2002$dementia))
  )
)

print(summary_dementia_w1)
```

```{r}
# 5. Frailty Index (49-item Searle/ELSA construction)
#   - heeye / hehear  : sensory items — placed in sensory_var_2002
#   - hedim code 5    : "heart murmur" — not a standard FI deficit
#   - hedib code 6    : Parkinson's disease — not in ELSA FI
#   - hedib codes 8,9 : Alzheimer's / Dementia — outcome, handled separately
# =========================================================================

# --- 5a. Mobility difficulties (Items 1–10) -----------------------------
# heada01–heada10 hold up to 10 "mention" codes (1–10), one per difficulty.
mob_cols <- paste0("heada", sprintf("%02d", 1:11))

elsa_fi <- elsa_core_w1 %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, all_of(mob_cols)) %>%
  mutate(
    hemobwa = has_mention(pick(all_of(mob_cols)), mob_cols,  1),  # walk 100 yards
    hemobsi = has_mention(pick(all_of(mob_cols)), mob_cols,  2),  # sit 2 hours
    hemobch = has_mention(pick(all_of(mob_cols)), mob_cols,  3),  # rise from chair
    hemobcs = has_mention(pick(all_of(mob_cols)), mob_cols,  4),  # climb several flights
    hemobcl = has_mention(pick(all_of(mob_cols)), mob_cols,  5),  # climb one flight
    hemobst = has_mention(pick(all_of(mob_cols)), mob_cols,  6),  # stoop/kneel/crouch
    hemobre = has_mention(pick(all_of(mob_cols)), mob_cols,  7),  # reach above shoulder
    hemobpu = has_mention(pick(all_of(mob_cols)), mob_cols,  8),  # push/pull heavy objects
    hemobli = has_mention(pick(all_of(mob_cols)), mob_cols,  9),  # lift/carry 10 lbs
    hemobpi = has_mention(pick(all_of(mob_cols)), mob_cols, 10)   # pick up 5p coin
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, starts_with("hemob"))

# --- 5b. ADL & IADL difficulties (Items 11–23) --------------------------
# headb01–headb13 hold up to 13 mention codes.
adl_cols <- paste0("headb", sprintf("%02d", 1:14))

adl_iadl <- elsa_core_w1 %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, all_of(adl_cols)) %>%
  mutate(
    headldr = has_mention(pick(all_of(adl_cols)), adl_cols,  1),  # dressing
    headlwa = has_mention(pick(all_of(adl_cols)), adl_cols,  2),  # walk across room
    headlba = has_mention(pick(all_of(adl_cols)), adl_cols,  3),  # bathing/showering
    headlea = has_mention(pick(all_of(adl_cols)), adl_cols,  4),  # eating/cut food
    headlbe = has_mention(pick(all_of(adl_cols)), adl_cols,  5),  # in/out of bed
    headlwc = has_mention(pick(all_of(adl_cols)), adl_cols,  6),  # using toilet
    headlma = has_mention(pick(all_of(adl_cols)), adl_cols,  7),  # using a map
    headlpr = has_mention(pick(all_of(adl_cols)), adl_cols,  8),  # prepare hot meal
    headlsh = has_mention(pick(all_of(adl_cols)), adl_cols,  9),  # shopping groceries
    headlph = has_mention(pick(all_of(adl_cols)), adl_cols, 10),  # phone calls
    headlme = has_mention(pick(all_of(adl_cols)), adl_cols, 11),  # taking medications
    headlhg = has_mention(pick(all_of(adl_cols)), adl_cols, 12),  # work around house/garden
    headlmo = has_mention(pick(all_of(adl_cols)), adl_cols, 13)   # managing money
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, starts_with("headl"))

# --- 5c. Diagnosed conditions (Items 24–36) -----------------------------
# hedim01–hedim07 (cardiovascular/metabolic) — 7 items used from codes 1–8:
#   code 5 (heart murmur) intentionally skipped.
# hedib01–hedib10 (other chronic) — 6 items used from codes 1–9:
#   code 6 (Parkinson's) intentionally skipped;
#   codes 8 (Alzheimer's) and 9 (dementia) handled in dementia classifier.
hedim_cols <- paste0("hedim", sprintf("%02d", 1:7))

diagnoses <- elsa_core_w1 %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, all_of(hedim_cols), all_of(hedib_cols)) %>%
  mutate(
    hedimbp  = has_mention(pick(all_of(hedim_cols)), hedim_cols, 1),  # hypertension
    hediman  = has_mention(pick(all_of(hedim_cols)), hedim_cols, 2),  # angina
    hedimmi  = has_mention(pick(all_of(hedim_cols)), hedim_cols, 3),  # heart attack / MI
    hedimhf  = has_mention(pick(all_of(hedim_cols)), hedim_cols, 4),  # congestive heart failure
    hedimar  = has_mention(pick(all_of(hedim_cols)), hedim_cols, 6),  # arrhythmia
    hedimdi  = has_mention(pick(all_of(hedim_cols)), hedim_cols, 7),  # diabetes
    hedimst  = has_mention(pick(all_of(hedim_cols)), hedim_cols, 8),  # stroke
    hediblu  = has_mention(pick(all_of(hedib_cols)), hedib_cols, 1),  # chronic lung disease
    hedibas  = has_mention(pick(all_of(hedib_cols)), hedib_cols, 2),  # asthma
    hedibar  = has_mention(pick(all_of(hedib_cols)), hedib_cols, 3),  # arthritis
    hedibos  = has_mention(pick(all_of(hedib_cols)), hedib_cols, 4),  # osteoporosis
    hedibca  = has_mention(pick(all_of(hedib_cols)), hedib_cols, 5),  # cancer / malignant tumour
    hedibps  = has_mention(pick(all_of(hedib_cols)), hedib_cols, 7)   # emotional/nervous/psychiatric
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq,
         hedimbp, hediman, hedimmi, hedimhf, hedimar, hedimdi, hedimst,
         hediblu, hedibas, hedibar, hedibos, hedibca, hedibps)

# --- 5d. CES-D depression items (Items 37–44) ---------------------------
# psceda–pscedh: 1=Yes, 2=No (lowercase names; same semantics as W2 PScedA–PScedH)
# Standard negatively-worded items score Yes (1) as a deficit.
# pscedd ("were you happy?") and pscedf ("have you enjoyed life?") are
# POSITIVELY worded → No (2) is the deficit.
cesd <- elsa_core_w1 %>%
  transmute(
    idauniq,
    psceda = case_when(psceda == 1 ~ 1L, psceda == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_), # depressed
    pscedb = case_when(pscedb == 1 ~ 1L, pscedb == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_), # everything an effort
    pscedc = case_when(pscedc == 1 ~ 1L, pscedc == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_), # sleep restless
    pscede = case_when(pscede == 1 ~ 1L, pscede == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_), # felt lonely
    pscedg = case_when(pscedg == 1 ~ 1L, pscedg == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_), # felt sad
    pscedh = case_when(pscedh == 1 ~ 1L, pscedh == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_), # could not get going
    # reverse-coded
    pscedd = case_when(pscedd == 2 ~ 1L, pscedd == 1 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_), # NOT happy
    pscedf = case_when(pscedf == 2 ~ 1L, pscedf == 1 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_)  # did NOT enjoy life
  )

# --- 5e. Other health (Items 45, 48–51) ---------------------------------
# Items 46 & 47 (heeye, hehear) are sensory and sit in sensory_var_2002.
other_health <- elsa_core_w1 %>%
  transmute(
    idauniq,
    # hehelf: self-rated general health (1=excellent … 5=poor) → fair/poor = deficit
    hehelf = case_when(hehelf %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 0L,
                       hehelf %in% c(4, 5)    ~ 1L,
                       TRUE                   ~ NA_integer_),
    hefla  = case_when(hefla  == 1 ~ 1L, hefla  == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_), # fall in last 2y
    hefrac = case_when(hefrac == 1 ~ 1L, hefrac == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_), # ever hip fracture
    heji   = case_when(heji   == 1 ~ 1L, heji   == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_), # ever joint replacement
    mmpain = case_when(mmpain == 1 ~ 1L, mmpain == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_)  # pain while walking
  )

# --- 5f. Merge all components and compute Frailty Index (vectorised) ----
fi_items <- c(
  # Mobility (10)
  "hemobwa", "hemobsi", "hemobch", "hemobcs", "hemobcl",
  "hemobst", "hemobre", "hemobpu", "hemobli", "hemobpi",
  # ADL / IADL (13)
  "headldr", "headlwa", "headlba", "headlea", "headlbe", "headlwc",
  "headlma", "headlpr", "headlsh", "headlph", "headlme", "headlhg", "headlmo",
  # Diagnosed conditions (13)
  "hedimbp", "hediman", "hedimmi", "hedimhf", "hedimar", "hedimdi", "hedimst",
  "hediblu", "hedibas", "hedibar", "hedibos", "hedibca", "hedibps",
  # CES-D depression (8)
  "psceda", "pscedb", "pscedc", "pscedd", "pscede", "pscedf", "pscedg", "pscedh",
  # Other health (5)
  "hehelf", "hefla", "hefrac", "heji", "mmpain"
)
n_fi_items <- length(fi_items)
stopifnot(n_fi_items == 49)

# Strict (I)ADL items removed in the sensitivity FI
iadl_items <- c(
  # ADL (6)
  "headldr", "headlwa", "headlba", "headlea", "headlbe", "headlwc",
  # IADL (7) — phone, money, meals, shopping, meds, house/garden, map use
  "headlma", "headlpr", "headlsh", "headlph", "headlme", "headlhg", "headlmo"
)
fi_items_noIADL   <- setdiff(fi_items, iadl_items)
n_fi_items_noIADL <- length(fi_items_noIADL)
stopifnot(n_fi_items_noIADL == 36)

fi_merged <- elsa_fi %>%
  left_join(adl_iadl,     by = "idauniq") %>%
  left_join(diagnoses,    by = "idauniq") %>%
  left_join(cesd,         by = "idauniq") %>%
  left_join(other_health, by = "idauniq")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# (a) ORIGINAL frailty index — 49 items
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
fi_mat <- as.matrix(fi_merged[, fi_items])

elsa_fi_2002_orig <- fi_merged %>%
  mutate(
    year         = 2002L,
    fi_n_valid   = rowSums(!is.na(fi_mat)),
    fi_n_deficit = rowSums(fi_mat == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    # Require >= 80% of items valid (>= 40 of 49).
    fi_score = if_else(
      fi_n_valid >= ceiling(n_fi_items * 0.8),
      fi_n_deficit / fi_n_valid,
      NA_real_
    ),
    # Binary frailty: >= 0.25 frail (Rockwood cut-off).
    frailty = case_when(
      is.na(fi_score)  ~ NA_integer_,
      fi_score >= 0.25 ~ 1L,
      fi_score <  0.25 ~ 0L
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(fi_score)) %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, year, fi_n_valid, fi_n_deficit, fi_score, frailty)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# (b) MODIFIED frailty index — (I)ADL items removed (sensitivity)
#     Addresses possible mediation by (I)ADL deficits on the
#     sensory-impairment → dementia pathway. Same ≥0.25 threshold,
#     same ≥80% completeness rule applied to the reduced 36-item set
#     (>= 29 of 36).
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
fi_mat_noIADL <- as.matrix(fi_merged[, fi_items_noIADL])

elsa_fi_2002_noIADL <- fi_merged %>%
  mutate(
    fi_n_valid_noIADL   = rowSums(!is.na(fi_mat_noIADL)),
    fi_n_deficit_noIADL = rowSums(fi_mat_noIADL == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    fi_score_noIADL = if_else(
      fi_n_valid_noIADL >= ceiling(n_fi_items_noIADL * 0.8),
      fi_n_deficit_noIADL / fi_n_valid_noIADL,
      NA_real_
    ),
    frailty_noIADL = case_when(
      is.na(fi_score_noIADL)  ~ NA_integer_,
      fi_score_noIADL >= 0.25 ~ 1L,
      fi_score_noIADL <  0.25 ~ 0L
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(fi_score_noIADL)) %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, fi_n_valid_noIADL, fi_n_deficit_noIADL,
                fi_score_noIADL, frailty_noIADL)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Combine both FI versions into a single per-person table.
# Original `elsa_fi_2002` interface is preserved (idauniq, year,
# fi_n_valid, fi_n_deficit, fi_score, frailty); sensitivity columns
# (fi_score_noIADL, frailty_noIADL) are added alongside.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
elsa_fi_2002 <- elsa_fi_2002_orig %>%
  full_join(elsa_fi_2002_noIADL, by = "idauniq")

```




```{r}
# =========================================================================
# 6. Merge 2002 data (extract only — no filtering)
# =========================================================================
# FIX: elsa_fi_2002 carries `year` only on rows that survived the 49-item
# filter; the noIADL-only rows have year = NA and were therefore silently
# dropped by a join on c("idauniq","year"). Join on idauniq alone and strip
# the redundant `year` column from the FI table.
elsa_2002 <- elsa_cov_2002 %>%
  left_join(sensory_var_2002, by = "idauniq") %>%
  left_join(elsa_cog_2002,    by = c("idauniq", "year")) %>%
  left_join(elsa_fi_2002 %>% dplyr::select(-any_of("year")), by = "idauniq")

# One row per person is assumed by every join below.
stopifnot(anyDuplicated(elsa_2002$idauniq) == 0)


# =========================================================================
# 7. Multiple imputation (MICE) — ELSA wave 1 (2002)
# =========================================================================
# Design — identical in HRS_dataextract.Rmd and at every ELSA wave:
#   * m = 20, maxit = 10, fully conditional specification; pmm for
#     continuous, polr for ordered categorical, logreg for binary.
#   * Imputed AND carried into the analysis data (the analysis covariates):
#       age, Education, Marital_status, Employment, Smoking, Alcohol,
#       Physical_activity, Social_activity.
#   * Gender and Race are imputed INSIDE the FCS so that no predictor
#     carries NAs into the design matrix, but are NOT carried back: the
#     analysis data retains their original values, including missing ones.
#     (This is the fix for predictors that previously had method "" while
#     still sitting in the predictor matrix — mice never fills those cells,
#     so NAs were being fed into every imputation model.)
#   * The primary study variables (frailty index, sensory impairment,
#     dementia) are neither imputed nor used as predictors, matching HRS and
#     the Methods statement that they were not imputed.
#   * birth_year is not a predictor (near-collinear with age). Age is
#     resolved deterministically from birth_year where it is missing,
#     mirroring the HRS coalesce(R*AGEY_E, year - birth_year) step.
#   * A single completed dataset (imputation 1) is carried forward, as in
#     HRS; the mids object is retained so pooled inference stays available.

analysis_covars02 <- c("age_2002", "Education", "Marital_status", "Employment",
                       "Smoking", "Alcohol", "Physical_activity", "Social_activity")

# ---- 7a. Imputation frame ----------------------------------------------
imp02_elsa <- elsa_2002 %>%
  transmute(
    idauniq    = as.character(idauniq),
    age_2002   = coalesce(as.numeric(age_2002), 2002 - as.numeric(birth_year)),
    Gender     = factor(Gender, levels = c(1, 2)),
    Race       = factor(Race,   levels = c(0, 1)),
    Education  = ordered(Education, levels = c(0, 1, 2)),
    across(c(Marital_status, Employment, Smoking, Alcohol,
             Physical_activity, Social_activity),
           ~ factor(.x, levels = c(0, 1)))
  )

# ELSA fielded a qualification item only at W1-W5; from W6 Education is an
# all-NA placeholder back-filled from the earlier waves at the pooled stage.
# mice cannot impute a wholly missing column, so any such variable is
# dropped here and left untouched in the analysis data.
all_missing02 <- names(imp02_elsa)[colSums(!is.na(imp02_elsa)) == 0]
if (length(all_missing02) > 0) {
  message("ELSA 2002 — no observed values, excluded from imputation: ",
          paste(all_missing02, collapse = ", "))
  imp02_elsa <- imp02_elsa %>% dplyr::select(-all_of(all_missing02))
}
imputed_vars02 <- setdiff(analysis_covars02, all_missing02)

# ---- 7b. Quantify missingness (for the Methods text) -------------------
miss_pct02 <- sapply(imp02_elsa, function(x) mean(is.na(x)) * 100)
cat("ELSA 2002 — percentage missing per variable:\n")
print(round(miss_pct02, 2))

miss_cov02 <- miss_pct02[analysis_covars02]
miss_cov02 <- miss_cov02[miss_cov02 > 0]
if (length(miss_cov02) > 0) {
  cat(sprintf("\nMean missing across analysis covariates: %.2f%%\n",
              mean(miss_cov02)))
  cat(sprintf("Maximum missing: %.2f%% (%s)\n",
              max(miss_cov02), names(which.max(miss_cov02))))
} else {
  cat("\nNo missing values among analysis covariates.\n")
}

# ---- 7c. Imputation method per variable --------------------------------
meth02 <- make.method(imp02_elsa)
meth02["idauniq"]  <- ""             # ID: never imputed, never a predictor
meth02["age_2002"] <- "pmm"
meth02[intersect("Education", names(imp02_elsa))] <- "polr"   # ordered
meth02[intersect(c("Gender", "Race", "Marital_status", "Employment", "Smoking",
                   "Alcohol", "Physical_activity", "Social_activity"),
                 names(imp02_elsa))] <- "logreg"
# Variables with no missing values are not imputed (mice requirement).
meth02[colSums(is.na(imp02_elsa)) == 0] <- ""

# ---- 7d. Predictor matrix ---------------------------------------------
pred02 <- make.predictorMatrix(imp02_elsa)
pred02[, "idauniq"] <- 0
pred02["idauniq", ] <- 0

# GUARD: every incomplete variable that is used as a predictor must itself
# be imputed, otherwise NAs leak into the design matrix.
incomplete02 <- names(imp02_elsa)[colSums(is.na(imp02_elsa)) > 0]
stopifnot(all(meth02[incomplete02] != ""))

# ---- 7e. Run MICE: 20 imputed datasets, 10 iterations ------------------
set.seed(3)
imp_mice02_elsa <- mice(
  imp02_elsa,
  m               = 20,
  maxit           = 10,
  method          = meth02,
  predictorMatrix = pred02,
  printFlag       = TRUE
)

# Any logged event means mice silently altered the specification — inspect.
if (!is.null(imp_mice02_elsa$loggedEvents)) {
  cat("\nMICE logged events (ELSA 2002):\n")
  print(imp_mice02_elsa$loggedEvents)
}

# ---- 7f. Convergence diagnostics --------------------------------------
plot(imp_mice02_elsa)          # trace plots across the 10 iterations

has_imps02 <- function(mids_obj, v) {
  !is.null(mids_obj$imp[[v]]) && nrow(mids_obj$imp[[v]]) >= 2
}

for (v in c("age_2002")) {
  if (has_imps02(imp_mice02_elsa, v)) {
    print(densityplot(imp_mice02_elsa, as.formula(paste("~", v))))
    print(stripplot(imp_mice02_elsa, as.formula(paste(v, "~ .imp")),
                    pch = 20, cex = 1.2))
  } else {
    message(sprintf("%s: %d missing value(s) — density/strip plots skipped.",
                    v, sum(is.na(imp_mice02_elsa$data[[v]]))))
  }
}

# ---- 7g. Observed vs imputed CELLS only -------------------------------
# FIX: the previous version compared observed values against the *completed*
# dataset, which is dominated by observed values and so barely moves. This
# compares the observed distribution against the imputed cells themselves.
imp_vs_obs02 <- function(mids_obj, v) {
  obs   <- mids_obj$data[[v]]
  cells <- mids_obj$imp[[v]]
  if (is.null(cells) || nrow(cells) == 0) {
    return(data.frame(variable = v, n_missing = 0L,
                      observed = NA_character_, imputed = NA_character_))
  }
  if (is.numeric(obs)) {
    data.frame(variable         = v,
               n_missing        = nrow(cells),
               observed         = sprintf("mean=%.3f", mean(obs, na.rm = TRUE)),
               imputed          = sprintf("mean range %.3f-%.3f",
                                          min(colMeans(cells)),
                                          max(colMeans(cells))))
  } else {
    ot <- round(prop.table(table(as.character(obs))), 3)
    it <- round(prop.table(table(unlist(lapply(cells, as.character)))), 3)
    data.frame(variable  = v,
               n_missing = nrow(cells),
               observed  = paste(names(ot), ot, sep = "=", collapse = " | "),
               imputed   = paste(names(it), it, sep = "=", collapse = " | "))
  }
}

diag02 <- do.call(rbind, lapply(imputed_vars02, imp_vs_obs02,
                                mids_obj = imp_mice02_elsa))
print(diag02)

# ---- 7h. Merge the completed covariates back ---------------------------
# Single completion (imputation 1), as in HRS_dataextract.Rmd. Only the
# analysis covariates are replaced; Gender, Race and every primary study
# variable keep their ORIGINAL values, including NAs, so the primary study
# variables remain un-imputed exactly as stated in the Methods.
imp02_elsa_complete1 <- complete(imp_mice02_elsa, 1)

elsa02_clean <- elsa_2002 %>%
  mutate(idauniq = as.character(idauniq)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-all_of(imputed_vars02)) %>%
  left_join(
    imp02_elsa_complete1 %>%
      mutate(idauniq = as.character(idauniq)) %>%
      dplyr::select(idauniq, all_of(imputed_vars02)),
    by = "idauniq"
  )

ELSA_2002 <- elsa02_clean

stopifnot(nrow(ELSA_2002) == nrow(elsa_2002))
```

# From 2004 as baseline start-point wave 2
```{r}
# 1. Load data ---------------------------------------------------------------
elsa_core    <- read_dta(file.path(data_dir, "wave_2_core_data_v4.dta"))
elsa_derived <- read_dta(file.path(data_dir, "wave_2_derived_variables.dta"))

# 2. Covariates -------------------------------------------------------------
# Naming differences from W1: mixed-case for many core vars; w2edqual in derived;
# scorg01–09 (zero-padded) replacing scorg1/scorga2/scorg3–9; scal7a instead
# of heala (now a true 7-day indicator, not a 12-month frequency).
elsa_cov_2004 <- elsa_core %>%
  left_join(
    elsa_derived %>% dplyr::select(idauniq, w2edqual, palevel, heoptgl, heoptca),
    by = "idauniq"
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    idauniq    = idauniq,
    year       = 2004L,
    birth_year = if_else(indobyr > 0, as.numeric(indobyr), NA_real_),
    age_2004   = if_else(indager > 0, as.numeric(indager), NA_real_),

    Gender = case_when(indsex %in% c(1, 2) ~ as.integer(indsex),
                       TRUE ~ NA_integer_),

    # W2 fqethnr has fuller coverage than W1, so no aethnicr fallback needed.
    Race = case_when(fqethnr == 1 ~ 0L, fqethnr == 2 ~ 1L,
                     TRUE ~ NA_integer_),

    # w2edqual: 1=Degree+ … 7=No qualification
    Education = case_when(
      is.na(w2edqual) | w2edqual < 0 ~ NA_integer_,
      w2edqual == 7                  ~ 0L,
      w2edqual %in% c(4, 5, 6)       ~ 1L,
      w2edqual %in% c(1, 2, 3)       ~ 2L,
      TRUE                           ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # DiMar: 1=Single, 2=Married 1st, 3=Remarried, 4=Sep, 5=Div, 6=Widowed
    Marital_status = case_when(
      DiMar %in% c(2, 3)       ~ 1L,
      DiMar %in% c(1, 4, 5, 6) ~ 0L,
      TRUE                     ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # wpdes: 1=Retired, 2=Employed, 3=Self-emp, 4=Unemployed, 5=Sick,
    # 6=Looking after home, 96=Semi-retired.
    # 85/86/95 (not codeable/irrelevant/other) → NA (uninformative).
    Employment = case_when(
      wpdes %in% c(2, 3)           ~ 1L,
      wpdes %in% c(1, 4, 5, 6, 96) ~ 0L,
      TRUE                          ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    Smoking = case_when(HESka == 1 ~ 1L, HESka == 2 ~ 0L,
                        TRUE ~ NA_integer_),

    # scal7a is a true 7-day binary in W2+
    Alcohol = case_when(scal7a == 1 ~ 1L, scal7a == 2 ~ 0L,
                        TRUE ~ NA_integer_),

    Physical_activity = case_when(
      HeActa %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 1L,
      HeActa == 4            ~ 0L,
      TRUE                   ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # scorg01–08 = org types; scorg09 = not a member of any
    Social_activity = case_when(
      scorg01 == 1 | scorg02 == 1 | scorg03 == 1 | scorg04 == 1 |
      scorg05 == 1 | scorg06 == 1 | scorg07 == 1 | scorg08 == 1 ~ 1L,
      scorg09 == 1 ~ 0L,
      scorg01 == 0 & scorg02 == 0 & scorg03 == 0 & scorg04 == 0 &
      scorg05 == 0 & scorg06 == 0 & scorg07 == 0 & scorg08 == 0 ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, year, birth_year, age_2004, Gender, Race, Education,
         Marital_status, Employment, Smoking, Alcohol,
         Physical_activity, Social_activity)


# 3. Sensory variables ------------------------------------------------------
# W2 derived heoptca / heoptgl use codes: -3=W1-only did not report,
# -2=W2-only did not report, 0=neither wave, 1=by W1, 2=by W2.
# All three of {-3, -2, 0} mean "no cataract/glaucoma reported" → 0.
sensory_var_2004 <- elsa_core %>%
  left_join(elsa_derived %>% dplyr::select(idauniq, heoptca, heoptgl),
            by = "idauniq") %>%
  transmute(
    idauniq = idauniq,

    # --- Hearing (Hehear: 1=excellent … 5=poor) ---
    hearing_loss = case_when(
      Hehear %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 0L,
      Hehear %in% c(4, 5)    ~ 1L,
      TRUE                   ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # --- Vision (Heeye: 1=excellent … 5=poor, 6=registered/legally blind) ---
    vision_overall = case_when(
      Heeye %in% c(1, 2, 3)    ~ 0L,
      Heeye %in% c(4, 5, 6)    ~ 1L,
      TRUE                     ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # --- Cataract diagnosis (cumulative ever-reported through W2) ---
    cataract_diagnosis = case_when(
      heoptca %in% c(1, 2)        ~ 1L,
      heoptca %in% c(-3, -2, 0)   ~ 0L,
      TRUE                        ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # --- Glaucoma diagnosis (cumulative ever-reported through W2) ---
    glaucoma_diagnosis = case_when(
      heoptgl %in% c(1, 2)        ~ 1L,
      heoptgl %in% c(-3, -2, 0)   ~ 0L,
      TRUE                        ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # --- Cataract surgery (direct question Hecat: 1=Yes, 2=No) ---
    cataract_surgery = case_when(
      Hecat == 1 ~ 1L,
      Hecat == 2 ~ 0L,
      TRUE       ~ NA_integer_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, hearing_loss, vision_overall,
                cataract_diagnosis, glaucoma_diagnosis, cataract_surgery)


# 4. Dementia classification -----------------------------------------------
elsa_cog_2004 <- elsa_core %>%
  left_join(elsa_derived %>% dplyr::select(idauniq, hedibad, hedibde), by = "idauniq") %>%
  transmute(
    idauniq = idauniq, year = 2004L,
    diagnosed_dementia = case_when(
      hedibad %in% c(1, 2) | hedibde %in% c(1, 2) ~ 1L,
      hedibad %in% c(-3, -2, 0) & hedibde %in% c(-3, -2, 0) ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    iqcode_b = if_else(Heiqb %in% 1:5, as.numeric(Heiqb), NA_real_),
    iqcode_c = if_else(Heiqc %in% 1:5, as.numeric(Heiqc), NA_real_),
    iqcode_d = if_else(Heiqd %in% 1:5, as.numeric(Heiqd), NA_real_),
    iqcode_e = if_else(Heiqe %in% 1:5, as.numeric(Heiqe), NA_real_),
    iqcode_f = if_else(Heiqf %in% 1:5, as.numeric(Heiqf), NA_real_),
    iqcode_g = if_else(Heiqg %in% 1:5, as.numeric(Heiqg), NA_real_),
    iqcode_h = if_else(Heiqh %in% 1:5, as.numeric(Heiqh), NA_real_),
    iqcode_i = if_else(Heiqi %in% 1:5, as.numeric(Heiqi), NA_real_),
    iqcode_j = if_else(Heiqj %in% 1:5, as.numeric(Heiqj), NA_real_),
    iqcode_k = if_else(Heiqk %in% 1:5, as.numeric(Heiqk), NA_real_),
    iqcode_l = if_else(Heiql %in% 1:5, as.numeric(Heiql), NA_real_),
    iqcode_m = if_else(Heiqm %in% 1:5, as.numeric(Heiqm), NA_real_),
    iqcode_n = if_else(Heiqn %in% 1:5, as.numeric(Heiqn), NA_real_),
    iqcode_o = if_else(Heiqo %in% 1:5, as.numeric(Heiqo), NA_real_),
    iqcode_p = if_else(Heiqp %in% 1:5, as.numeric(Heiqp), NA_real_),
    iqcode_q = if_else(Heiqq %in% 1:5, as.numeric(Heiqq), NA_real_)
  )

iqcode_cols <- paste0("iqcode_", letters[2:17])
iqcode_mat  <- as.matrix(elsa_cog_2004[, iqcode_cols])

elsa_cog_2004 <- elsa_cog_2004 %>%
  mutate(
    iqcode_n_valid  = rowSums(!is.na(iqcode_mat)),
    iqcode_mean     = if_else(iqcode_n_valid >= 1L,
                              rowMeans(iqcode_mat, na.rm = TRUE),
                              NA_real_),
    iqcode_dementia = case_when(
      is.na(iqcode_mean) ~ NA_integer_,
      iqcode_mean >= 3.4 ~ 1L,
      iqcode_mean <  3.4 ~ 0L
    ),
    dementia = case_when(
      diagnosed_dementia == 1 | iqcode_dementia == 1 ~ 1L,
      diagnosed_dementia == 0 | iqcode_dementia == 0 ~ 0L,
      TRUE                                           ~ NA_integer_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, year, diagnosed_dementia, iqcode_mean, iqcode_n_valid,
         iqcode_dementia, dementia)

# Wave 2 (2004) Dementia Classification — observed counts
# -------------------------------------------------------
# Total participants in Wave 2: 9,432
# Total dementia cases:         107  (1.13% prevalence; 0 missing)
#   Physician diagnosis only : 64   (of which 62 had no IQCODE data)
#   IQCODE ≥ 3.4 only        : 22
#   Both sources             : 21
# Missing dementia status:     0    (both sources resolvable for every respondent)
#
# Physician diagnosis (derived hedibad + hedibde, codes {1,2} → yes):
#   Yes: 85   No: 9,347   Missing: 0
# IQCODE (16-item Heiqb–Heiqq):
#   125 respondents with ≥1 valid item
#   9,307 with no IQCODE data (no informant / proxy interview)
#   Mean 3.49  |  Median 3.06  |  IQR 3.00–3.94
#   ≥ 3.4 classification: Yes 43  No 82  NA 9,307
```

```{r}
  filter(dementia == 1) %>%
  mutate(
    dementia_source = case_when(
      diagnosed_dementia == 1 & iqcode_dementia == 1 ~ "Both",
      diagnosed_dementia == 1 & (iqcode_dementia == 0 | is.na(iqcode_dementia)) ~ "Physician Dx only",
      (diagnosed_dementia == 0 | is.na(diagnosed_dementia)) & iqcode_dementia == 1 ~ "IQCODE only"
    )
  )

cat("--- Dementia Source Breakdown (among dementia cases) ---\n")
source_tab_w2 <- dementia_desc_w2 %>%
  count(dementia_source) %>%
  mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1))
print(source_tab_w2)
cat("\n")

cat("--- Final Combined Dementia (either source) ---\n")
cat("  Dementia Yes (1):", sum(elsa_cog_2004$dementia == 1, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("  Dementia No  (0):", sum(elsa_cog_2004$dementia == 0, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("  Dementia NA     :", sum(is.na(elsa_cog_2004$dementia)), "\n")
cat("  Prevalence (among non-NA):",
    round(100 * mean(elsa_cog_2004$dementia == 1, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "%\n\n")

summary_dementia_w2 <- tibble(
  Source = c("Physician diagnosis only",
             "IQCODE >= 3.4 only",
             "Both sources",
             "Total dementia cases",
             "Total non-dementia",
             "Total missing"),
  N = c(
    sum(dementia_desc_w2$dementia_source == "Physician Dx only", na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(dementia_desc_w2$dementia_source == "IQCODE only", na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(dementia_desc_w2$dementia_source == "Both", na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(elsa_cog_2004$dementia == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(elsa_cog_2004$dementia == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(is.na(elsa_cog_2004$dementia))
  )
)

print(summary_dementia_w2)

```



# Frailty Index
```{r}
# 5. Frailty Index ---------------------------------------------------------
# (has_mention is already defined from the W1 chunk; no need to redefine.)

# 5a. Mobility — use pick() (cur_data() is deprecated in dplyr >= 1.1.0)
mob_cols <- paste0("heada", sprintf("%02d", 1:10))
elsa_fi <- elsa_core %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, all_of(mob_cols)) %>%
  mutate(
    hemobwa = has_mention(pick(all_of(mob_cols)), mob_cols,  1),
    hemobsi = has_mention(pick(all_of(mob_cols)), mob_cols,  2),
    hemobch = has_mention(pick(all_of(mob_cols)), mob_cols,  3),
    hemobcs = has_mention(pick(all_of(mob_cols)), mob_cols,  4),
    hemobcl = has_mention(pick(all_of(mob_cols)), mob_cols,  5),
    hemobst = has_mention(pick(all_of(mob_cols)), mob_cols,  6),
    hemobre = has_mention(pick(all_of(mob_cols)), mob_cols,  7),
    hemobpu = has_mention(pick(all_of(mob_cols)), mob_cols,  8),
    hemobli = has_mention(pick(all_of(mob_cols)), mob_cols,  9),
    hemobpi = has_mention(pick(all_of(mob_cols)), mob_cols, 10)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, starts_with("hemob"))

# 5b. ADL/IADL
adl_cols <- paste0("headb", sprintf("%02d", 1:13))
adl_iadl <- elsa_core %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, all_of(adl_cols)) %>%
  mutate(
    headldr = has_mention(pick(all_of(adl_cols)), adl_cols,  1),
    headlwa = has_mention(pick(all_of(adl_cols)), adl_cols,  2),
    headlba = has_mention(pick(all_of(adl_cols)), adl_cols,  3),
    headlea = has_mention(pick(all_of(adl_cols)), adl_cols,  4),
    headlbe = has_mention(pick(all_of(adl_cols)), adl_cols,  5),
    headlwc = has_mention(pick(all_of(adl_cols)), adl_cols,  6),
    headlma = has_mention(pick(all_of(adl_cols)), adl_cols,  7),
    headlpr = has_mention(pick(all_of(adl_cols)), adl_cols,  8),
    headlsh = has_mention(pick(all_of(adl_cols)), adl_cols,  9),
    headlph = has_mention(pick(all_of(adl_cols)), adl_cols, 10),
    headlme = has_mention(pick(all_of(adl_cols)), adl_cols, 11),
    headlhg = has_mention(pick(all_of(adl_cols)), adl_cols, 12),
    headlmo = has_mention(pick(all_of(adl_cols)), adl_cols, 13)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, starts_with("headl"))

# 5c. Diagnosed conditions — from derived file.
# Same {-3,-2,0}→0, {1,2}→1 handling as sensory/dementia.
recode_dx <- function(x) {
  case_when(
    x %in% c(1, 2)      ~ 1L,
    x %in% c(-3, -2, 0) ~ 0L,
    TRUE                ~ NA_integer_
  )
}
diagnoses <- elsa_derived %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, hedimbp, hediman, hedimmi, hedimhf, hedimar,
         hedimdi, hedimst, hediblu, hedibas, hedibar, hedibos,
         hedibca, hedibps) %>%
  mutate(across(-idauniq, recode_dx))

# 5d. CES-D (mixed case in W2)
cesd <- elsa_core %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, PScedA, PScedB, PScedC, PScedD,
         PScedE, PScedF, PScedG, PScedH) %>%
  mutate(
    psceda = case_when(PScedA == 1 ~ 1L, PScedA == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    pscedb = case_when(PScedB == 1 ~ 1L, PScedB == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    pscedc = case_when(PScedC == 1 ~ 1L, PScedC == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    pscede = case_when(PScedE == 1 ~ 1L, PScedE == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    pscedg = case_when(PScedG == 1 ~ 1L, PScedG == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    pscedh = case_when(PScedH == 1 ~ 1L, PScedH == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    pscedd = case_when(PScedD == 2 ~ 1L, PScedD == 1 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    pscedf = case_when(PScedF == 2 ~ 1L, PScedF == 1 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, psceda, pscedb, pscedc, pscedd, pscede, pscedf, pscedg, pscedh)

# 5e. Other health (mixed case)
other_health <- elsa_core %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, Hehelf, HeFla, HeFrac, HeJi, MmPain) %>%
  mutate(
    hehelf = case_when(Hehelf %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 0L,
                       Hehelf %in% c(4, 5)    ~ 1L,
                       TRUE                   ~ NA_integer_),
    hefla  = case_when(HeFla  == 1 ~ 1L, HeFla  == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    hefrac = case_when(HeFrac == 1 ~ 1L, HeFrac == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    heji   = case_when(HeJi   == 1 ~ 1L, HeJi   == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    mmpain = case_when(MmPain == 1 ~ 1L, MmPain == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, hehelf, hefla, hefrac, heji, mmpain)

# 5f. Merge & compute FI — vectorised (matches W1)
fi_items <- c(
  "hemobwa", "hemobsi", "hemobch", "hemobcs", "hemobcl",
  "hemobst", "hemobre", "hemobpu", "hemobli", "hemobpi",
  "headldr", "headlwa", "headlba", "headlea", "headlbe", "headlwc",
  "headlma", "headlpr", "headlsh", "headlph", "headlme", "headlhg", "headlmo",
  "hedimbp", "hediman", "hedimmi", "hedimhf", "hedimar",
  "hedimdi", "hedimst", "hediblu", "hedibas", "hedibar", "hedibos", "hedibca", "hedibps",
  "psceda", "pscedb", "pscedc", "pscedd", "pscede", "pscedf", "pscedg", "pscedh",
  "hehelf", "hefla", "hefrac", "heji", "mmpain"
)
n_fi_items <- length(fi_items)
stopifnot(n_fi_items == 49)

# Strict (I)ADL items removed in the sensitivity FI
iadl_items <- c(
  # ADL (6)
  "headldr", "headlwa", "headlba", "headlea", "headlbe", "headlwc",
  # IADL (7) — phone, money, meals, shopping, meds, house/garden, map use
  "headlma", "headlpr", "headlsh", "headlph", "headlme", "headlhg", "headlmo"
)
fi_items_noIADL   <- setdiff(fi_items, iadl_items)
n_fi_items_noIADL <- length(fi_items_noIADL)
stopifnot(n_fi_items_noIADL == 36)

fi_merged <- elsa_fi %>%
  left_join(adl_iadl,     by = "idauniq") %>%
  left_join(diagnoses,    by = "idauniq") %>%
  left_join(cesd,         by = "idauniq") %>%
  left_join(other_health, by = "idauniq")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# (a) ORIGINAL frailty index — 49 items
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
fi_mat <- as.matrix(fi_merged[, fi_items])

elsa_fi_2004_orig <- fi_merged %>%
  mutate(
    year         = 2004L,
    fi_n_valid   = rowSums(!is.na(fi_mat)),
    fi_n_deficit = rowSums(fi_mat == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    fi_score     = if_else(
      fi_n_valid >= ceiling(n_fi_items * 0.8),
      fi_n_deficit / fi_n_valid,
      NA_real_
    ),
    frailty = case_when(
      is.na(fi_score)  ~ NA_integer_,
      fi_score >= 0.25 ~ 1L,
      fi_score <  0.25 ~ 0L
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(fi_score)) %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, year, fi_n_valid, fi_n_deficit, fi_score, frailty)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# (b) MODIFIED frailty index — (I)ADL items removed (sensitivity)
#     Addresses possible mediation by (I)ADL deficits on the
#     sensory-impairment → dementia pathway. Same ≥0.25 threshold,
#     same ≥80% completeness rule applied to the reduced 36-item set
#     (>= 29 of 36).
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
fi_mat_noIADL <- as.matrix(fi_merged[, fi_items_noIADL])

elsa_fi_2004_noIADL <- fi_merged %>%
  mutate(
    fi_n_valid_noIADL   = rowSums(!is.na(fi_mat_noIADL)),
    fi_n_deficit_noIADL = rowSums(fi_mat_noIADL == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    fi_score_noIADL = if_else(
      fi_n_valid_noIADL >= ceiling(n_fi_items_noIADL * 0.8),
      fi_n_deficit_noIADL / fi_n_valid_noIADL,
      NA_real_
    ),
    frailty_noIADL = case_when(
      is.na(fi_score_noIADL)  ~ NA_integer_,
      fi_score_noIADL >= 0.25 ~ 1L,
      fi_score_noIADL <  0.25 ~ 0L
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(fi_score_noIADL)) %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, fi_n_valid_noIADL, fi_n_deficit_noIADL,
                fi_score_noIADL, frailty_noIADL)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Combine both FI versions into a single per-person table.
# Original `elsa_fi_2004` interface is preserved (idauniq, year,
# fi_n_valid, fi_n_deficit, fi_score, frailty); sensitivity columns
# (fi_score_noIADL, frailty_noIADL) are added alongside.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
elsa_fi_2004 <- elsa_fi_2004_orig %>%
  full_join(elsa_fi_2004_noIADL, by = "idauniq")

```



# Merge 2004 data
```{r}
# =========================================================================
# 6. Merge 2004 data
# =========================================================================
# FIX (as at 2002): elsa_fi_2004 carries `year` only on rows that survived
# the 49-item completeness filter, so noIADL-only rows have year = NA and
# were silently dropped by a join on c("idauniq","year").
elsa_2004 <- elsa_cov_2004 %>%
  left_join(sensory_var_2004, by = "idauniq") %>%
  left_join(elsa_cog_2004,    by = c("idauniq", "year")) %>%
  left_join(elsa_fi_2004 %>% dplyr::select(-any_of("year")), by = "idauniq")

stopifnot(anyDuplicated(elsa_2004$idauniq) == 0)

# =========================================================================
# 7. Multiple imputation (MICE) — ELSA wave 2 (2004)
# =========================================================================
# Identical specification to wave 1 — see the design notes in the 2002 block.
# Full convergence and observed-vs-imputed diagnostics are produced once, at
# wave 1, mirroring HRS_dataextract.Rmd (diagnostics at its 2004 baseline).

analysis_covars04 <- c("age_2004", "Education", "Marital_status", "Employment",
                       "Smoking", "Alcohol", "Physical_activity", "Social_activity")

# ---- 7a. Imputation frame ----------------------------------------------
# birth_year is not a predictor (near-collinear with age); age is resolved
# deterministically where a birth year exists and pmm handles the residual
# cases. Wave 2 fieldwork spanned 2004-2005, so that value can be ±1 year.
imp04_elsa <- elsa_2004 %>%
  transmute(
    idauniq    = as.character(idauniq),
    age_2004   = coalesce(as.numeric(age_2004), 2004 - as.numeric(birth_year)),
    Gender     = factor(Gender, levels = c(1, 2)),
    Race       = factor(Race,   levels = c(0, 1)),
    Education  = ordered(Education, levels = c(0, 1, 2)),
    across(c(Marital_status, Employment, Smoking, Alcohol,
             Physical_activity, Social_activity),
           ~ factor(.x, levels = c(0, 1)))
  )

# Variables with no observed values (Education from W6 onward) cannot be
# imputed; drop them here and leave them untouched in the analysis data.
all_missing04 <- names(imp04_elsa)[colSums(!is.na(imp04_elsa)) == 0]
if (length(all_missing04) > 0) {
  message("ELSA 2004 — no observed values, excluded from imputation: ",
          paste(all_missing04, collapse = ", "))
  imp04_elsa <- imp04_elsa %>% dplyr::select(-all_of(all_missing04))
}
imputed_vars04 <- setdiff(analysis_covars04, all_missing04)

# ---- 7b. Quantify missingness (for the Methods text) -------------------
miss_pct04 <- sapply(imp04_elsa, function(x) mean(is.na(x)) * 100)
cat("ELSA 2004 — percentage missing per variable:\n")
print(round(miss_pct04, 2))

miss_cov04 <- miss_pct04[intersect(imputed_vars04, names(miss_pct04))]
miss_cov04 <- miss_cov04[miss_cov04 > 0]
if (length(miss_cov04) > 0) {
  cat(sprintf("\nMean missing across analysis covariates: %.2f%%\n",
              mean(miss_cov04)))
  cat(sprintf("Maximum missing: %.2f%% (%s)\n",
              max(miss_cov04), names(which.max(miss_cov04))))
} else {
  cat("\nNo missing values among analysis covariates.\n")
}

# ---- 7c. Imputation method per variable --------------------------------
meth04 <- make.method(imp04_elsa)
meth04["idauniq"]  <- ""
meth04["age_2004"] <- "pmm"
meth04[intersect("Education", names(imp04_elsa))] <- "polr"
meth04[intersect(c("Gender", "Race", "Marital_status", "Employment", "Smoking",
                   "Alcohol", "Physical_activity", "Social_activity"),
                 names(imp04_elsa))] <- "logreg"
# Variables with no missing values are not imputed (mice requirement).
meth04[colSums(is.na(imp04_elsa)) == 0] <- ""

# ---- 7d. Predictor matrix ---------------------------------------------
pred04 <- make.predictorMatrix(imp04_elsa)
pred04[, "idauniq"] <- 0
pred04["idauniq", ] <- 0

# GUARD: no incomplete variable may be used as a predictor without itself
# being imputed, otherwise NAs leak into every imputation model.
incomplete04 <- names(imp04_elsa)[colSums(is.na(imp04_elsa)) > 0]
stopifnot(all(meth04[incomplete04] != ""))

# ---- 7e. Run MICE: 20 imputed datasets, 10 iterations ------------------
set.seed(3)
imp_mice04_elsa <- mice(
  imp04_elsa,
  m               = 20,
  maxit           = 10,
  method          = meth04,
  predictorMatrix = pred04,
  printFlag       = TRUE
)

if (!is.null(imp_mice04_elsa$loggedEvents)) {
  cat("\nMICE logged events (ELSA 2004):\n")
  print(imp_mice04_elsa$loggedEvents)
}

# ---- 7f. Merge the completed covariates back ---------------------------
# Single completion (imputation 1), as in HRS. Only the analysis covariates
# are replaced; Gender, Race and the primary study variables keep their
# ORIGINAL values, including NAs.
imp04_elsa_complete1 <- complete(imp_mice04_elsa, 1)

elsa04_clean <- elsa_2004 %>%
  mutate(idauniq = as.character(idauniq)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-all_of(imputed_vars04)) %>%
  left_join(
    imp04_elsa_complete1 %>%
      mutate(idauniq = as.character(idauniq)) %>%
      dplyr::select(idauniq, all_of(imputed_vars04)),
    by = "idauniq"
  )

ELSA_2004 <- elsa04_clean

stopifnot(nrow(ELSA_2004) == nrow(elsa_2004))
```

# ELSA Wave 3 (2006)
```{r}
elsa_core_w3 <- read_dta(file.path(data_dir, "wave_3_elsa_data_v4.dta"))

# ==========================================================================
# 1. Covariates
# W3 specifics:
#   - all lowercase variable names
#   - w3edqual in core (no derived file needed)
#   - dimar ALREADY uses 1–11 civil-partnership coding (change is at W3, not W4)
# ==========================================================================
elsa_cov_2006 <- elsa_core_w3 %>%
  transmute(
    idauniq,
    year       = 2006L,
    birth_year = if_else(indobyr > 0, as.numeric(indobyr), NA_real_),
    age_2006   = if_else(indager > 0, as.numeric(indager), NA_real_),

    Gender = case_when(indsex %in% c(1, 2) ~ as.integer(indsex),
                       TRUE                ~ NA_integer_),

    Race = case_when(fqethnr == 1 ~ 0L, fqethnr == 2 ~ 1L,
                     TRUE ~ NA_integer_),

    # w3edqual: same 1–7 coding as w2edqual
    Education = case_when(
      is.na(w3edqual) | w3edqual < 0 ~ NA_integer_,
      w3edqual == 7                  ~ 0L,
      w3edqual %in% c(4, 5, 6)       ~ 1L,
      w3edqual %in% c(1, 2, 3)       ~ 2L,
      TRUE                           ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # W3 dimar: 1–11 coding with civil partnerships
    #   1=Single, 2=Married(1st), 3=Civil partner, 4=Remarried,
    #   5=Separated, 6=Divorced, 7=Widowed,
    #   8=CP separated, 9=CP dissolved, 10=Surviving CP,
    #   11=CP + previously married
    Marital_status = case_when(
      dimar %in% c(2, 3, 4, 11)              ~ 1L,   # married / in CP / remarried
      dimar %in% c(1, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10)     ~ 0L,   # single / sep / div / widowed
      TRUE                                   ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # wpdes: treat 85/86 (not codeable / irrelevant) as NA
    Employment = case_when(
      wpdes %in% c(2, 3)           ~ 1L,
      wpdes %in% c(1, 4, 5, 6, 96) ~ 0L,
      TRUE                          ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    Smoking = case_when(heska == 1 ~ 1L, heska == 2 ~ 0L,
                        TRUE ~ NA_integer_),

    Alcohol = case_when(scal7a == 1 ~ 1L, scal7a == 2 ~ 0L,
                        TRUE ~ NA_integer_),

    Physical_activity = case_when(
      heacta %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 1L,
      heacta == 4            ~ 0L,
      TRUE                   ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    Social_activity = case_when(
      scorg01 == 1 | scorg02 == 1 | scorg03 == 1 | scorg04 == 1 |
      scorg05 == 1 | scorg06 == 1 | scorg07 == 1 | scorg08 == 1 ~ 1L,
      scorg09 == 1 ~ 0L,
      scorg01 == 0 & scorg02 == 0 & scorg03 == 0 & scorg04 == 0 &
      scorg05 == 0 & scorg06 == 0 & scorg07 == 0 & scorg08 == 0 ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, year, birth_year, age_2006,
         Gender, Race, Education, Marital_status, Employment,
         Smoking, Alcohol, Physical_activity, Social_activity)


# ==========================================================================
# 2. Sensory variables
# W3 heoptca/heoptgl codes: {-3, -2, -1, 0, 1, 2, 3}
#   1,2,3  = by W1/W2/W3 (reported)
#   0      = not in any wave
#   -1/-2/-3 = "in Wave X only and did not report" → also "no report"
# ==========================================================================
sensory_var_2006 <- elsa_core_w3 %>%
  transmute(
    idauniq,

    # --- Hearing (hehear: 1=excellent … 5=poor) ---
    hearing_loss = case_when(
      hehear %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 0L,
      hehear %in% c(4, 5)    ~ 1L,
      TRUE                   ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # --- Vision (heeye: 1=excellent … 5=poor, 6=registered/legally blind) ---
    vision_overall = case_when(
      heeye %in% c(1, 2, 3)    ~ 0L,
      heeye %in% c(4, 5, 6)    ~ 1L,
      TRUE                     ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # --- Cataract diagnosis (cumulative ever-reported through W3) ---
    cataract_diagnosis = case_when(
      heoptca %in% c(1, 2, 3)         ~ 1L,
      heoptca %in% c(-3, -2, -1, 0)   ~ 0L,
      TRUE                            ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # --- Glaucoma diagnosis (cumulative ever-reported through W3) ---
    glaucoma_diagnosis = case_when(
      heoptgl %in% c(1, 2, 3)         ~ 1L,
      heoptgl %in% c(-3, -2, -1, 0)   ~ 0L,
      TRUE                            ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # --- Cataract surgery (direct question hecat: 1=Yes, 2=No) ---
    cataract_surgery = case_when(
      hecat == 1 ~ 1L,
      hecat == 2 ~ 0L,
      TRUE       ~ NA_integer_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, hearing_loss, vision_overall,
                cataract_diagnosis, glaucoma_diagnosis, cataract_surgery)


# ==========================================================================
# 3. Dementia classification
# Same code-range as sensory: {-3,-2,-1,0} → "no report", {1,2,3} → reported
# ==========================================================================
elsa_cog_2006 <- elsa_core_w3 %>%
  transmute(
    idauniq,
    year = 2006L,
    diagnosed_dementia = case_when(
      hedibad %in% c(1, 2, 3) | hedibde %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 1L,
      hedibad %in% c(-3, -2, -1, 0) &
        hedibde %in% c(-3, -2, -1, 0)                   ~ 0L,
      TRUE                                              ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    iqcode_b = if_else(heiqb %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqb), NA_real_),
    iqcode_c = if_else(heiqc %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqc), NA_real_),
    iqcode_d = if_else(heiqd %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqd), NA_real_),
    iqcode_e = if_else(heiqe %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqe), NA_real_),
    iqcode_f = if_else(heiqf %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqf), NA_real_),
    iqcode_g = if_else(heiqg %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqg), NA_real_),
    iqcode_h = if_else(heiqh %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqh), NA_real_),
    iqcode_i = if_else(heiqi %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqi), NA_real_),
    iqcode_j = if_else(heiqj %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqj), NA_real_),
    iqcode_k = if_else(heiqk %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqk), NA_real_),
    iqcode_l = if_else(heiql %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiql), NA_real_),
    iqcode_m = if_else(heiqm %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqm), NA_real_),
    iqcode_n = if_else(heiqn %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqn), NA_real_),
    iqcode_o = if_else(heiqo %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqo), NA_real_),
    iqcode_p = if_else(heiqp %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqp), NA_real_),
    iqcode_q = if_else(heiqq %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqq), NA_real_)
  )

iqcode_cols <- paste0("iqcode_", letters[2:17])
iqcode_mat  <- as.matrix(elsa_cog_2006[, iqcode_cols])

elsa_cog_2006 <- elsa_cog_2006 %>%
  mutate(
    iqcode_n_valid  = rowSums(!is.na(iqcode_mat)),
    iqcode_mean     = if_else(iqcode_n_valid >= 1L,
                              rowMeans(iqcode_mat, na.rm = TRUE),
                              NA_real_),
    iqcode_dementia = case_when(
      is.na(iqcode_mean) ~ NA_integer_,
      iqcode_mean >= 3.4 ~ 1L,
      iqcode_mean <  3.4 ~ 0L
    ),
    dementia = case_when(
      diagnosed_dementia == 1 | iqcode_dementia == 1 ~ 1L,
      diagnosed_dementia == 0 | iqcode_dementia == 0 ~ 0L,
      TRUE                                           ~ NA_integer_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, year, diagnosed_dementia, iqcode_mean, iqcode_n_valid,
         iqcode_dementia, dementia)

# Wave 3 (2006) Dementia Classification — observed counts
# -------------------------------------------------------
# Total participants in Wave 3: 9,771
# Total dementia cases:         172  (1.76% prevalence; 0 missing)
#   Physician diagnosis only : 84   (of which 78 had no IQCODE data)
#   IQCODE ≥ 3.4 only        : 39
#   Both sources             : 49
# Missing dementia status:     0    (both sources resolvable for every respondent)
#
# Physician diagnosis (hedibad + hedibde, cumulative codes {1,2,3} → yes):
#   Yes: 133   No: 9,638   Missing: 0
# IQCODE (16-item heiqb–heiqq):
#   224 respondents with ≥1 valid item
#   9,547 with no IQCODE data (no informant / proxy interview)
#   Mean 3.57  |  Median 3.13  |  IQR 3.00–4.39
#   ≥ 3.4 classification: Yes 88  No 136  NA 9,547
```

# Frailty Index 2006
```{r}
# 4. Frailty Index (49 items)
# W3 specifics:
#   - Mobility/ADL already binary (0=not mentioned, 1=mentioned)
#   - headlho instead of headlhg (same construct; renamed)
#   - hegenh (self-rated): 1=Very good … 5=Very bad  → {1,2}=0, {3,4,5}=1
#   - Diagnosed conditions: cumulative codes {-3,-2,-1,0,1,2,3}
# ==========================================================================
recode_mob_adl <- function(x) {
  case_when(
    x == 1 ~ 1L,
    x == 0 ~ 0L,
    TRUE   ~ NA_integer_
  )
}

# Include ALL "did not report" codes as 0
recode_dx_w3 <- function(x) {
  case_when(
    x %in% c(1, 2, 3)           ~ 1L,
    x %in% c(-3, -2, -1, 0)     ~ 0L,
    TRUE                        ~ NA_integer_
  )
}

# Mobility (Items 1–10)
mobility_w3 <- elsa_core_w3 %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, hemobwa, hemobsi, hemobch, hemobcs, hemobcl,
         hemobst, hemobre, hemobpu, hemobli, hemobpi) %>%
  mutate(across(-idauniq, recode_mob_adl))

# ADL/IADL (Items 11–23) — headlho renamed to headlhg for W2 consistency
adl_iadl_w3 <- elsa_core_w3 %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, headldr, headlwa, headlba, headlea, headlbe, headlwc,
         headlma, headlpr, headlsh, headlph, headlme, headlho, headlmo) %>%
  rename(headlhg = headlho) %>%
  mutate(across(-idauniq, recode_mob_adl))

# Diagnosed conditions (Items 24–36)
diagnoses_w3 <- elsa_core_w3 %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, hedimbp, hediman, hedimmi, hedimhf, hedimar,
         hedimdi, hedimst, hediblu, hedibas, hedibar, hedibos,
         hedibca, hedibps) %>%
  mutate(across(-idauniq, recode_dx_w3))

# CES-D (Items 37–44) — lowercase in W3
cesd_w3 <- elsa_core_w3 %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, psceda, pscedb, pscedc, pscedd,
         pscede, pscedf, pscedg, pscedh) %>%
  mutate(
    psceda = case_when(psceda == 1 ~ 1L, psceda == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    pscedb = case_when(pscedb == 1 ~ 1L, pscedb == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    pscedc = case_when(pscedc == 1 ~ 1L, pscedc == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    pscede = case_when(pscede == 1 ~ 1L, pscede == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    pscedg = case_when(pscedg == 1 ~ 1L, pscedg == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    pscedh = case_when(pscedh == 1 ~ 1L, pscedh == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    # reverse-coded
    pscedd = case_when(pscedd == 2 ~ 1L, pscedd == 1 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    pscedf = case_when(pscedf == 2 ~ 1L, pscedf == 1 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_)
  )

# Other health (Items 45, 48–51) — W3 uses hegenh (different scale from W2 Hehelf)
other_health_w3 <- elsa_core_w3 %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, hegenh, hefla, hefrac, heji, mmpain) %>%
  mutate(
    hehelf = case_when(
      hegenh %in% c(1, 2)    ~ 0L,
      hegenh %in% c(3, 4, 5) ~ 1L,
      TRUE                   ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    hefla  = case_when(hefla  == 1 ~ 1L, hefla  == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    hefrac = case_when(hefrac == 1 ~ 1L, hefrac == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    heji   = case_when(heji   == 1 ~ 1L, heji   == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    mmpain = case_when(mmpain == 1 ~ 1L, mmpain == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, hehelf, hefla, hefrac, heji, mmpain)

# Strict (I)ADL items removed in the sensitivity FI
# (Re-declared so this chunk is self-contained; identical across waves.)
iadl_items <- c(
  # ADL (6)
  "headldr", "headlwa", "headlba", "headlea", "headlbe", "headlwc",
  # IADL (7) — phone, money, meals, shopping, meds, house/garden, map use
  "headlma", "headlpr", "headlsh", "headlph", "headlme", "headlhg", "headlmo"
)
fi_items_noIADL   <- setdiff(fi_items, iadl_items)
n_fi_items_noIADL <- length(fi_items_noIADL)
stopifnot(n_fi_items_noIADL == 36)

# Merge components (single source of recoded items feeds both FIs)
fi_merged_w3 <- mobility_w3 %>%
  left_join(adl_iadl_w3,     by = "idauniq") %>%
  left_join(diagnoses_w3,    by = "idauniq") %>%
  left_join(cesd_w3,         by = "idauniq") %>%
  left_join(other_health_w3, by = "idauniq")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# (a) ORIGINAL frailty index — 49 items
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
fi_mat_w3 <- as.matrix(fi_merged_w3[, fi_items])

elsa_fi_2006_orig <- fi_merged_w3 %>%
  mutate(
    year         = 2006L,
    fi_n_valid   = rowSums(!is.na(fi_mat_w3)),
    fi_n_deficit = rowSums(fi_mat_w3 == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    fi_score     = if_else(
      fi_n_valid >= ceiling(n_fi_items * 0.8),
      fi_n_deficit / fi_n_valid,
      NA_real_
    ),
    frailty = case_when(
      is.na(fi_score)  ~ NA_integer_,
      fi_score >= 0.25 ~ 1L,
      fi_score <  0.25 ~ 0L
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(fi_score)) %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, year, fi_n_valid, fi_n_deficit, fi_score, frailty)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# (b) MODIFIED frailty index — (I)ADL items removed (sensitivity)
#     Addresses possible mediation by (I)ADL deficits on the
#     sensory-impairment → dementia pathway. Same ≥0.25 threshold,
#     same ≥80% completeness rule applied to the reduced 36-item set
#     (>= 29 of 36).
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
fi_mat_w3_noIADL <- as.matrix(fi_merged_w3[, fi_items_noIADL])

elsa_fi_2006_noIADL <- fi_merged_w3 %>%
  mutate(
    fi_n_valid_noIADL   = rowSums(!is.na(fi_mat_w3_noIADL)),
    fi_n_deficit_noIADL = rowSums(fi_mat_w3_noIADL == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    fi_score_noIADL = if_else(
      fi_n_valid_noIADL >= ceiling(n_fi_items_noIADL * 0.8),
      fi_n_deficit_noIADL / fi_n_valid_noIADL,
      NA_real_
    ),
    frailty_noIADL = case_when(
      is.na(fi_score_noIADL)  ~ NA_integer_,
      fi_score_noIADL >= 0.25 ~ 1L,
      fi_score_noIADL <  0.25 ~ 0L
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(fi_score_noIADL)) %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, fi_n_valid_noIADL, fi_n_deficit_noIADL,
                fi_score_noIADL, frailty_noIADL)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Combine both FI versions into a single per-person table.
# Original `elsa_fi_2006` interface is preserved (idauniq, year,
# fi_n_valid, fi_n_deficit, fi_score, frailty); sensitivity columns
# (fi_score_noIADL, frailty_noIADL) are added alongside.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
elsa_fi_2006 <- elsa_fi_2006_orig %>%
  full_join(elsa_fi_2006_noIADL, by = "idauniq")


```



# Merge 2006 data
```{r}
# ==========================================================================
# 5. Merge 2006 data
# ==========================================================================
# FIX (as at 2002/2004): elsa_fi_2006 carries `year` only on rows that
# survived the 49-item completeness filter, so noIADL-only rows have
# year = NA and were silently dropped by a join on c("idauniq","year").
elsa_2006 <- elsa_cov_2006 %>%
  left_join(sensory_var_2006, by = "idauniq") %>%
  left_join(elsa_cog_2006,    by = c("idauniq", "year")) %>%
  left_join(elsa_fi_2006 %>% dplyr::select(-any_of("year")), by = "idauniq")

stopifnot(anyDuplicated(elsa_2006$idauniq) == 0)

# ==========================================================================
# 6. Multiple imputation (MICE) — ELSA wave 3 (2006)
# ==========================================================================
# Identical specification to waves 1-2 — see the design notes in the 2002
# block. Full convergence and observed-vs-imputed diagnostics are produced
# once, at wave 1, mirroring HRS_dataextract.Rmd.

analysis_covars06 <- c("age_2006", "Education", "Marital_status", "Employment",
                       "Smoking", "Alcohol", "Physical_activity", "Social_activity")

# ---- 6a. Imputation frame ----------------------------------------------
# birth_year is not a predictor (near-collinear with age); age is resolved
# deterministically where a birth year exists and pmm handles the residual
# cases. Wave 3 fieldwork spanned 2006-2007, so that value can be ±1 year.
imp06_elsa <- elsa_2006 %>%
  transmute(
    idauniq    = as.character(idauniq),
    age_2006   = coalesce(as.numeric(age_2006), 2006 - as.numeric(birth_year)),
    Gender     = factor(Gender, levels = c(1, 2)),
    Race       = factor(Race,   levels = c(0, 1)),
    Education  = ordered(Education, levels = c(0, 1, 2)),
    across(c(Marital_status, Employment, Smoking, Alcohol,
             Physical_activity, Social_activity),
           ~ factor(.x, levels = c(0, 1)))
  )

# Variables with no observed values (Education from W6 onward) cannot be
# imputed; drop them here and leave them untouched in the analysis data.
all_missing06 <- names(imp06_elsa)[colSums(!is.na(imp06_elsa)) == 0]
if (length(all_missing06) > 0) {
  message("ELSA 2006 — no observed values, excluded from imputation: ",
          paste(all_missing06, collapse = ", "))
  imp06_elsa <- imp06_elsa %>% dplyr::select(-all_of(all_missing06))
}
imputed_vars06 <- setdiff(analysis_covars06, all_missing06)

# ---- 6b. Quantify missingness (for the Methods text) -------------------
miss_pct06 <- sapply(imp06_elsa, function(x) mean(is.na(x)) * 100)
cat("ELSA 2006 — percentage missing per variable:\n")
print(round(miss_pct06, 2))

miss_cov06 <- miss_pct06[intersect(imputed_vars06, names(miss_pct06))]
miss_cov06 <- miss_cov06[miss_cov06 > 0]
if (length(miss_cov06) > 0) {
  cat(sprintf("\nMean missing across analysis covariates: %.2f%%\n",
              mean(miss_cov06)))
  cat(sprintf("Maximum missing: %.2f%% (%s)\n",
              max(miss_cov06), names(which.max(miss_cov06))))
} else {
  cat("\nNo missing values among analysis covariates.\n")
}

# ---- 6c. Imputation method per variable --------------------------------
meth06 <- make.method(imp06_elsa)
meth06["idauniq"]  <- ""
meth06["age_2006"] <- "pmm"
meth06[intersect("Education", names(imp06_elsa))] <- "polr"
meth06[intersect(c("Gender", "Race", "Marital_status", "Employment", "Smoking",
                   "Alcohol", "Physical_activity", "Social_activity"),
                 names(imp06_elsa))] <- "logreg"
# Variables with no missing values are not imputed (mice requirement).
meth06[colSums(is.na(imp06_elsa)) == 0] <- ""

# ---- 6d. Predictor matrix ---------------------------------------------
pred06 <- make.predictorMatrix(imp06_elsa)
pred06[, "idauniq"] <- 0
pred06["idauniq", ] <- 0

# GUARD: no incomplete variable may be used as a predictor without itself
# being imputed, otherwise NAs leak into every imputation model.
incomplete06 <- names(imp06_elsa)[colSums(is.na(imp06_elsa)) > 0]
stopifnot(all(meth06[incomplete06] != ""))

# ---- 6e. Run MICE: 20 imputed datasets, 10 iterations ------------------
set.seed(3)
imp_mice06_elsa <- mice(
  imp06_elsa,
  m               = 20,
  maxit           = 10,
  method          = meth06,
  predictorMatrix = pred06,
  printFlag       = TRUE
)

if (!is.null(imp_mice06_elsa$loggedEvents)) {
  cat("\nMICE logged events (ELSA 2006):\n")
  print(imp_mice06_elsa$loggedEvents)
}

# ---- 6f. Merge the completed covariates back ---------------------------
# Single completion (imputation 1), as in HRS. Only the analysis covariates
# are replaced; Gender, Race and the primary study variables keep their
# ORIGINAL values, including NAs.
imp06_elsa_complete1 <- complete(imp_mice06_elsa, 1)

elsa06_clean <- elsa_2006 %>%
  mutate(idauniq = as.character(idauniq)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-all_of(imputed_vars06)) %>%
  left_join(
    imp06_elsa_complete1 %>%
      mutate(idauniq = as.character(idauniq)) %>%
      dplyr::select(idauniq, all_of(imputed_vars06)),
    by = "idauniq"
  )

ELSA_2006 <- elsa06_clean

stopifnot(nrow(ELSA_2006) == nrow(elsa_2006))
```
