# ELSA Wave 4 (2008)
```{r}
elsa_core_w4 <- read_dta(file.path(data_dir, "wave_4_elsa_data_v3.dta"))

# ==========================================================================
# 1. Covariates
# W4 specifics (versus earlier waves):
#   - all lowercase variable names
#   - w4edqual in core (same 1–7 coding as w2edqual/w3edqual)
#   - dimar already uses 1–11 civil-partnership coding (change was in W3)
#   - hehelf: 1–5 "Excellent" scale (same as W2, not W3's hegenh)
#   - heoptca/heoptgl/hedibad/hedibde: "newly reported" binary 0/1 per wave
#     (not cumulative — see dementia note below)
#   - Mobility / ADL: binary 0/1 (like W3)
# ==========================================================================
elsa_cov_2008 <- elsa_core_w4 %>%
  transmute(
    idauniq,
    year       = 2008L,
    birth_year = if_else(indobyr > 0, as.numeric(indobyr), NA_real_),
    age_2008   = if_else(indager > 0, as.numeric(indager), NA_real_),

    Gender = case_when(indsex %in% c(1, 2) ~ as.integer(indsex),
                       TRUE                ~ NA_integer_),

    Race = case_when(fqethnr == 1 ~ 0L, fqethnr == 2 ~ 1L,
                     TRUE ~ NA_integer_),

    Education = case_when(
      is.na(w4edqual) | w4edqual < 0 ~ NA_integer_,
      w4edqual == 7                  ~ 0L,
      w4edqual %in% c(4, 5, 6)       ~ 1L,
      w4edqual %in% c(1, 2, 3)       ~ 2L,
      TRUE                           ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # dimar 1–11 with civil partnership
    #   2=Married(1st), 3=Civil partner, 4=Remarried, 11=CP+prior marriage → married
    #   1=Single, 5=Separated, 6=Divorced, 7=Widowed, 8–10=CP ended → not married
    Marital_status = case_when(
      dimar %in% c(2, 3, 4, 11)              ~ 1L,
      dimar %in% c(1, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10)     ~ 0L,
      TRUE                                   ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # wpdes: treat 85/86 (not codeable / irrelevant) as NA
    Employment = case_when(
      wpdes %in% c(2, 3)           ~ 1L,
      wpdes %in% c(1, 4, 5, 6, 96) ~ 0L,
      TRUE                          ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    Smoking = case_when(heska == 1 ~ 1L, heska == 2 ~ 0L,
                        TRUE ~ NA_integer_),

    Alcohol = case_when(scal7a == 1 ~ 1L, scal7a == 2 ~ 0L,
                        TRUE ~ NA_integer_),

    Physical_activity = case_when(
      heacta %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 1L,
      heacta == 4            ~ 0L,
      TRUE                   ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    Social_activity = case_when(
      scorg01 == 1 | scorg02 == 1 | scorg03 == 1 | scorg04 == 1 |
      scorg05 == 1 | scorg06 == 1 | scorg07 == 1 | scorg08 == 1 ~ 1L,
      scorg09 == 1 ~ 0L,
      scorg01 == 0 & scorg02 == 0 & scorg03 == 0 & scorg04 == 0 &
      scorg05 == 0 & scorg06 == 0 & scorg07 == 0 & scorg08 == 0 ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, year, birth_year, age_2008,
         Gender, Race, Education, Marital_status, Employment,
         Smoking, Alcohol, Physical_activity, Social_activity)


# ==========================================================================
# 2. Sensory variables
# W4 heoptca / heoptgl are binary 0/1 ("newly reported"); negatives are
# refusal/DK/not-applicable only (no "did not report" pseudo-codes).
# ==========================================================================
sensory_var_2008 <- elsa_core_w4 %>%
  transmute(
    idauniq,

    # --- Hearing (hehear: 1=excellent … 5=poor) ---
    hearing_loss = case_when(
      hehear %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 0L,
      hehear %in% c(4, 5)    ~ 1L,
      TRUE                   ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # --- Vision (heeye: 1=excellent … 5=poor, 6=registered/legally blind) ---
    vision_overall = case_when(
      heeye %in% c(1, 2, 3)    ~ 0L,
      heeye %in% c(4, 5, 6)    ~ 1L,
      TRUE                     ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # --- Cataract diagnosis (NEWLY reported at W4 — see warning above) ---
    cataract_diagnosis = case_when(
      heoptca == 1 ~ 1L,
      heoptca == 0 ~ 0L,
      TRUE         ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # --- Glaucoma diagnosis (NEWLY reported at W4 — see warning above) ---
    glaucoma_diagnosis = case_when(
      heoptgl == 1 ~ 1L,
      heoptgl == 0 ~ 0L,
      TRUE         ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # --- Cataract surgery (direct question hecat: 1=Yes, 2=No) ---
    cataract_surgery = case_when(
      hecat == 1 ~ 1L,
      hecat == 2 ~ 0L,
      TRUE       ~ NA_integer_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, hearing_loss, vision_overall,
                cataract_diagnosis, glaucoma_diagnosis,
                cataract_surgery)

# ==========================================================================
# 3. Dementia classification
# NOTE: From W4 onwards, hedibad / hedibde are "newly reported" per wave,
# NOT cumulative. A respondent diagnosed in W2 or W3 who is not re-asked
# (or doesn't re-report) this wave will have hedibad = 0. Therefore the
# wave-level `diagnosed_dementia` here is effectively *incidence-this-wave*,
# not prevalence-ever. For cumulative prevalence across W4+ you will need
# to carry forward across waves in the pooled long dataset at the end.
# ==========================================================================
elsa_cog_2008 <- elsa_core_w4 %>%
  transmute(
    idauniq,
    year = 2008L,
    diagnosed_dementia = case_when(
      hedibad == 1 | hedibde == 1 ~ 1L,
      hedibad == 0 | hedibde == 0 ~ 0L,
      TRUE                        ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    iqcode_b = if_else(heiqb %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqb), NA_real_),
    iqcode_c = if_else(heiqc %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqc), NA_real_),
    iqcode_d = if_else(heiqd %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqd), NA_real_),
    iqcode_e = if_else(heiqe %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqe), NA_real_),
    iqcode_f = if_else(heiqf %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqf), NA_real_),
    iqcode_g = if_else(heiqg %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqg), NA_real_),
    iqcode_h = if_else(heiqh %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqh), NA_real_),
    iqcode_i = if_else(heiqi %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqi), NA_real_),
    iqcode_j = if_else(heiqj %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqj), NA_real_),
    iqcode_k = if_else(heiqk %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqk), NA_real_),
    iqcode_l = if_else(heiql %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiql), NA_real_),
    iqcode_m = if_else(heiqm %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqm), NA_real_),
    iqcode_n = if_else(heiqn %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqn), NA_real_),
    iqcode_o = if_else(heiqo %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqo), NA_real_),
    iqcode_p = if_else(heiqp %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqp), NA_real_),
    iqcode_q = if_else(heiqq %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqq), NA_real_)
  )

iqcode_cols <- paste0("iqcode_", letters[2:17])
iqcode_mat  <- as.matrix(elsa_cog_2008[, iqcode_cols])

elsa_cog_2008 <- elsa_cog_2008 %>%
  mutate(
    iqcode_n_valid  = rowSums(!is.na(iqcode_mat)),
    iqcode_mean     = if_else(iqcode_n_valid >= 1L,
                              rowMeans(iqcode_mat, na.rm = TRUE),
                              NA_real_),
    iqcode_dementia = case_when(
      is.na(iqcode_mean) ~ NA_integer_,
      iqcode_mean >= 3.4 ~ 1L,
      iqcode_mean <  3.4 ~ 0L
    ),
    dementia = case_when(
      diagnosed_dementia == 1 | iqcode_dementia == 1 ~ 1L,
      diagnosed_dementia == 0 | iqcode_dementia == 0 ~ 0L,
      TRUE                                           ~ NA_integer_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, year, diagnosed_dementia, iqcode_mean, iqcode_n_valid,
         iqcode_dementia, dementia)


# Wave 4 (2008) Dementia Classification — observed counts
# -------------------------------------------------------
# Total participants in Wave 4: 11,050
# Total dementia cases:         157  (1.42% prevalence)
#   Physician diagnosis only : 69   (of which 64 had no IQCODE data)
#   IQCODE ≥ 3.4 only        : 36
#   Both sources             : 52
# Missing dementia status:     15   (hedibad & hedibde both Refusal/Don't Know;
#                                    no IQCODE data either)
#
# NOTE: from W4 onwards, hedibad/hedibde are "newly reported" per wave
# (binary 0/1), not cumulative — so `diagnosed_dementia` here reflects
# wave-specific incidence rather than ever-diagnosed. Cumulative status
# is recovered by pmax-ing across waves in the final long dataset.
#
# Physician diagnosis (hedibad + hedibde, codes 0/1):
#   Yes: 121   No: 10,914   Missing: 15
# IQCODE (16-item heiqb–heiqq):
#   140 respondents with ≥1 valid item
#   10,910 with no IQCODE data (no informant / proxy interview)
#   Mean 3.93  |  Median 3.88  |  IQR 3.13–4.81
#   ≥ 3.4 classification: Yes 88  No 52  NA 10,910
```

# Frailty Index (2008)
```{r}
# 4. Frailty Index (49 items)
# W4 specifics:
#   - mobility / ADL already binary 0/1 (like W3)
#   - headlte replaces headlph → rename to headlph for consistency
#   - headlho → rename to headlhg for consistency
#   - hehelf back to 1–5 Excellent scale (same as W2)
#   - diagnosed conditions: binary 0/1 per-wave (newly reported)
# ==========================================================================
recode_mob_adl_w4 <- function(x) {
  case_when(x == 1 ~ 1L, x == 0 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_)
}
recode_dx_w4 <- function(x) {
  case_when(x == 1 ~ 1L, x == 0 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_)
}

# Mobility (Items 1–10)
mobility_w4 <- elsa_core_w4 %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, hemobwa, hemobsi, hemobch, hemobcs, hemobcl,
         hemobst, hemobre, hemobpu, hemobli, hemobpi) %>%
  mutate(across(-idauniq, recode_mob_adl_w4))

# ADL/IADL (Items 11–23): headlte → headlph, headlho → headlhg
adl_iadl_w4 <- elsa_core_w4 %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, headldr, headlwa, headlba, headlea, headlbe, headlwc,
         headlma, headlpr, headlsh, headlte, headlme, headlho, headlmo) %>%
  rename(headlph = headlte,
         headlhg = headlho) %>%
  mutate(across(-idauniq, recode_mob_adl_w4))

# Diagnosed conditions (Items 24–36)
diagnoses_w4 <- elsa_core_w4 %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, hedimbp, hediman, hedimmi, hedimhf, hedimar,
         hedimdi, hedimst, hediblu, hedibas, hedibar, hedibos,
         hedibca, hedibps) %>%
  mutate(across(-idauniq, recode_dx_w4))

# CES-D (Items 37–44) — lowercase in W4
cesd_w4 <- elsa_core_w4 %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, psceda, pscedb, pscedc, pscedd,
         pscede, pscedf, pscedg, pscedh) %>%
  mutate(
    psceda = case_when(psceda == 1 ~ 1L, psceda == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    pscedb = case_when(pscedb == 1 ~ 1L, pscedb == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    pscedc = case_when(pscedc == 1 ~ 1L, pscedc == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    pscede = case_when(pscede == 1 ~ 1L, pscede == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    pscedg = case_when(pscedg == 1 ~ 1L, pscedg == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    pscedh = case_when(pscedh == 1 ~ 1L, pscedh == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    pscedd = case_when(pscedd == 2 ~ 1L, pscedd == 1 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    pscedf = case_when(pscedf == 2 ~ 1L, pscedf == 1 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_)
  )

# Other health (Items 45, 48–51) — W4 hehelf 1=Excellent … 5=Poor (like W2)
other_health_w4 <- elsa_core_w4 %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, hehelf, hefla, hefrac, heji, mmpain) %>%
  mutate(
    hehelf = case_when(hehelf %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 0L,
                       hehelf %in% c(4, 5)    ~ 1L,
                       TRUE                   ~ NA_integer_),
    hefla  = case_when(hefla  == 1 ~ 1L, hefla  == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    hefrac = case_when(hefrac == 1 ~ 1L, hefrac == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    heji   = case_when(heji   == 1 ~ 1L, heji   == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    mmpain = case_when(mmpain == 1 ~ 1L, mmpain == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, hehelf, hefla, hefrac, heji, mmpain)

# Merge & compute FI (vectorised)
fi_items <- c(
  "hemobwa", "hemobsi", "hemobch", "hemobcs", "hemobcl",
  "hemobst", "hemobre", "hemobpu", "hemobli", "hemobpi",
  "headldr", "headlwa", "headlba", "headlea", "headlbe", "headlwc",
  "headlma", "headlpr", "headlsh", "headlph", "headlme", "headlhg", "headlmo",
  "hedimbp", "hediman", "hedimmi", "hedimhf", "hedimar",
  "hedimdi", "hedimst", "hediblu", "hedibas", "hedibar", "hedibos", "hedibca", "hedibps",
  "psceda", "pscedb", "pscedc", "pscedd", "pscede", "pscedf", "pscedg", "pscedh",
  "hehelf", "hefla", "hefrac", "heji", "mmpain"
)
n_fi_items <- length(fi_items)
stopifnot(n_fi_items == 49)

# Strict (I)ADL items removed in the sensitivity FI
# (Re-declared so this chunk is self-contained; identical across waves.)
iadl_items <- c(
  # ADL (6)
  "headldr", "headlwa", "headlba", "headlea", "headlbe", "headlwc",
  # IADL (7) — phone, money, meals, shopping, meds, house/garden, map use
  "headlma", "headlpr", "headlsh", "headlph", "headlme", "headlhg", "headlmo"
)
fi_items_noIADL   <- setdiff(fi_items, iadl_items)
n_fi_items_noIADL <- length(fi_items_noIADL)
stopifnot(n_fi_items_noIADL == 36)

# Merge components (single source of recoded items feeds both FIs)
fi_merged_w4 <- mobility_w4 %>%
  left_join(adl_iadl_w4,     by = "idauniq") %>%
  left_join(diagnoses_w4,    by = "idauniq") %>%
  left_join(cesd_w4,         by = "idauniq") %>%
  left_join(other_health_w4, by = "idauniq")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# (a) ORIGINAL frailty index — 49 items
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
fi_mat_w4 <- as.matrix(fi_merged_w4[, fi_items])

elsa_fi_2008_orig <- fi_merged_w4 %>%
  mutate(
    year         = 2008L,
    fi_n_valid   = rowSums(!is.na(fi_mat_w4)),
    fi_n_deficit = rowSums(fi_mat_w4 == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    fi_score     = if_else(
      fi_n_valid >= ceiling(n_fi_items * 0.8),
      fi_n_deficit / fi_n_valid,
      NA_real_
    ),
    frailty = case_when(
      is.na(fi_score)  ~ NA_integer_,
      fi_score >= 0.25 ~ 1L,
      fi_score <  0.25 ~ 0L
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(fi_score)) %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, year, fi_n_valid, fi_n_deficit, fi_score, frailty)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# (b) MODIFIED frailty index — (I)ADL items removed (sensitivity)
#     Addresses possible mediation by (I)ADL deficits on the
#     sensory-impairment → dementia pathway. Same ≥0.25 threshold,
#     same ≥80% completeness rule applied to the reduced 36-item set
#     (>= 29 of 36).
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
fi_mat_w4_noIADL <- as.matrix(fi_merged_w4[, fi_items_noIADL])

elsa_fi_2008_noIADL <- fi_merged_w4 %>%
  mutate(
    fi_n_valid_noIADL   = rowSums(!is.na(fi_mat_w4_noIADL)),
    fi_n_deficit_noIADL = rowSums(fi_mat_w4_noIADL == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    fi_score_noIADL = if_else(
      fi_n_valid_noIADL >= ceiling(n_fi_items_noIADL * 0.8),
      fi_n_deficit_noIADL / fi_n_valid_noIADL,
      NA_real_
    ),
    frailty_noIADL = case_when(
      is.na(fi_score_noIADL)  ~ NA_integer_,
      fi_score_noIADL >= 0.25 ~ 1L,
      fi_score_noIADL <  0.25 ~ 0L
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(fi_score_noIADL)) %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, fi_n_valid_noIADL, fi_n_deficit_noIADL,
                fi_score_noIADL, frailty_noIADL)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Combine both FI versions into a single per-person table.
# Original `elsa_fi_2008` interface is preserved (idauniq, year,
# fi_n_valid, fi_n_deficit, fi_score, frailty); sensitivity columns
# (fi_score_noIADL, frailty_noIADL) are added alongside.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
elsa_fi_2008 <- elsa_fi_2008_orig %>%
  full_join(elsa_fi_2008_noIADL, by = "idauniq")

```




```{r}
# 5. Merge 2008 data
# ==========================================================================
elsa_2008 <- elsa_cov_2008 %>%
  left_join(sensory_var_2008, by = "idauniq") %>%
  left_join(elsa_cog_2008,    by = c("idauniq", "year")) %>%
  left_join(elsa_fi_2008,     by = c("idauniq", "year"))


# ==========================================================================
# 6. Multiple imputation (MICE) — ELSA wave 4 (2008)
# ==========================================================================
# Identical specification to waves 1-3 — see the design notes in the 2002
# block. Full convergence and observed-vs-imputed diagnostics are produced
# once, at wave 1, mirroring HRS_dataextract.Rmd.

analysis_covars08 <- c("age_2008", "Education", "Marital_status", "Employment",
                       "Smoking", "Alcohol", "Physical_activity", "Social_activity")

# ---- 6a. Imputation frame ----------------------------------------------
# birth_year is not a predictor (near-collinear with age); age is resolved
# deterministically where a birth year exists and pmm handles the residual
# cases. Wave 4 fieldwork spanned 2008-2009, so that value can be ±1 year.
imp08_elsa <- elsa_2008 %>%
  transmute(
    idauniq    = as.character(idauniq),
    age_2008   = coalesce(as.numeric(age_2008), 2008 - as.numeric(birth_year)),
    Gender     = factor(Gender, levels = c(1, 2)),
    Race       = factor(Race,   levels = c(0, 1)),
    Education  = ordered(Education, levels = c(0, 1, 2)),
    across(c(Marital_status, Employment, Smoking, Alcohol,
             Physical_activity, Social_activity),
           ~ factor(.x, levels = c(0, 1)))
  )

# Variables with no observed values (Education from W6 onward) cannot be
# imputed; drop them here and leave them untouched in the analysis data.
all_missing08 <- names(imp08_elsa)[colSums(!is.na(imp08_elsa)) == 0]
if (length(all_missing08) > 0) {
  message("ELSA 2008 — no observed values, excluded from imputation: ",
          paste(all_missing08, collapse = ", "))
  imp08_elsa <- imp08_elsa %>% dplyr::select(-all_of(all_missing08))
}
imputed_vars08 <- setdiff(analysis_covars08, all_missing08)

# ---- 6b. Quantify missingness (for the Methods text) -------------------
miss_pct08 <- sapply(imp08_elsa, function(x) mean(is.na(x)) * 100)
cat("ELSA 2008 — percentage missing per variable:\n")
print(round(miss_pct08, 2))

miss_cov08 <- miss_pct08[intersect(imputed_vars08, names(miss_pct08))]
miss_cov08 <- miss_cov08[miss_cov08 > 0]
if (length(miss_cov08) > 0) {
  cat(sprintf("\nMean missing across analysis covariates: %.2f%%\n",
              mean(miss_cov08)))
  cat(sprintf("Maximum missing: %.2f%% (%s)\n",
              max(miss_cov08), names(which.max(miss_cov08))))
} else {
  cat("\nNo missing values among analysis covariates.\n")
}

# ---- 6c. Imputation method per variable --------------------------------
meth08 <- make.method(imp08_elsa)
meth08["idauniq"]  <- ""
meth08["age_2008"] <- "pmm"
meth08[intersect("Education", names(imp08_elsa))] <- "polr"
meth08[intersect(c("Gender", "Race", "Marital_status", "Employment", "Smoking",
                   "Alcohol", "Physical_activity", "Social_activity"),
                 names(imp08_elsa))] <- "logreg"
# Variables with no missing values are not imputed (mice requirement).
meth08[colSums(is.na(imp08_elsa)) == 0] <- ""

# ---- 6d. Predictor matrix ---------------------------------------------
pred08 <- make.predictorMatrix(imp08_elsa)
pred08[, "idauniq"] <- 0
pred08["idauniq", ] <- 0

# GUARD: no incomplete variable may be used as a predictor without itself
# being imputed, otherwise NAs leak into every imputation model.
incomplete08 <- names(imp08_elsa)[colSums(is.na(imp08_elsa)) > 0]
stopifnot(all(meth08[incomplete08] != ""))

# ---- 6e. Run MICE: 20 imputed datasets, 10 iterations ------------------
set.seed(3)
imp_mice08_elsa <- mice(
  imp08_elsa,
  m               = 20,
  maxit           = 10,
  method          = meth08,
  predictorMatrix = pred08,
  printFlag       = TRUE
)

if (!is.null(imp_mice08_elsa$loggedEvents)) {
  cat("\nMICE logged events (ELSA 2008):\n")
  print(imp_mice08_elsa$loggedEvents)
}

# ---- 6f. Merge the completed covariates back ---------------------------
# Single completion (imputation 1), as in HRS. Only the analysis covariates
# are replaced; Gender, Race and the primary study variables keep their
# ORIGINAL values, including NAs.
imp08_elsa_complete1 <- complete(imp_mice08_elsa, 1)

elsa08_clean <- elsa_2008 %>%
  mutate(idauniq = as.character(idauniq)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-all_of(imputed_vars08)) %>%
  left_join(
    imp08_elsa_complete1 %>%
      mutate(idauniq = as.character(idauniq)) %>%
      dplyr::select(idauniq, all_of(imputed_vars08)),
    by = "idauniq"
  )

ELSA_2008 <- elsa08_clean

stopifnot(nrow(ELSA_2008) == nrow(elsa_2008))
```

# ELSA Wave 5 (2010)
```{r}
# W5 specifics:
#   - structurally identical to W4 (all lowercase, dimar 1–11 CP coding,
#     headlte/headlho, hehelf 1=Excellent…5=Poor,
#     binary newly-reported heoptca/heoptgl/hedibad/hedibde)
#   - w5edqual in core (same 1–7 coding)
# ==========================================================================
elsa_core_w5 <- read_dta(file.path(data_dir, "wave_5_elsa_data_v4.dta"))

# 1. Covariates -----------------------------------------------------------
elsa_cov_2010 <- elsa_core_w5 %>%
  transmute(
    idauniq,
    year       = 2010L,
    birth_year = if_else(indobyr > 0, as.numeric(indobyr), NA_real_),
    age_2010   = if_else(indager > 0, as.numeric(indager), NA_real_),

    Gender = case_when(indsex %in% c(1, 2) ~ as.integer(indsex),
                       TRUE                ~ NA_integer_),

    Race = case_when(fqethnr == 1 ~ 0L, fqethnr == 2 ~ 1L,
                     TRUE ~ NA_integer_),

    Education = case_when(
      is.na(w5edqual) | w5edqual < 0 ~ NA_integer_,
      w5edqual == 7                  ~ 0L,
      w5edqual %in% c(4, 5, 6)       ~ 1L,
      w5edqual %in% c(1, 2, 3)       ~ 2L,
      TRUE                           ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # dimar 1–11 (CP coding; unchanged since W3)
    Marital_status = case_when(
      dimar %in% c(2, 3, 4, 11)              ~ 1L,
      dimar %in% c(1, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10)     ~ 0L,
      TRUE                                   ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # wpdes: treat 85/86 (not codeable / irrelevant) as NA
    Employment = case_when(
      wpdes %in% c(2, 3)           ~ 1L,
      wpdes %in% c(1, 4, 5, 6, 96) ~ 0L,
      TRUE                          ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    Smoking = case_when(heska == 1 ~ 1L, heska == 2 ~ 0L,
                        TRUE ~ NA_integer_),

    Alcohol = case_when(scal7a == 1 ~ 1L, scal7a == 2 ~ 0L,
                        TRUE ~ NA_integer_),

    Physical_activity = case_when(
      heacta %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 1L,
      heacta == 4            ~ 0L,
      TRUE                   ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    Social_activity = case_when(
      scorg01 == 1 | scorg02 == 1 | scorg03 == 1 | scorg04 == 1 |
      scorg05 == 1 | scorg06 == 1 | scorg07 == 1 | scorg08 == 1 ~ 1L,
      scorg09 == 1 ~ 0L,
      scorg01 == 0 & scorg02 == 0 & scorg03 == 0 & scorg04 == 0 &
      scorg05 == 0 & scorg06 == 0 & scorg07 == 0 & scorg08 == 0 ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, year, birth_year, age_2010,
         Gender, Race, Education, Marital_status, Employment,
         Smoking, Alcohol, Physical_activity, Social_activity)


# 2. Sensory variables ----------------------------------------------------
sensory_var_2010 <- elsa_core_w5 %>%
  transmute(
    idauniq,

    # --- Hearing (hehear: 1=excellent … 5=poor) ---
    hearing_loss = case_when(
      hehear %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 0L,
      hehear %in% c(4, 5)    ~ 1L,
      TRUE                   ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # --- Vision (heeye: 1=excellent … 5=poor, 6=registered/legally blind) ---
    vision_overall = case_when(
      heeye %in% c(1, 2, 3)    ~ 0L,
      heeye %in% c(4, 5, 6)    ~ 1L,
      TRUE                     ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # --- Cataract diagnosis (NEWLY reported at W5 — see warning above) ---
    cataract_diagnosis = case_when(
      heoptca == 1 ~ 1L,
      heoptca == 0 ~ 0L,
      TRUE         ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # --- Glaucoma diagnosis (NEWLY reported at W5 — see warning above) ---
    glaucoma_diagnosis = case_when(
      heoptgl == 1 ~ 1L,
      heoptgl == 0 ~ 0L,
      TRUE         ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # --- Cataract surgery (direct question hecat: 1=Yes, 2=No) ---
    cataract_surgery = case_when(
      hecat == 1 ~ 1L,
      hecat == 2 ~ 0L,
      TRUE       ~ NA_integer_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, hearing_loss, vision_overall,
                cataract_diagnosis, glaucoma_diagnosis,
                cataract_surgery)


# 3. Dementia classification ----------------------------------------------
# NOTE: hedibad / hedibde are "newly reported" per wave (same as W4+).
elsa_cog_2010 <- elsa_core_w5 %>%
  transmute(
    idauniq,
    year = 2010L,
    diagnosed_dementia = case_when(
      hedibad == 1 | hedibde == 1 ~ 1L,
      hedibad == 0 | hedibde == 0 ~ 0L,
      TRUE                        ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    iqcode_b = if_else(heiqb %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqb), NA_real_),
    iqcode_c = if_else(heiqc %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqc), NA_real_),
    iqcode_d = if_else(heiqd %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqd), NA_real_),
    iqcode_e = if_else(heiqe %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqe), NA_real_),
    iqcode_f = if_else(heiqf %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqf), NA_real_),
    iqcode_g = if_else(heiqg %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqg), NA_real_),
    iqcode_h = if_else(heiqh %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqh), NA_real_),
    iqcode_i = if_else(heiqi %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqi), NA_real_),
    iqcode_j = if_else(heiqj %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqj), NA_real_),
    iqcode_k = if_else(heiqk %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqk), NA_real_),
    iqcode_l = if_else(heiql %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiql), NA_real_),
    iqcode_m = if_else(heiqm %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqm), NA_real_),
    iqcode_n = if_else(heiqn %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqn), NA_real_),
    iqcode_o = if_else(heiqo %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqo), NA_real_),
    iqcode_p = if_else(heiqp %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqp), NA_real_),
    iqcode_q = if_else(heiqq %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqq), NA_real_)
  )

iqcode_cols <- paste0("iqcode_", letters[2:17])
iqcode_mat  <- as.matrix(elsa_cog_2010[, iqcode_cols])

elsa_cog_2010 <- elsa_cog_2010 %>%
  mutate(
    iqcode_n_valid  = rowSums(!is.na(iqcode_mat)),
    iqcode_mean     = if_else(iqcode_n_valid >= 1L,
                              rowMeans(iqcode_mat, na.rm = TRUE),
                              NA_real_),
    iqcode_dementia = case_when(
      is.na(iqcode_mean) ~ NA_integer_,
      iqcode_mean >= 3.4 ~ 1L,
      iqcode_mean <  3.4 ~ 0L
    ),
    dementia = case_when(
      diagnosed_dementia == 1 | iqcode_dementia == 1 ~ 1L,
      diagnosed_dementia == 0 | iqcode_dementia == 0 ~ 0L,
      TRUE                                           ~ NA_integer_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, year, diagnosed_dementia, iqcode_mean, iqcode_n_valid,
         iqcode_dementia, dementia)


# Wave 5 (2010) Dementia Classification — observed counts
# -------------------------------------------------------
# Total participants in Wave 5: 10,274
# Total dementia cases:         166  (1.62% prevalence)
#   Physician diagnosis only : 81   (of which 74 had no IQCODE data)
#   IQCODE ≥ 3.4 only        : 29   (includes 1 case where physician Dx was refused/DK)
#   Both sources             : 56
# Missing dementia status:     14   (hedibad & hedibde both Refusal/Don't Know;
#                                    no IQCODE data either)
#
# NOTE: hedibad / hedibde are "newly reported" per wave (W4+ convention) —
# cumulative status across waves is recovered downstream in the long dataset.
#
# Physician diagnosis (hedibad + hedibde, codes 0/1):
#   Yes: 137   No: 10,122   Missing: 15 (1 of which rescued by IQCODE ≥ 3.4)
# IQCODE (16-item heiqb–heiqq):
#   129 respondents with ≥1 valid item
#   10,145 with no IQCODE data (no informant / proxy interview)
#   Mean 4.02  |  Median 4.13  |  IQR 3.20–4.88
#   ≥ 3.4 classification: Yes 85  No 44  NA 10,145
```

# Frailty Index 2010
```{r}
# 4. Frailty Index (49 items) -------------------------------------------
recode_mob_adl_w5 <- function(x) {
  case_when(x == 1 ~ 1L, x == 0 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_)
}
recode_dx_w5 <- function(x) {
  case_when(x == 1 ~ 1L, x == 0 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_)
}

# Mobility (Items 1–10)
mobility_w5 <- elsa_core_w5 %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, hemobwa, hemobsi, hemobch, hemobcs, hemobcl,
         hemobst, hemobre, hemobpu, hemobli, hemobpi) %>%
  mutate(across(-idauniq, recode_mob_adl_w5))

# ADL/IADL (Items 11–23): headlte → headlph, headlho → headlhg
adl_iadl_w5 <- elsa_core_w5 %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, headldr, headlwa, headlba, headlea, headlbe, headlwc,
         headlma, headlpr, headlsh, headlte, headlme, headlho, headlmo) %>%
  rename(headlph = headlte,
         headlhg = headlho) %>%
  mutate(across(-idauniq, recode_mob_adl_w5))

# Diagnosed conditions (Items 24–36)
diagnoses_w5 <- elsa_core_w5 %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, hedimbp, hediman, hedimmi, hedimhf, hedimar,
         hedimdi, hedimst, hediblu, hedibas, hedibar, hedibos,
         hedibca, hedibps) %>%
  mutate(across(-idauniq, recode_dx_w5))

# CES-D (Items 37–44)
cesd_w5 <- elsa_core_w5 %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, psceda, pscedb, pscedc, pscedd,
         pscede, pscedf, pscedg, pscedh) %>%
  mutate(
    psceda = case_when(psceda == 1 ~ 1L, psceda == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    pscedb = case_when(pscedb == 1 ~ 1L, pscedb == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    pscedc = case_when(pscedc == 1 ~ 1L, pscedc == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    pscede = case_when(pscede == 1 ~ 1L, pscede == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    pscedg = case_when(pscedg == 1 ~ 1L, pscedg == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    pscedh = case_when(pscedh == 1 ~ 1L, pscedh == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    pscedd = case_when(pscedd == 2 ~ 1L, pscedd == 1 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    pscedf = case_when(pscedf == 2 ~ 1L, pscedf == 1 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_)
  )

# Other health (Items 45, 48–51)
other_health_w5 <- elsa_core_w5 %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, hehelf, hefla, hefrac, heji, mmpain) %>%
  mutate(
    hehelf = case_when(hehelf %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 0L,
                       hehelf %in% c(4, 5)    ~ 1L,
                       TRUE                   ~ NA_integer_),
    hefla  = case_when(hefla  == 1 ~ 1L, hefla  == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    hefrac = case_when(hefrac == 1 ~ 1L, hefrac == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    heji   = case_when(heji   == 1 ~ 1L, heji   == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    mmpain = case_when(mmpain == 1 ~ 1L, mmpain == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, hehelf, hefla, hefrac, heji, mmpain)

# Merge & compute FI — vectorised
fi_items <- c(
  "hemobwa", "hemobsi", "hemobch", "hemobcs", "hemobcl",
  "hemobst", "hemobre", "hemobpu", "hemobli", "hemobpi",
  "headldr", "headlwa", "headlba", "headlea", "headlbe", "headlwc",
  "headlma", "headlpr", "headlsh", "headlph", "headlme", "headlhg", "headlmo",
  "hedimbp", "hediman", "hedimmi", "hedimhf", "hedimar",
  "hedimdi", "hedimst", "hediblu", "hedibas", "hedibar", "hedibos", "hedibca", "hedibps",
  "psceda", "pscedb", "pscedc", "pscedd", "pscede", "pscedf", "pscedg", "pscedh",
  "hehelf", "hefla", "hefrac", "heji", "mmpain"
)
n_fi_items <- length(fi_items)
stopifnot(n_fi_items == 49)

# Strict (I)ADL items removed in the sensitivity FI
# (Re-declared so this chunk is self-contained; identical across waves.)
iadl_items <- c(
  # ADL (6)
  "headldr", "headlwa", "headlba", "headlea", "headlbe", "headlwc",
  # IADL (7) — phone, money, meals, shopping, meds, house/garden, map use
  "headlma", "headlpr", "headlsh", "headlph", "headlme", "headlhg", "headlmo"
)
fi_items_noIADL   <- setdiff(fi_items, iadl_items)
n_fi_items_noIADL <- length(fi_items_noIADL)
stopifnot(n_fi_items_noIADL == 36)

# Merge components (single source of recoded items feeds both FIs)
fi_merged_w5 <- mobility_w5 %>%
  left_join(adl_iadl_w5,     by = "idauniq") %>%
  left_join(diagnoses_w5,    by = "idauniq") %>%
  left_join(cesd_w5,         by = "idauniq") %>%
  left_join(other_health_w5, by = "idauniq")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# (a) ORIGINAL frailty index — 49 items
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
fi_mat_w5 <- as.matrix(fi_merged_w5[, fi_items])

elsa_fi_2010_orig <- fi_merged_w5 %>%
  mutate(
    year         = 2010L,
    fi_n_valid   = rowSums(!is.na(fi_mat_w5)),
    fi_n_deficit = rowSums(fi_mat_w5 == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    fi_score     = if_else(
      fi_n_valid >= ceiling(n_fi_items * 0.8),
      fi_n_deficit / fi_n_valid,
      NA_real_
    ),
    frailty = case_when(
      is.na(fi_score)  ~ NA_integer_,
      fi_score >= 0.25 ~ 1L,
      fi_score <  0.25 ~ 0L
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(fi_score)) %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, year, fi_n_valid, fi_n_deficit, fi_score, frailty)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# (b) MODIFIED frailty index — (I)ADL items removed (sensitivity)
#     Addresses possible mediation by (I)ADL deficits on the
#     sensory-impairment → dementia pathway. Same ≥0.25 threshold,
#     same ≥80% completeness rule applied to the reduced 36-item set
#     (>= 29 of 36).
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
fi_mat_w5_noIADL <- as.matrix(fi_merged_w5[, fi_items_noIADL])

elsa_fi_2010_noIADL <- fi_merged_w5 %>%
  mutate(
    fi_n_valid_noIADL   = rowSums(!is.na(fi_mat_w5_noIADL)),
    fi_n_deficit_noIADL = rowSums(fi_mat_w5_noIADL == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    fi_score_noIADL = if_else(
      fi_n_valid_noIADL >= ceiling(n_fi_items_noIADL * 0.8),
      fi_n_deficit_noIADL / fi_n_valid_noIADL,
      NA_real_
    ),
    frailty_noIADL = case_when(
      is.na(fi_score_noIADL)  ~ NA_integer_,
      fi_score_noIADL >= 0.25 ~ 1L,
      fi_score_noIADL <  0.25 ~ 0L
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(fi_score_noIADL)) %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, fi_n_valid_noIADL, fi_n_deficit_noIADL,
                fi_score_noIADL, frailty_noIADL)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Combine both FI versions into a single per-person table.
# Original `elsa_fi_2010` interface is preserved (idauniq, year,
# fi_n_valid, fi_n_deficit, fi_score, frailty); sensitivity columns
# (fi_score_noIADL, frailty_noIADL) are added alongside.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
elsa_fi_2010 <- elsa_fi_2010_orig %>%
  full_join(elsa_fi_2010_noIADL, by = "idauniq")
```

# Merge 2010 data
```{r}
# 5. Merge 2010 data ----------------------------------------------------
elsa_2010 <- elsa_cov_2010 %>%
  left_join(sensory_var_2010, by = "idauniq") %>%
  left_join(elsa_cog_2010,    by = c("idauniq", "year")) %>%
  left_join(elsa_fi_2010,     by = c("idauniq", "year"))


# ==========================================================================
# 6. Multiple imputation (MICE) — ELSA wave 5 (2010)
# ==========================================================================
# Identical specification to waves 1-4 — see the design notes in the 2002
# block. Full convergence and observed-vs-imputed diagnostics are produced
# once, at wave 1, mirroring HRS_dataextract.Rmd.

analysis_covars10 <- c("age_2010", "Education", "Marital_status", "Employment",
                       "Smoking", "Alcohol", "Physical_activity", "Social_activity")

# ---- 6a. Imputation frame ----------------------------------------------
# birth_year is not a predictor (near-collinear with age); age is resolved
# deterministically where a birth year exists and pmm handles the residual
# cases. Wave 5 fieldwork spanned 2010-2011, so that value can be ±1 year.
imp10_elsa <- elsa_2010 %>%
  transmute(
    idauniq    = as.character(idauniq),
    age_2010   = coalesce(as.numeric(age_2010), 2010 - as.numeric(birth_year)),
    Gender     = factor(Gender, levels = c(1, 2)),
    Race       = factor(Race,   levels = c(0, 1)),
    Education  = ordered(Education, levels = c(0, 1, 2)),
    across(c(Marital_status, Employment, Smoking, Alcohol,
             Physical_activity, Social_activity),
           ~ factor(.x, levels = c(0, 1)))
  )

# Variables with no observed values (Education from W6 onward) cannot be
# imputed; drop them here and leave them untouched in the analysis data.
all_missing10 <- names(imp10_elsa)[colSums(!is.na(imp10_elsa)) == 0]
if (length(all_missing10) > 0) {
  message("ELSA 2010 — no observed values, excluded from imputation: ",
          paste(all_missing10, collapse = ", "))
  imp10_elsa <- imp10_elsa %>% dplyr::select(-all_of(all_missing10))
}
imputed_vars10 <- setdiff(analysis_covars10, all_missing10)

# ---- 6b. Quantify missingness (for the Methods text) -------------------
miss_pct10 <- sapply(imp10_elsa, function(x) mean(is.na(x)) * 100)
cat("ELSA 2010 — percentage missing per variable:\n")
print(round(miss_pct10, 2))

miss_cov10 <- miss_pct10[intersect(imputed_vars10, names(miss_pct10))]
miss_cov10 <- miss_cov10[miss_cov10 > 0]
if (length(miss_cov10) > 0) {
  cat(sprintf("\nMean missing across analysis covariates: %.2f%%\n",
              mean(miss_cov10)))
  cat(sprintf("Maximum missing: %.2f%% (%s)\n",
              max(miss_cov10), names(which.max(miss_cov10))))
} else {
  cat("\nNo missing values among analysis covariates.\n")
}

# ---- 6c. Imputation method per variable --------------------------------
meth10 <- make.method(imp10_elsa)
meth10["idauniq"]  <- ""
meth10["age_2010"] <- "pmm"
meth10[intersect("Education", names(imp10_elsa))] <- "polr"
meth10[intersect(c("Gender", "Race", "Marital_status", "Employment", "Smoking",
                   "Alcohol", "Physical_activity", "Social_activity"),
                 names(imp10_elsa))] <- "logreg"
# Variables with no missing values are not imputed (mice requirement).
meth10[colSums(is.na(imp10_elsa)) == 0] <- ""

# ---- 6d. Predictor matrix ---------------------------------------------
pred10 <- make.predictorMatrix(imp10_elsa)
pred10[, "idauniq"] <- 0
pred10["idauniq", ] <- 0

# GUARD: no incomplete variable may be used as a predictor without itself
# being imputed, otherwise NAs leak into every imputation model.
incomplete10 <- names(imp10_elsa)[colSums(is.na(imp10_elsa)) > 0]
stopifnot(all(meth10[incomplete10] != ""))

# ---- 6e. Run MICE: 20 imputed datasets, 10 iterations ------------------
set.seed(3)
imp_mice10_elsa <- mice(
  imp10_elsa,
  m               = 20,
  maxit           = 10,
  method          = meth10,
  predictorMatrix = pred10,
  printFlag       = TRUE
)

if (!is.null(imp_mice10_elsa$loggedEvents)) {
  cat("\nMICE logged events (ELSA 2010):\n")
  print(imp_mice10_elsa$loggedEvents)
}

# ---- 6f. Merge the completed covariates back ---------------------------
# Single completion (imputation 1), as in HRS. Only the analysis covariates
# are replaced; Gender, Race and the primary study variables keep their
# ORIGINAL values, including NAs.
imp10_elsa_complete1 <- complete(imp_mice10_elsa, 1)

elsa10_clean <- elsa_2010 %>%
  mutate(idauniq = as.character(idauniq)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-all_of(imputed_vars10)) %>%
  left_join(
    imp10_elsa_complete1 %>%
      mutate(idauniq = as.character(idauniq)) %>%
      dplyr::select(idauniq, all_of(imputed_vars10)),
    by = "idauniq"
  )

ELSA_2010 <- elsa10_clean

stopifnot(nrow(ELSA_2010) == nrow(elsa_2010))
```

# ELSA Wave 6 (2012)
```{r}
# W6 specifics:
#   - mixed-case variable names (DiMar, Hehelf, HeEye, HeHear, HESka,
#     HeActa, WpDes, Fqethnr, Indobyr, Heiqb–q, PScedA–H, HeFla, HeFrac,
#     HeJi, MmPain)
#   - lowercase: indager, indsex, heoptca, heoptgl, hedibad, hedibde,
#     hedim*, hedib*, hemob*, headl*, scal7a, scorg01–09
#   - NO education variable in core (w6edqual does not exist)
#   - headlph back (W4/W5 used headlte)
#   - Hehelf 1=Excellent … 5=Poor (like W2/W4/W5)
#   - heoptca/heoptgl/hedibad/hedibde: binary 0/1 "newly reported"
# ==========================================================================
elsa_core_w6 <- read_dta(file.path(data_dir, "wave_6_elsa_data_v2.dta"))

# 1. Covariates -----------------------------------------------------------
elsa_cov_2012 <- elsa_core_w6 %>%
  transmute(
    idauniq,
    year       = 2012L,
    birth_year = if_else(Indobyr > 0, as.numeric(Indobyr), NA_real_),
    age_2012   = if_else(indager > 0, as.numeric(indager), NA_real_),

    Gender = case_when(indsex %in% c(1, 2) ~ as.integer(indsex),
                       TRUE                ~ NA_integer_),

    Race = case_when(Fqethnr == 1 ~ 0L, Fqethnr == 2 ~ 1L,
                     TRUE ~ NA_integer_),

    # W6 core has no education variable — kept NA; can be back-filled from
    # earlier waves (w1–w5 edqual) at the pooled/long-data stage.
    Education = NA_integer_,

    # DiMar 1–11 (CP coding; unchanged since W3)
    Marital_status = case_when(
      DiMar %in% c(2, 3, 4, 11)              ~ 1L,
      DiMar %in% c(1, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10)     ~ 0L,
      TRUE                                   ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # WpDes: treat 85/86 (not codeable / irrelevant) as NA
    Employment = case_when(
      WpDes %in% c(2, 3)           ~ 1L,
      WpDes %in% c(1, 4, 5, 6, 96) ~ 0L,
      TRUE                          ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    Smoking = case_when(HESka == 1 ~ 1L, HESka == 2 ~ 0L,
                        TRUE ~ NA_integer_),

    Alcohol = case_when(scal7a == 1 ~ 1L, scal7a == 2 ~ 0L,
                        TRUE ~ NA_integer_),

    Physical_activity = case_when(
      HeActa %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 1L,
      HeActa == 4            ~ 0L,
      TRUE                   ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    Social_activity = case_when(
      scorg01 == 1 | scorg02 == 1 | scorg03 == 1 | scorg04 == 1 |
      scorg05 == 1 | scorg06 == 1 | scorg07 == 1 | scorg08 == 1 ~ 1L,
      scorg09 == 1 ~ 0L,
      scorg01 == 0 & scorg02 == 0 & scorg03 == 0 & scorg04 == 0 &
      scorg05 == 0 & scorg06 == 0 & scorg07 == 0 & scorg08 == 0 ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, year, birth_year, age_2012,
         Gender, Race, Education, Marital_status, Employment,
         Smoking, Alcohol, Physical_activity, Social_activity)


# 2. Sensory variables ----------------------------------------------------
sensory_var_2012 <- elsa_core_w6 %>%
  transmute(
    idauniq,

    # --- Hearing (HeHear: 1=excellent … 5=poor) ---
    hearing_loss = case_when(
      HeHear %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 0L,
      HeHear %in% c(4, 5)    ~ 1L,
      TRUE                   ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # --- Vision (HeEye: 1=excellent … 5=poor, 6=registered/legally blind) ---
    vision_overall = case_when(
      HeEye %in% c(1, 2, 3)    ~ 0L,
      HeEye %in% c(4, 5, 6)    ~ 1L,
      TRUE                     ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # --- Cataract diagnosis (NEWLY reported at W6 — see warning above) ---
    cataract_diagnosis = case_when(
      heoptca == 1 ~ 1L,
      heoptca == 0 ~ 0L,
      TRUE         ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # --- Glaucoma diagnosis (NEWLY reported at W6 — see warning above) ---
    glaucoma_diagnosis = case_when(
      heoptgl == 1 ~ 1L,
      heoptgl == 0 ~ 0L,
      TRUE         ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # --- Cataract surgery (direct question HeCat: 1=Yes, 2=No) ---
    cataract_surgery = case_when(
      HeCat == 1 ~ 1L,
      HeCat == 2 ~ 0L,
      TRUE       ~ NA_integer_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, hearing_loss, vision_overall,
                cataract_diagnosis, glaucoma_diagnosis,
                cataract_surgery)


# 3. Dementia classification ----------------------------------------------
# NOTE: hedibad / hedibde are "newly reported" per wave (W4+ convention)
elsa_cog_2012 <- elsa_core_w6 %>%
  transmute(
    idauniq,
    year = 2012L,
    diagnosed_dementia = case_when(
      hedibad == 1 | hedibde == 1 ~ 1L,
      hedibad == 0 | hedibde == 0 ~ 0L,
      TRUE                        ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    iqcode_b = if_else(Heiqb %in% 1:5, as.numeric(Heiqb), NA_real_),
    iqcode_c = if_else(Heiqc %in% 1:5, as.numeric(Heiqc), NA_real_),
    iqcode_d = if_else(Heiqd %in% 1:5, as.numeric(Heiqd), NA_real_),
    iqcode_e = if_else(Heiqe %in% 1:5, as.numeric(Heiqe), NA_real_),
    iqcode_f = if_else(Heiqf %in% 1:5, as.numeric(Heiqf), NA_real_),
    iqcode_g = if_else(Heiqg %in% 1:5, as.numeric(Heiqg), NA_real_),
    iqcode_h = if_else(Heiqh %in% 1:5, as.numeric(Heiqh), NA_real_),
    iqcode_i = if_else(Heiqi %in% 1:5, as.numeric(Heiqi), NA_real_),
    iqcode_j = if_else(Heiqj %in% 1:5, as.numeric(Heiqj), NA_real_),
    iqcode_k = if_else(Heiqk %in% 1:5, as.numeric(Heiqk), NA_real_),
    iqcode_l = if_else(Heiql %in% 1:5, as.numeric(Heiql), NA_real_),
    iqcode_m = if_else(Heiqm %in% 1:5, as.numeric(Heiqm), NA_real_),
    iqcode_n = if_else(Heiqn %in% 1:5, as.numeric(Heiqn), NA_real_),
    iqcode_o = if_else(Heiqo %in% 1:5, as.numeric(Heiqo), NA_real_),
    iqcode_p = if_else(Heiqp %in% 1:5, as.numeric(Heiqp), NA_real_),
    iqcode_q = if_else(Heiqq %in% 1:5, as.numeric(Heiqq), NA_real_)
  )

iqcode_cols <- paste0("iqcode_", letters[2:17])
iqcode_mat  <- as.matrix(elsa_cog_2012[, iqcode_cols])

elsa_cog_2012 <- elsa_cog_2012 %>%
  mutate(
    iqcode_n_valid  = rowSums(!is.na(iqcode_mat)),
    iqcode_mean     = if_else(iqcode_n_valid >= 1L,
                              rowMeans(iqcode_mat, na.rm = TRUE),
                              NA_real_),
    iqcode_dementia = case_when(
      is.na(iqcode_mean) ~ NA_integer_,
      iqcode_mean >= 3.4 ~ 1L,
      iqcode_mean <  3.4 ~ 0L
    ),
    dementia = case_when(
      diagnosed_dementia == 1 | iqcode_dementia == 1 ~ 1L,
      diagnosed_dementia == 0 | iqcode_dementia == 0 ~ 0L,
      TRUE                                           ~ NA_integer_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, year, diagnosed_dementia, iqcode_mean, iqcode_n_valid,
         iqcode_dementia, dementia)

#   ≥ 3.4 classification: Yes 87  No 120  NA 10,394
```

# Frailty Index 2012
```{r}
# 4. Frailty Index (49 items) --------------------------------------------
recode_mob_adl_w6 <- function(x) {
  case_when(x == 1 ~ 1L, x == 0 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_)
}
recode_dx_w6 <- function(x) {
  case_when(x == 1 ~ 1L, x == 0 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_)
}

# Mobility (Items 1–10)
mobility_w6 <- elsa_core_w6 %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, hemobwa, hemobsi, hemobch, hemobcs, hemobcl,
         hemobst, hemobre, hemobpu, hemobli, hemobpi) %>%
  mutate(across(-idauniq, recode_mob_adl_w6))

# ADL/IADL (Items 11–23): headlph is back; headlho → headlhg
adl_iadl_w6 <- elsa_core_w6 %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, headldr, headlwa, headlba, headlea, headlbe, headlwc,
         headlma, headlpr, headlsh, headlph, headlme, headlho, headlmo) %>%
  rename(headlhg = headlho) %>%
  mutate(across(-idauniq, recode_mob_adl_w6))

# Diagnosed conditions (Items 24–36)
diagnoses_w6 <- elsa_core_w6 %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, hedimbp, hediman, hedimmi, hedimhf, hedimar,
         hedimdi, hedimst, hediblu, hedibas, hedibar, hedibos,
         hedibca, hedibps) %>%
  mutate(across(-idauniq, recode_dx_w6))

# CES-D (Items 37–44) — mixed-case PScedA-H
cesd_w6 <- elsa_core_w6 %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, PScedA, PScedB, PScedC, PScedD,
         PScedE, PScedF, PScedG, PScedH) %>%
  mutate(
    psceda = case_when(PScedA == 1 ~ 1L, PScedA == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    pscedb = case_when(PScedB == 1 ~ 1L, PScedB == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    pscedc = case_when(PScedC == 1 ~ 1L, PScedC == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    pscede = case_when(PScedE == 1 ~ 1L, PScedE == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    pscedg = case_when(PScedG == 1 ~ 1L, PScedG == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    pscedh = case_when(PScedH == 1 ~ 1L, PScedH == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    pscedd = case_when(PScedD == 2 ~ 1L, PScedD == 1 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    pscedf = case_when(PScedF == 2 ~ 1L, PScedF == 1 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, psceda, pscedb, pscedc, pscedd, pscede, pscedf, pscedg, pscedh) 

# Other health (Items 45, 48–51) — mixed-case
other_health_w6 <- elsa_core_w6 %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, Hehelf, HeFla, HeFrac, HeJi, MmPain) %>%
  mutate(
    hehelf = case_when(Hehelf %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 0L,
                       Hehelf %in% c(4, 5)    ~ 1L,
                       TRUE                   ~ NA_integer_),
    hefla  = case_when(HeFla  == 1 ~ 1L, HeFla  == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    hefrac = case_when(HeFrac == 1 ~ 1L, HeFrac == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    heji   = case_when(HeJi   == 1 ~ 1L, HeJi   == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    mmpain = case_when(MmPain == 1 ~ 1L, MmPain == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, hehelf, hefla, hefrac, heji, mmpain)

# Merge & compute FI — vectorised
fi_items <- c(
  "hemobwa", "hemobsi", "hemobch", "hemobcs", "hemobcl",
  "hemobst", "hemobre", "hemobpu", "hemobli", "hemobpi",
  "headldr", "headlwa", "headlba", "headlea", "headlbe", "headlwc",
  "headlma", "headlpr", "headlsh", "headlph", "headlme", "headlhg", "headlmo",
  "hedimbp", "hediman", "hedimmi", "hedimhf", "hedimar",
  "hedimdi", "hedimst", "hediblu", "hedibas", "hedibar", "hedibos", "hedibca", "hedibps",
  "psceda", "pscedb", "pscedc", "pscedd", "pscede", "pscedf", "pscedg", "pscedh",
  "hehelf", "hefla", "hefrac", "heji", "mmpain"
)
n_fi_items <- length(fi_items)
stopifnot(n_fi_items == 49)

# Strict (I)ADL items removed in the sensitivity FI
# (Re-declared so this chunk is self-contained; identical across waves.)
iadl_items <- c(
  # ADL (6)
  "headldr", "headlwa", "headlba", "headlea", "headlbe", "headlwc",
  # IADL (7) — phone, money, meals, shopping, meds, house/garden, map use
  "headlma", "headlpr", "headlsh", "headlph", "headlme", "headlhg", "headlmo"
)
fi_items_noIADL   <- setdiff(fi_items, iadl_items)
n_fi_items_noIADL <- length(fi_items_noIADL)
stopifnot(n_fi_items_noIADL == 36)

# Merge components (single source of recoded items feeds both FIs)
fi_merged_w6 <- mobility_w6 %>%
  left_join(adl_iadl_w6,     by = "idauniq") %>%
  left_join(diagnoses_w6,    by = "idauniq") %>%
  left_join(cesd_w6,         by = "idauniq") %>%
  left_join(other_health_w6, by = "idauniq")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# (a) ORIGINAL frailty index — 49 items
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
fi_mat_w6 <- as.matrix(fi_merged_w6[, fi_items])

elsa_fi_2012_orig <- fi_merged_w6 %>%
  mutate(
    year         = 2012L,
    fi_n_valid   = rowSums(!is.na(fi_mat_w6)),
    fi_n_deficit = rowSums(fi_mat_w6 == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    fi_score     = if_else(
      fi_n_valid >= ceiling(n_fi_items * 0.8),
      fi_n_deficit / fi_n_valid,
      NA_real_
    ),
    frailty = case_when(
      is.na(fi_score)  ~ NA_integer_,
      fi_score >= 0.25 ~ 1L,
      fi_score <  0.25 ~ 0L
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(fi_score)) %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, year, fi_n_valid, fi_n_deficit, fi_score, frailty)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# (b) MODIFIED frailty index — (I)ADL items removed (sensitivity)
#     Addresses possible mediation by (I)ADL deficits on the
#     sensory-impairment → dementia pathway. Same ≥0.25 threshold,
#     same ≥80% completeness rule applied to the reduced 36-item set
#     (>= 29 of 36).
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
fi_mat_w6_noIADL <- as.matrix(fi_merged_w6[, fi_items_noIADL])

elsa_fi_2012_noIADL <- fi_merged_w6 %>%
  mutate(
    fi_n_valid_noIADL   = rowSums(!is.na(fi_mat_w6_noIADL)),
    fi_n_deficit_noIADL = rowSums(fi_mat_w6_noIADL == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    fi_score_noIADL = if_else(
      fi_n_valid_noIADL >= ceiling(n_fi_items_noIADL * 0.8),
      fi_n_deficit_noIADL / fi_n_valid_noIADL,
      NA_real_
    ),
    frailty_noIADL = case_when(
      is.na(fi_score_noIADL)  ~ NA_integer_,
      fi_score_noIADL >= 0.25 ~ 1L,
      fi_score_noIADL <  0.25 ~ 0L
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(fi_score_noIADL)) %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, fi_n_valid_noIADL, fi_n_deficit_noIADL,
                fi_score_noIADL, frailty_noIADL)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Combine both FI versions into a single per-person table.
# Original `elsa_fi_2012` interface is preserved (idauniq, year,
# fi_n_valid, fi_n_deficit, fi_score, frailty); sensitivity columns
# (fi_score_noIADL, frailty_noIADL) are added alongside.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
elsa_fi_2012 <- elsa_fi_2012_orig %>%
  full_join(elsa_fi_2012_noIADL, by = "idauniq")

```




```{r}
# 5. Merge 2012 data -----------------------------------------------------
elsa_2012 <- elsa_cov_2012 %>%
  left_join(sensory_var_2012, by = "idauniq") %>%
  left_join(elsa_cog_2012,    by = c("idauniq", "year")) %>%
  left_join(elsa_fi_2012,     by = c("idauniq", "year"))


# ==========================================================================
# 6. Multiple imputation (MICE) — ELSA wave 6 (2012)
# ==========================================================================
# Identical specification to waves 1-5 — see the design notes in the 2002
# block. From W6 Education is an all-NA placeholder (ELSA fielded no
# qualification item), so it is detected and excluded automatically below,
# and is back-filled from W1-W5 at the pooled stage instead.

analysis_covars12 <- c("age_2012", "Education", "Marital_status", "Employment",
                       "Smoking", "Alcohol", "Physical_activity", "Social_activity")

# ---- 6a. Imputation frame ----------------------------------------------
# birth_year is not a predictor (near-collinear with age); age is resolved
# deterministically where a birth year exists and pmm handles the residual
# cases. Wave 6 fieldwork spanned 2012-2013, so that value can be ±1 year.
imp12_elsa <- elsa_2012 %>%
  transmute(
    idauniq    = as.character(idauniq),
    age_2012   = coalesce(as.numeric(age_2012), 2012 - as.numeric(birth_year)),
    Gender     = factor(Gender, levels = c(1, 2)),
    Race       = factor(Race,   levels = c(0, 1)),
    Education  = ordered(Education, levels = c(0, 1, 2)),
    across(c(Marital_status, Employment, Smoking, Alcohol,
             Physical_activity, Social_activity),
           ~ factor(.x, levels = c(0, 1)))
  )

# Variables with no observed values (Education from W6 onward) cannot be
# imputed; drop them here and leave them untouched in the analysis data.
all_missing12 <- names(imp12_elsa)[colSums(!is.na(imp12_elsa)) == 0]
if (length(all_missing12) > 0) {
  message("ELSA 2012 — no observed values, excluded from imputation: ",
          paste(all_missing12, collapse = ", "))
  imp12_elsa <- imp12_elsa %>% dplyr::select(-all_of(all_missing12))
}
imputed_vars12 <- setdiff(analysis_covars12, all_missing12)

# ---- 6b. Quantify missingness (for the Methods text) -------------------
miss_pct12 <- sapply(imp12_elsa, function(x) mean(is.na(x)) * 100)
cat("ELSA 2012 — percentage missing per variable:\n")
print(round(miss_pct12, 2))

miss_cov12 <- miss_pct12[intersect(imputed_vars12, names(miss_pct12))]
miss_cov12 <- miss_cov12[miss_cov12 > 0]
if (length(miss_cov12) > 0) {
  cat(sprintf("\nMean missing across analysis covariates: %.2f%%\n",
              mean(miss_cov12)))
  cat(sprintf("Maximum missing: %.2f%% (%s)\n",
              max(miss_cov12), names(which.max(miss_cov12))))
} else {
  cat("\nNo missing values among analysis covariates.\n")
}

# ---- 6c. Imputation method per variable --------------------------------
meth12 <- make.method(imp12_elsa)
meth12["idauniq"]  <- ""
meth12["age_2012"] <- "pmm"
meth12[intersect("Education", names(imp12_elsa))] <- "polr"
meth12[intersect(c("Gender", "Race", "Marital_status", "Employment", "Smoking",
                   "Alcohol", "Physical_activity", "Social_activity"),
                 names(imp12_elsa))] <- "logreg"
# Variables with no missing values are not imputed (mice requirement).
meth12[colSums(is.na(imp12_elsa)) == 0] <- ""

# ---- 6d. Predictor matrix ---------------------------------------------
pred12 <- make.predictorMatrix(imp12_elsa)
pred12[, "idauniq"] <- 0
pred12["idauniq", ] <- 0

# GUARD: no incomplete variable may be used as a predictor without itself
# being imputed, otherwise NAs leak into every imputation model.
incomplete12 <- names(imp12_elsa)[colSums(is.na(imp12_elsa)) > 0]
stopifnot(all(meth12[incomplete12] != ""))

# ---- 6e. Run MICE: 20 imputed datasets, 10 iterations ------------------
set.seed(3)
imp_mice12_elsa <- mice(
  imp12_elsa,
  m               = 20,
  maxit           = 10,
  method          = meth12,
  predictorMatrix = pred12,
  printFlag       = TRUE
)

if (!is.null(imp_mice12_elsa$loggedEvents)) {
  cat("\nMICE logged events (ELSA 2012):\n")
  print(imp_mice12_elsa$loggedEvents)
}

# ---- 6f. Merge the completed covariates back ---------------------------
# Single completion (imputation 1), as in HRS. Only the analysis covariates
# are replaced; Gender, Race and the primary study variables keep their
# ORIGINAL values, including NAs.
imp12_elsa_complete1 <- complete(imp_mice12_elsa, 1)

elsa12_clean <- elsa_2012 %>%
  mutate(idauniq = as.character(idauniq)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-all_of(imputed_vars12)) %>%
  left_join(
    imp12_elsa_complete1 %>%
      mutate(idauniq = as.character(idauniq)) %>%
      dplyr::select(idauniq, all_of(imputed_vars12)),
    by = "idauniq"
  )

ELSA_2012 <- elsa12_clean

stopifnot(nrow(ELSA_2012) == nrow(elsa_2012))
```

# ELSA Wave 7 (2014)
```{r}
# W7 specifics: structurally identical to W6 —
#   mixed-case core vars, no education, headlph back, Hehelf 1=Excellent,
#   binary 0/1 "newly reported" for heoptca/heoptgl/hedibad/hedibde.
# ==========================================================================
elsa_core_w7 <- read_dta(file.path(data_dir, "wave_7_elsa_data.dta"))

# 1. Covariates ------------------------------------------------------------
elsa_cov_2014 <- elsa_core_w7 %>%
  transmute(
    idauniq,
    year       = 2014L,
    birth_year = if_else(Indobyr > 0, as.numeric(Indobyr), NA_real_),
    age_2014   = if_else(indager > 0, as.numeric(indager), NA_real_),

    Gender = case_when(indsex %in% c(1, 2) ~ as.integer(indsex),
                       TRUE                ~ NA_integer_),

    Race = case_when(Fqethnr == 1 ~ 0L, Fqethnr == 2 ~ 1L,
                     TRUE ~ NA_integer_),

    # No education variable in W7 (same as W6) — can be back-filled from
    # W1–W5 edqual in the pooled long dataset later.
    Education = NA_integer_,

    # DiMar 1–11 (CP coding; unchanged since W3)
    Marital_status = case_when(
      DiMar %in% c(2, 3, 4, 11)              ~ 1L,
      DiMar %in% c(1, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10)     ~ 0L,
      TRUE                                   ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # WpDes: 85/86 (not codeable / irrelevant) → NA
    Employment = case_when(
      WpDes %in% c(2, 3)           ~ 1L,
      WpDes %in% c(1, 4, 5, 6, 96) ~ 0L,
      TRUE                          ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    Smoking = case_when(HESka == 1 ~ 1L, HESka == 2 ~ 0L,
                        TRUE ~ NA_integer_),

    Alcohol = case_when(scal7a == 1 ~ 1L, scal7a == 2 ~ 0L,
                        TRUE ~ NA_integer_),

    Physical_activity = case_when(
      HeActa %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 1L,
      HeActa == 4            ~ 0L,
      TRUE                   ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    Social_activity = case_when(
      scorg01 == 1 | scorg02 == 1 | scorg03 == 1 | scorg04 == 1 |
      scorg05 == 1 | scorg06 == 1 | scorg07 == 1 | scorg08 == 1 ~ 1L,
      scorg09 == 1 ~ 0L,
      scorg01 == 0 & scorg02 == 0 & scorg03 == 0 & scorg04 == 0 &
      scorg05 == 0 & scorg06 == 0 & scorg07 == 0 & scorg08 == 0 ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, year, birth_year, age_2014,
         Gender, Race, Education, Marital_status, Employment,
         Smoking, Alcohol, Physical_activity, Social_activity)


# 2. Sensory variables ----------------------------------------------------
sensory_var_2014 <- elsa_core_w7 %>%
  transmute(
    idauniq,

    # --- Hearing (HeHear: 1=excellent … 5=poor) ---
    hearing_loss = case_when(
      HeHear %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 0L,
      HeHear %in% c(4, 5)    ~ 1L,
      TRUE                   ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # --- Vision (HeEye: 1=excellent … 5=poor, 6=registered/legally blind) ---
    vision_overall = case_when(
      HeEye %in% c(1, 2, 3)    ~ 0L,
      HeEye %in% c(4, 5, 6)    ~ 1L,
      TRUE                     ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # --- Cataract diagnosis (NEWLY reported at W7 — see warning above) ---
    cataract_diagnosis = case_when(
      heoptca == 1 ~ 1L,
      heoptca == 0 ~ 0L,
      TRUE         ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # --- Glaucoma diagnosis (NEWLY reported at W7 — see warning above) ---
    glaucoma_diagnosis = case_when(
      heoptgl == 1 ~ 1L,
      heoptgl == 0 ~ 0L,
      TRUE         ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # --- Cataract surgery (direct question HeCat: 1=Yes, 2=No) ---
    cataract_surgery = case_when(
      HeCat == 1 ~ 1L,
      HeCat == 2 ~ 0L,
      TRUE       ~ NA_integer_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, hearing_loss, vision_overall,
                cataract_diagnosis, glaucoma_diagnosis,
                cataract_surgery)


# 3. Dementia classification ---------------------------------------------
# NOTE: hedibad / hedibde are "newly reported" per wave (W4+).
elsa_cog_2014 <- elsa_core_w7 %>%
  transmute(
    idauniq,
    year = 2014L,
    diagnosed_dementia = case_when(
      hedibad == 1 | hedibde == 1 ~ 1L,
      hedibad == 0 | hedibde == 0 ~ 0L,
      TRUE                        ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    iqcode_b = if_else(Heiqb %in% 1:5, as.numeric(Heiqb), NA_real_),
    iqcode_c = if_else(Heiqc %in% 1:5, as.numeric(Heiqc), NA_real_),
    iqcode_d = if_else(Heiqd %in% 1:5, as.numeric(Heiqd), NA_real_),
    iqcode_e = if_else(Heiqe %in% 1:5, as.numeric(Heiqe), NA_real_),
    iqcode_f = if_else(Heiqf %in% 1:5, as.numeric(Heiqf), NA_real_),
    iqcode_g = if_else(Heiqg %in% 1:5, as.numeric(Heiqg), NA_real_),
    iqcode_h = if_else(Heiqh %in% 1:5, as.numeric(Heiqh), NA_real_),
    iqcode_i = if_else(Heiqi %in% 1:5, as.numeric(Heiqi), NA_real_),
    iqcode_j = if_else(Heiqj %in% 1:5, as.numeric(Heiqj), NA_real_),
    iqcode_k = if_else(Heiqk %in% 1:5, as.numeric(Heiqk), NA_real_),
    iqcode_l = if_else(Heiql %in% 1:5, as.numeric(Heiql), NA_real_),
    iqcode_m = if_else(Heiqm %in% 1:5, as.numeric(Heiqm), NA_real_),
    iqcode_n = if_else(Heiqn %in% 1:5, as.numeric(Heiqn), NA_real_),
    iqcode_o = if_else(Heiqo %in% 1:5, as.numeric(Heiqo), NA_real_),
    iqcode_p = if_else(Heiqp %in% 1:5, as.numeric(Heiqp), NA_real_),
    iqcode_q = if_else(Heiqq %in% 1:5, as.numeric(Heiqq), NA_real_)
  )

iqcode_cols <- paste0("iqcode_", letters[2:17])
iqcode_mat  <- as.matrix(elsa_cog_2014[, iqcode_cols])

elsa_cog_2014 <- elsa_cog_2014 %>%
  mutate(
    iqcode_n_valid  = rowSums(!is.na(iqcode_mat)),
    iqcode_mean     = if_else(iqcode_n_valid >= 1L,
                              rowMeans(iqcode_mat, na.rm = TRUE),
                              NA_real_),
    iqcode_dementia = case_when(
      is.na(iqcode_mean) ~ NA_integer_,
      iqcode_mean >= 3.4 ~ 1L,
      iqcode_mean <  3.4 ~ 0L
    ),
    dementia = case_when(
      diagnosed_dementia == 1 | iqcode_dementia == 1 ~ 1L,
      diagnosed_dementia == 0 | iqcode_dementia == 0 ~ 0L,
      TRUE                                           ~ NA_integer_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, year, diagnosed_dementia, iqcode_mean, iqcode_n_valid,
         iqcode_dementia, dementia)

# Wave 7 (2014) Dementia Classification — observed counts
# -------------------------------------------------------
# Total participants in Wave 7: 9,666
# Total dementia cases:         169  (1.75% prevalence)
#   Physician diagnosis only : 73   (of which 69 had no IQCODE data)
#   IQCODE ≥ 3.4 only        : 31
#   Both sources             : 65
# Missing dementia status:     4    (lowest of the "newly reported" waves;
#                                    hedibad & hedibde both Refusal/DK and
#                                    no IQCODE data either)
#
# NOTE: hedibad / hedibde are "newly reported" per wave (W4+ convention) —
# cumulative status is recovered downstream by pmax across waves.
#
# Physician diagnosis (hedibad + hedibde, codes 0/1):
#   Yes: 138   No: 9,524   Missing: 4 (none rescued by IQCODE — all 4
#                                       also had no informant data)
# IQCODE (16-item Heiqb–Heiqq, mixed-case):
#   216 respondents with ≥1 valid item
#   9,450 with no IQCODE data (no informant / proxy interview)
#   Mean 3.67  |  Median 3.19  |  IQR 3.00–4.52
#   ≥ 3.4 classification: Yes 96  No 120  NA 9,450
```

```{r}
# 4. Frailty Index (49 items) --------------------------------------------
recode_mob_adl_w7 <- function(x) {
  case_when(x == 1 ~ 1L, x == 0 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_)
}
recode_dx_w7 <- function(x) {
  case_when(x == 1 ~ 1L, x == 0 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_)
}

# Mobility (Items 1–10)
mobility_w7 <- elsa_core_w7 %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, hemobwa, hemobsi, hemobch, hemobcs, hemobcl,
         hemobst, hemobre, hemobpu, hemobli, hemobpi) %>%
  mutate(across(-idauniq, recode_mob_adl_w7))

# ADL/IADL (Items 11–23): headlph back (W6 style); headlho → headlhg
adl_iadl_w7 <- elsa_core_w7 %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, headldr, headlwa, headlba, headlea, headlbe, headlwc,
         headlma, headlpr, headlsh, headlph, headlme, headlho, headlmo) %>%
  rename(headlhg = headlho) %>%
  mutate(across(-idauniq, recode_mob_adl_w7))

# Diagnosed conditions (Items 24–36)
diagnoses_w7 <- elsa_core_w7 %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, hedimbp, hediman, hedimmi, hedimhf, hedimar,
         hedimdi, hedimst, hediblu, hedibas, hedibar, hedibos,
         hedibca, hedibps) %>%
  mutate(across(-idauniq, recode_dx_w7))

# CES-D (Items 37–44) — mixed-case PScedA–H
cesd_w7 <- elsa_core_w7 %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, PScedA, PScedB, PScedC, PScedD,
         PScedE, PScedF, PScedG, PScedH) %>%
  mutate(
    psceda = case_when(PScedA == 1 ~ 1L, PScedA == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    pscedb = case_when(PScedB == 1 ~ 1L, PScedB == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    pscedc = case_when(PScedC == 1 ~ 1L, PScedC == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    pscede = case_when(PScedE == 1 ~ 1L, PScedE == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    pscedg = case_when(PScedG == 1 ~ 1L, PScedG == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    pscedh = case_when(PScedH == 1 ~ 1L, PScedH == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    pscedd = case_when(PScedD == 2 ~ 1L, PScedD == 1 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    pscedf = case_when(PScedF == 2 ~ 1L, PScedF == 1 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, psceda, pscedb, pscedc, pscedd, pscede, pscedf, pscedg, pscedh)

# Other health (Items 45, 48–51) — mixed-case
other_health_w7 <- elsa_core_w7 %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, Hehelf, HeFla, HeFrac, HeJi, MmPain) %>%
  mutate(
    hehelf = case_when(Hehelf %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 0L,
                       Hehelf %in% c(4, 5)    ~ 1L,
                       TRUE                   ~ NA_integer_),
    hefla  = case_when(HeFla  == 1 ~ 1L, HeFla  == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    hefrac = case_when(HeFrac == 1 ~ 1L, HeFrac == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    heji   = case_when(HeJi   == 1 ~ 1L, HeJi   == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    mmpain = case_when(MmPain == 1 ~ 1L, MmPain == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, hehelf, hefla, hefrac, heji, mmpain)

# Merge & compute FI — vectorised
fi_items <- c(
  "hemobwa", "hemobsi", "hemobch", "hemobcs", "hemobcl",
  "hemobst", "hemobre", "hemobpu", "hemobli", "hemobpi",
  "headldr", "headlwa", "headlba", "headlea", "headlbe", "headlwc",
  "headlma", "headlpr", "headlsh", "headlph", "headlme", "headlhg", "headlmo",
  "hedimbp", "hediman", "hedimmi", "hedimhf", "hedimar",
  "hedimdi", "hedimst", "hediblu", "hedibas", "hedibar", "hedibos", "hedibca", "hedibps",
  "psceda", "pscedb", "pscedc", "pscedd", "pscede", "pscedf", "pscedg", "pscedh",
  "hehelf", "hefla", "hefrac", "heji", "mmpain"
)
n_fi_items <- length(fi_items)
stopifnot(n_fi_items == 49)

# Strict (I)ADL items removed in the sensitivity FI
# (Re-declared so this chunk is self-contained; identical across waves.)
iadl_items <- c(
  # ADL (6)
  "headldr", "headlwa", "headlba", "headlea", "headlbe", "headlwc",
  # IADL (7) — phone, money, meals, shopping, meds, house/garden, map use
  "headlma", "headlpr", "headlsh", "headlph", "headlme", "headlhg", "headlmo"
)
fi_items_noIADL   <- setdiff(fi_items, iadl_items)
n_fi_items_noIADL <- length(fi_items_noIADL)
stopifnot(n_fi_items_noIADL == 36)

# Merge components (single source of recoded items feeds both FIs)
fi_merged_w7 <- mobility_w7 %>%
  left_join(adl_iadl_w7,     by = "idauniq") %>%
  left_join(diagnoses_w7,    by = "idauniq") %>%
  left_join(cesd_w7,         by = "idauniq") %>%
  left_join(other_health_w7, by = "idauniq")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# (a) ORIGINAL frailty index — 49 items
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
fi_mat_w7 <- as.matrix(fi_merged_w7[, fi_items])

elsa_fi_2014_orig <- fi_merged_w7 %>%
  mutate(
    year         = 2014L,
    fi_n_valid   = rowSums(!is.na(fi_mat_w7)),
    fi_n_deficit = rowSums(fi_mat_w7 == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    fi_score     = if_else(
      fi_n_valid >= ceiling(n_fi_items * 0.8),
      fi_n_deficit / fi_n_valid,
      NA_real_
    ),
    frailty = case_when(
      is.na(fi_score)  ~ NA_integer_,
      fi_score >= 0.25 ~ 1L,
      fi_score <  0.25 ~ 0L
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(fi_score)) %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, year, fi_n_valid, fi_n_deficit, fi_score, frailty)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# (b) MODIFIED frailty index — (I)ADL items removed (sensitivity)
#     Addresses possible mediation by (I)ADL deficits on the
#     sensory-impairment → dementia pathway. Same ≥0.25 threshold,
#     same ≥80% completeness rule applied to the reduced 36-item set
#     (>= 29 of 36).
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
fi_mat_w7_noIADL <- as.matrix(fi_merged_w7[, fi_items_noIADL])

elsa_fi_2014_noIADL <- fi_merged_w7 %>%
  mutate(
    fi_n_valid_noIADL   = rowSums(!is.na(fi_mat_w7_noIADL)),
    fi_n_deficit_noIADL = rowSums(fi_mat_w7_noIADL == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    fi_score_noIADL = if_else(
      fi_n_valid_noIADL >= ceiling(n_fi_items_noIADL * 0.8),
      fi_n_deficit_noIADL / fi_n_valid_noIADL,
      NA_real_
    ),
    frailty_noIADL = case_when(
      is.na(fi_score_noIADL)  ~ NA_integer_,
      fi_score_noIADL >= 0.25 ~ 1L,
      fi_score_noIADL <  0.25 ~ 0L
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(fi_score_noIADL)) %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, fi_n_valid_noIADL, fi_n_deficit_noIADL,
                fi_score_noIADL, frailty_noIADL)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Combine both FI versions into a single per-person table.
# Original `elsa_fi_2014` interface is preserved (idauniq, year,
# fi_n_valid, fi_n_deficit, fi_score, frailty); sensitivity columns
# (fi_score_noIADL, frailty_noIADL) are added alongside.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
elsa_fi_2014 <- elsa_fi_2014_orig %>%
  full_join(elsa_fi_2014_noIADL, by = "idauniq")
```

```{r}
# 5. Merge 2014 data -----------------------------------------------------
elsa_2014 <- elsa_cov_2014 %>%
  left_join(sensory_var_2014, by = "idauniq") %>%
  left_join(elsa_cog_2014,    by = c("idauniq", "year")) %>%
  left_join(elsa_fi_2014,     by = c("idauniq", "year"))


# ==========================================================================
# 6. Multiple imputation (MICE) — ELSA wave 7 (2014)
# ==========================================================================
# Identical specification to waves 1-6 — see the design notes in the 2002
# block. Education is an all-NA placeholder at W7 and is detected and
# excluded automatically below.

analysis_covars14 <- c("age_2014", "Education", "Marital_status", "Employment",
                       "Smoking", "Alcohol", "Physical_activity", "Social_activity")

# ---- 6a. Imputation frame ----------------------------------------------
# birth_year is not a predictor (near-collinear with age); age is resolved
# deterministically where a birth year exists and pmm handles the residual
# cases. Wave 7 fieldwork spanned 2014-2015, so that value can be ±1 year.
imp14_elsa <- elsa_2014 %>%
  transmute(
    idauniq    = as.character(idauniq),
    age_2014   = coalesce(as.numeric(age_2014), 2014 - as.numeric(birth_year)),
    Gender     = factor(Gender, levels = c(1, 2)),
    Race       = factor(Race,   levels = c(0, 1)),
    Education  = ordered(Education, levels = c(0, 1, 2)),
    across(c(Marital_status, Employment, Smoking, Alcohol,
             Physical_activity, Social_activity),
           ~ factor(.x, levels = c(0, 1)))
  )

# Variables with no observed values (Education from W6 onward) cannot be
# imputed; drop them here and leave them untouched in the analysis data.
all_missing14 <- names(imp14_elsa)[colSums(!is.na(imp14_elsa)) == 0]
if (length(all_missing14) > 0) {
  message("ELSA 2014 — no observed values, excluded from imputation: ",
          paste(all_missing14, collapse = ", "))
  imp14_elsa <- imp14_elsa %>% dplyr::select(-all_of(all_missing14))
}
imputed_vars14 <- setdiff(analysis_covars14, all_missing14)

# ---- 6b. Quantify missingness (for the Methods text) -------------------
miss_pct14 <- sapply(imp14_elsa, function(x) mean(is.na(x)) * 100)
cat("ELSA 2014 — percentage missing per variable:\n")
print(round(miss_pct14, 2))

miss_cov14 <- miss_pct14[intersect(imputed_vars14, names(miss_pct14))]
miss_cov14 <- miss_cov14[miss_cov14 > 0]
if (length(miss_cov14) > 0) {
  cat(sprintf("\nMean missing across analysis covariates: %.2f%%\n",
              mean(miss_cov14)))
  cat(sprintf("Maximum missing: %.2f%% (%s)\n",
              max(miss_cov14), names(which.max(miss_cov14))))
} else {
  cat("\nNo missing values among analysis covariates.\n")
}

# ---- 6c. Imputation method per variable --------------------------------
meth14 <- make.method(imp14_elsa)
meth14["idauniq"]  <- ""
meth14["age_2014"] <- "pmm"
meth14[intersect("Education", names(imp14_elsa))] <- "polr"
meth14[intersect(c("Gender", "Race", "Marital_status", "Employment", "Smoking",
                   "Alcohol", "Physical_activity", "Social_activity"),
                 names(imp14_elsa))] <- "logreg"
# Variables with no missing values are not imputed (mice requirement).
meth14[colSums(is.na(imp14_elsa)) == 0] <- ""

# ---- 6d. Predictor matrix ---------------------------------------------
pred14 <- make.predictorMatrix(imp14_elsa)
pred14[, "idauniq"] <- 0
pred14["idauniq", ] <- 0

# GUARD: no incomplete variable may be used as a predictor without itself
# being imputed, otherwise NAs leak into every imputation model.
incomplete14 <- names(imp14_elsa)[colSums(is.na(imp14_elsa)) > 0]
stopifnot(all(meth14[incomplete14] != ""))

# ---- 6e. Run MICE: 20 imputed datasets, 10 iterations ------------------
set.seed(3)
imp_mice14_elsa <- mice(
  imp14_elsa,
  m               = 20,
  maxit           = 10,
  method          = meth14,
  predictorMatrix = pred14,
  printFlag       = TRUE
)

if (!is.null(imp_mice14_elsa$loggedEvents)) {
  cat("\nMICE logged events (ELSA 2014):\n")
  print(imp_mice14_elsa$loggedEvents)
}

# ---- 6f. Merge the completed covariates back ---------------------------
# Single completion (imputation 1), as in HRS. Only the analysis covariates
# are replaced; Gender, Race and the primary study variables keep their
# ORIGINAL values, including NAs.
imp14_elsa_complete1 <- complete(imp_mice14_elsa, 1)

elsa14_clean <- elsa_2014 %>%
  mutate(idauniq = as.character(idauniq)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-all_of(imputed_vars14)) %>%
  left_join(
    imp14_elsa_complete1 %>%
      mutate(idauniq = as.character(idauniq)) %>%
      dplyr::select(idauniq, all_of(imputed_vars14)),
    by = "idauniq"
  )

ELSA_2014 <- elsa14_clean

stopifnot(nrow(ELSA_2014) == nrow(elsa_2014))
```
