# ELSA Wave 8 (2016)
```{r}
# W8 specifics:
#   - all lowercase variable names
#   - dimarr (double-r) with simplified 1–6 coding (CP folded into married codes)
#   - fqethnmr (not fqethnr)
#   - NEW social-activity var names: scorgpo/nw/rl/ch/ed/sc/sp/95/96
#   - headlph present (not headlte)
#   - hehelf 1=Excellent … 5=Poor (same as W2/W4/W5/W6/W7)
#   - heoptca/heoptgl/hedibad/hedibde: binary 0/1 "newly reported"
#   - NO education variable
# ==========================================================================
elsa_core_w8 <- read_dta(file.path(data_dir, "wave_8_elsa_data_eul_v2.dta"))

# 1. Covariates ------------------------------------------------------------
elsa_cov_2016 <- elsa_core_w8 %>%
  transmute(
    idauniq,
    year       = 2016L,
    birth_year = if_else(indobyr > 0, as.numeric(indobyr), NA_real_),
    age_2016   = if_else(indager > 0, as.numeric(indager), NA_real_),

    Gender = case_when(indsex %in% c(1, 2) ~ as.integer(indsex),
                       TRUE                ~ NA_integer_),

    Race = case_when(fqethnmr == 1 ~ 0L, fqethnmr == 2 ~ 1L,
                     TRUE ~ NA_integer_),

    # No education variable in W8 — can be back-filled from W1–W5 edqual
    # in the pooled long dataset later.
    Education = NA_integer_,

    # dimarr simplified coding: 1=Single, 2=Married/CP, 3=Remarried,
    # 4=Sep (or CP separated), 5=Divorced (or CP dissolved), 6=Widowed
    # (or surviving CP).
    Marital_status = case_when(
      dimarr %in% c(2, 3)       ~ 1L,
      dimarr %in% c(1, 4, 5, 6) ~ 0L,
      TRUE                      ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # wpdes: treat 85/86/95 (not codeable / irrelevant / other) as NA
    Employment = case_when(
      wpdes %in% c(2, 3)           ~ 1L,
      wpdes %in% c(1, 4, 5, 6, 96) ~ 0L,
      TRUE                          ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    Smoking = case_when(heska == 1 ~ 1L, heska == 2 ~ 0L,
                        TRUE ~ NA_integer_),

    Alcohol = case_when(scal7a == 1 ~ 1L, scal7a == 2 ~ 0L,
                        TRUE ~ NA_integer_),

    Physical_activity = case_when(
      heacta %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 1L,
      heacta == 4            ~ 0L,
      TRUE                   ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # W8 social: new variable names
    #   scorgpo=political, scorgnw=neighbourhood, scorgrl=religious,
    #   scorgch=charitable, scorged=education, scorgsc=social club,
    #   scorgsp=sports, scorg95=other, scorg96=none of these
    Social_activity = case_when(
      scorgpo == 1 | scorgnw == 1 | scorgrl == 1 | scorgch == 1 |
      scorged == 1 | scorgsc == 1 | scorgsp == 1 | scorg95 == 1 ~ 1L,
      scorg96 == 1 ~ 0L,
      scorgpo == 0 & scorgnw == 0 & scorgrl == 0 & scorgch == 0 &
      scorged == 0 & scorgsc == 0 & scorgsp == 0 & scorg95 == 0 ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, year, birth_year, age_2016,
         Gender, Race, Education, Marital_status, Employment,
         Smoking, Alcohol, Physical_activity, Social_activity)


# 2. Sensory variables ----------------------------------------------------
sensory_var_2016 <- elsa_core_w8 %>%
  transmute(
    idauniq,

    # --- Hearing (hehear: 1=excellent … 5=poor) ---
    hearing_loss = case_when(
      hehear %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 0L,
      hehear %in% c(4, 5)    ~ 1L,
      TRUE                   ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # --- Vision (heeye: 1=excellent … 5=poor, 6=registered/legally blind) ---
    vision_overall = case_when(
      heeye %in% c(1, 2, 3)    ~ 0L,
      heeye %in% c(4, 5, 6)    ~ 1L,
      TRUE                     ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # --- Cataract diagnosis (NEWLY reported at W8 — see warning above) ---
    cataract_diagnosis = case_when(
      heoptca == 1 ~ 1L,
      heoptca == 0 ~ 0L,
      TRUE         ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # --- Glaucoma diagnosis (NEWLY reported at W8 — see warning above) ---
    glaucoma_diagnosis = case_when(
      heoptgl == 1 ~ 1L,
      heoptgl == 0 ~ 0L,
      TRUE         ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # --- Cataract surgery (direct question hecat: 1=Yes, 2=No) ---
    cataract_surgery = case_when(
      hecat == 1 ~ 1L,
      hecat == 2 ~ 0L,
      TRUE       ~ NA_integer_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, hearing_loss, vision_overall,
                cataract_diagnosis, glaucoma_diagnosis,
                cataract_surgery)

# 3. Dementia classification ----------------------------------------------
# NOTE: hedibad / hedibde are "newly reported" per wave (W4+ convention).
elsa_cog_2016 <- elsa_core_w8 %>%
  transmute(
    idauniq,
    year = 2016L,
    diagnosed_dementia = case_when(
      hedibad == 1 | hedibde == 1 ~ 1L,
      hedibad == 0 | hedibde == 0 ~ 0L,
      TRUE                        ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    iqcode_b = if_else(heiqb %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqb), NA_real_),
    iqcode_c = if_else(heiqc %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqc), NA_real_),
    iqcode_d = if_else(heiqd %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqd), NA_real_),
    iqcode_e = if_else(heiqe %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqe), NA_real_),
    iqcode_f = if_else(heiqf %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqf), NA_real_),
    iqcode_g = if_else(heiqg %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqg), NA_real_),
    iqcode_h = if_else(heiqh %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqh), NA_real_),
    iqcode_i = if_else(heiqi %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqi), NA_real_),
    iqcode_j = if_else(heiqj %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqj), NA_real_),
    iqcode_k = if_else(heiqk %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqk), NA_real_),
    iqcode_l = if_else(heiql %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiql), NA_real_),
    iqcode_m = if_else(heiqm %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqm), NA_real_),
    iqcode_n = if_else(heiqn %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqn), NA_real_),
    iqcode_o = if_else(heiqo %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqo), NA_real_),
    iqcode_p = if_else(heiqp %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqp), NA_real_),
    iqcode_q = if_else(heiqq %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqq), NA_real_)
  )

iqcode_cols <- paste0("iqcode_", letters[2:17])
iqcode_mat  <- as.matrix(elsa_cog_2016[, iqcode_cols])

elsa_cog_2016 <- elsa_cog_2016 %>%
  mutate(
    iqcode_n_valid  = rowSums(!is.na(iqcode_mat)),
    iqcode_mean     = if_else(iqcode_n_valid >= 1L,
                              rowMeans(iqcode_mat, na.rm = TRUE),
                              NA_real_),
    iqcode_dementia = case_when(
      is.na(iqcode_mean) ~ NA_integer_,
      iqcode_mean >= 3.4 ~ 1L,
      iqcode_mean <  3.4 ~ 0L
    ),
    dementia = case_when(
      diagnosed_dementia == 1 | iqcode_dementia == 1 ~ 1L,
      diagnosed_dementia == 0 | iqcode_dementia == 0 ~ 0L,
      TRUE                                           ~ NA_integer_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, year, diagnosed_dementia, iqcode_mean, iqcode_n_valid,
         iqcode_dementia, dementia)

# Wave 8 (2016) Dementia Classification — observed counts
# -------------------------------------------------------
# Total participants in Wave 8: 8,445   (smallest sample since W2)
# Total dementia cases:         180    (2.13% prevalence — highest of all waves)
#   Physician diagnosis only : 110   (of which 103 had no IQCODE data)
#   IQCODE ≥ 3.4 only        : 22
#   Both sources             : 48
# Missing dementia status:     7      (hedibad & hedibde both Refusal/DK and
#                                      no IQCODE data either)
#
# NOTE: hedibad / hedibde are "newly reported" per wave (W4+ convention) —
# cumulative status is recovered downstream by pmax across waves.
#
# Physician diagnosis (hedibad + hedibde, codes 0/1):
#   Yes: 158   No: 8,280   Missing: 7 (none rescued by IQCODE)
# IQCODE (16-item heiqb–heiqq, lowercase):
#   157 respondents with ≥1 valid item
#   8,288 with no IQCODE data (no informant / proxy interview)
#   Mean 3.68  |  Median 3.31  |  IQR 3.00–4.38
#   ≥ 3.4 classification: Yes 70  No 87  NA 8,288
```

```{r}
# 4. Frailty Index (49 items) --------------------------------------------
recode_mob_adl_w8 <- function(x) {
  case_when(x == 1 ~ 1L, x == 0 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_)
}
recode_dx_w8 <- function(x) {
  case_when(x == 1 ~ 1L, x == 0 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_)
}

# Mobility (Items 1–10)
mobility_w8 <- elsa_core_w8 %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, hemobwa, hemobsi, hemobch, hemobcs, hemobcl,
         hemobst, hemobre, hemobpu, hemobli, hemobpi) %>%
  mutate(across(-idauniq, recode_mob_adl_w8))

# ADL/IADL (Items 11–23): headlph present; headlho → headlhg
adl_iadl_w8 <- elsa_core_w8 %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, headldr, headlwa, headlba, headlea, headlbe, headlwc,
         headlma, headlpr, headlsh, headlph, headlme, headlho, headlmo) %>%
  rename(headlhg = headlho) %>%
  mutate(across(-idauniq, recode_mob_adl_w8))

# Diagnosed conditions (Items 24–36)
diagnoses_w8 <- elsa_core_w8 %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, hedimbp, hediman, hedimmi, hedimhf, hedimar,
         hedimdi, hedimst, hediblu, hedibas, hedibar, hedibos,
         hedibca, hedibps) %>%
  mutate(across(-idauniq, recode_dx_w8))

# CES-D (Items 37–44) — lowercase in W8
cesd_w8 <- elsa_core_w8 %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, psceda, pscedb, pscedc, pscedd,
         pscede, pscedf, pscedg, pscedh) %>%
  mutate(
    psceda = case_when(psceda == 1 ~ 1L, psceda == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    pscedb = case_when(pscedb == 1 ~ 1L, pscedb == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    pscedc = case_when(pscedc == 1 ~ 1L, pscedc == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    pscede = case_when(pscede == 1 ~ 1L, pscede == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    pscedg = case_when(pscedg == 1 ~ 1L, pscedg == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    pscedh = case_when(pscedh == 1 ~ 1L, pscedh == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    pscedd = case_when(pscedd == 2 ~ 1L, pscedd == 1 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    pscedf = case_when(pscedf == 2 ~ 1L, pscedf == 1 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_)
  )

# Other health (Items 45, 48–51)
other_health_w8 <- elsa_core_w8 %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, hehelf, hefla, hefrac, heji, mmpain) %>%
  mutate(
    hehelf = case_when(hehelf %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 0L,
                       hehelf %in% c(4, 5)    ~ 1L,
                       TRUE                   ~ NA_integer_),
    hefla  = case_when(hefla  == 1 ~ 1L, hefla  == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    hefrac = case_when(hefrac == 1 ~ 1L, hefrac == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    heji   = case_when(heji   == 1 ~ 1L, heji   == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    mmpain = case_when(mmpain == 1 ~ 1L, mmpain == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, hehelf, hefla, hefrac, heji, mmpain)

# Merge & compute FI — vectorised
fi_items <- c(
  "hemobwa", "hemobsi", "hemobch", "hemobcs", "hemobcl",
  "hemobst", "hemobre", "hemobpu", "hemobli", "hemobpi",
  "headldr", "headlwa", "headlba", "headlea", "headlbe", "headlwc",
  "headlma", "headlpr", "headlsh", "headlph", "headlme", "headlhg", "headlmo",
  "hedimbp", "hediman", "hedimmi", "hedimhf", "hedimar",
  "hedimdi", "hedimst", "hediblu", "hedibas", "hedibar", "hedibos", "hedibca", "hedibps",
  "psceda", "pscedb", "pscedc", "pscedd", "pscede", "pscedf", "pscedg", "pscedh",
  "hehelf", "hefla", "hefrac", "heji", "mmpain"
)
n_fi_items <- length(fi_items)
stopifnot(n_fi_items == 49)

# Strict (I)ADL items removed in the sensitivity FI
# (Re-declared so this chunk is self-contained; identical across waves.)
iadl_items <- c(
  # ADL (6)
  "headldr", "headlwa", "headlba", "headlea", "headlbe", "headlwc",
  # IADL (7) — phone, money, meals, shopping, meds, house/garden, map use
  "headlma", "headlpr", "headlsh", "headlph", "headlme", "headlhg", "headlmo"
)
fi_items_noIADL   <- setdiff(fi_items, iadl_items)
n_fi_items_noIADL <- length(fi_items_noIADL)
stopifnot(n_fi_items_noIADL == 36)

# Merge components (single source of recoded items feeds both FIs)
fi_merged_w8 <- mobility_w8 %>%
  left_join(adl_iadl_w8,     by = "idauniq") %>%
  left_join(diagnoses_w8,    by = "idauniq") %>%
  left_join(cesd_w8,         by = "idauniq") %>%
  left_join(other_health_w8, by = "idauniq")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# (a) ORIGINAL frailty index — 49 items
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
fi_mat_w8 <- as.matrix(fi_merged_w8[, fi_items])

elsa_fi_2016_orig <- fi_merged_w8 %>%
  mutate(
    year         = 2016L,
    fi_n_valid   = rowSums(!is.na(fi_mat_w8)),
    fi_n_deficit = rowSums(fi_mat_w8 == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    fi_score     = if_else(
      fi_n_valid >= ceiling(n_fi_items * 0.8),
      fi_n_deficit / fi_n_valid,
      NA_real_
    ),
    frailty = case_when(
      is.na(fi_score)  ~ NA_integer_,
      fi_score >= 0.25 ~ 1L,
      fi_score <  0.25 ~ 0L
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(fi_score)) %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, year, fi_n_valid, fi_n_deficit, fi_score, frailty)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# (b) MODIFIED frailty index — (I)ADL items removed (sensitivity)
#     Addresses possible mediation by (I)ADL deficits on the
#     sensory-impairment → dementia pathway. Same ≥0.25 threshold,
#     same ≥80% completeness rule applied to the reduced 36-item set
#     (>= 29 of 36).
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
fi_mat_w8_noIADL <- as.matrix(fi_merged_w8[, fi_items_noIADL])

elsa_fi_2016_noIADL <- fi_merged_w8 %>%
  mutate(
    fi_n_valid_noIADL   = rowSums(!is.na(fi_mat_w8_noIADL)),
    fi_n_deficit_noIADL = rowSums(fi_mat_w8_noIADL == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    fi_score_noIADL = if_else(
      fi_n_valid_noIADL >= ceiling(n_fi_items_noIADL * 0.8),
      fi_n_deficit_noIADL / fi_n_valid_noIADL,
      NA_real_
    ),
    frailty_noIADL = case_when(
      is.na(fi_score_noIADL)  ~ NA_integer_,
      fi_score_noIADL >= 0.25 ~ 1L,
      fi_score_noIADL <  0.25 ~ 0L
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(fi_score_noIADL)) %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, fi_n_valid_noIADL, fi_n_deficit_noIADL,
                fi_score_noIADL, frailty_noIADL)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Combine both FI versions into a single per-person table.
# Original `elsa_fi_2016` interface is preserved (idauniq, year,
# fi_n_valid, fi_n_deficit, fi_score, frailty); sensitivity columns
# (fi_score_noIADL, frailty_noIADL) are added alongside.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
elsa_fi_2016 <- elsa_fi_2016_orig %>%
  full_join(elsa_fi_2016_noIADL, by = "idauniq")
```

```{r}
# 5. Merge 2016 data -----------------------------------------------------
elsa_2016 <- elsa_cov_2016 %>%
  left_join(sensory_var_2016, by = "idauniq") %>%
  left_join(elsa_cog_2016,    by = c("idauniq", "year")) %>%
  left_join(elsa_fi_2016,     by = c("idauniq", "year"))


# ==========================================================================
# 6. Multiple imputation (MICE) — ELSA wave 8 (2016)
# ==========================================================================
# Identical specification to waves 1-7 — see the design notes in the 2002
# block. Education is an all-NA placeholder at W8 and is detected and
# excluded automatically below.

analysis_covars16 <- c("age_2016", "Education", "Marital_status", "Employment",
                       "Smoking", "Alcohol", "Physical_activity", "Social_activity")

# ---- 6a. Imputation frame ----------------------------------------------
# birth_year is not a predictor (near-collinear with age); age is resolved
# deterministically where a birth year exists and pmm handles the residual
# cases. Wave 8 fieldwork spanned 2016-2017, so that value can be ±1 year.
imp16_elsa <- elsa_2016 %>%
  transmute(
    idauniq    = as.character(idauniq),
    age_2016   = coalesce(as.numeric(age_2016), 2016 - as.numeric(birth_year)),
    Gender     = factor(Gender, levels = c(1, 2)),
    Race       = factor(Race,   levels = c(0, 1)),
    Education  = ordered(Education, levels = c(0, 1, 2)),
    across(c(Marital_status, Employment, Smoking, Alcohol,
             Physical_activity, Social_activity),
           ~ factor(.x, levels = c(0, 1)))
  )

# Variables with no observed values (Education from W6 onward) cannot be
# imputed; drop them here and leave them untouched in the analysis data.
all_missing16 <- names(imp16_elsa)[colSums(!is.na(imp16_elsa)) == 0]
if (length(all_missing16) > 0) {
  message("ELSA 2016 — no observed values, excluded from imputation: ",
          paste(all_missing16, collapse = ", "))
  imp16_elsa <- imp16_elsa %>% dplyr::select(-all_of(all_missing16))
}
imputed_vars16 <- setdiff(analysis_covars16, all_missing16)

# ---- 6b. Quantify missingness (for the Methods text) -------------------
miss_pct16 <- sapply(imp16_elsa, function(x) mean(is.na(x)) * 100)
cat("ELSA 2016 — percentage missing per variable:\n")
print(round(miss_pct16, 2))

miss_cov16 <- miss_pct16[intersect(imputed_vars16, names(miss_pct16))]
miss_cov16 <- miss_cov16[miss_cov16 > 0]
if (length(miss_cov16) > 0) {
  cat(sprintf("\nMean missing across analysis covariates: %.2f%%\n",
              mean(miss_cov16)))
  cat(sprintf("Maximum missing: %.2f%% (%s)\n",
              max(miss_cov16), names(which.max(miss_cov16))))
} else {
  cat("\nNo missing values among analysis covariates.\n")
}

# ---- 6c. Imputation method per variable --------------------------------
meth16 <- make.method(imp16_elsa)
meth16["idauniq"]  <- ""
meth16["age_2016"] <- "pmm"
meth16[intersect("Education", names(imp16_elsa))] <- "polr"
meth16[intersect(c("Gender", "Race", "Marital_status", "Employment", "Smoking",
                   "Alcohol", "Physical_activity", "Social_activity"),
                 names(imp16_elsa))] <- "logreg"
# Variables with no missing values are not imputed (mice requirement).
meth16[colSums(is.na(imp16_elsa)) == 0] <- ""

# ---- 6d. Predictor matrix ---------------------------------------------
pred16 <- make.predictorMatrix(imp16_elsa)
pred16[, "idauniq"] <- 0
pred16["idauniq", ] <- 0

# GUARD: no incomplete variable may be used as a predictor without itself
# being imputed, otherwise NAs leak into every imputation model.
incomplete16 <- names(imp16_elsa)[colSums(is.na(imp16_elsa)) > 0]
stopifnot(all(meth16[incomplete16] != ""))

# ---- 6e. Run MICE: 20 imputed datasets, 10 iterations ------------------
set.seed(3)
imp_mice16_elsa <- mice(
  imp16_elsa,
  m               = 20,
  maxit           = 10,
  method          = meth16,
  predictorMatrix = pred16,
  printFlag       = TRUE
)

if (!is.null(imp_mice16_elsa$loggedEvents)) {
  cat("\nMICE logged events (ELSA 2016):\n")
  print(imp_mice16_elsa$loggedEvents)
}

# ---- 6f. Merge the completed covariates back ---------------------------
# Single completion (imputation 1), as in HRS. Only the analysis covariates
# are replaced; Gender, Race and the primary study variables keep their
# ORIGINAL values, including NAs.
imp16_elsa_complete1 <- complete(imp_mice16_elsa, 1)

elsa16_clean <- elsa_2016 %>%
  mutate(idauniq = as.character(idauniq)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-all_of(imputed_vars16)) %>%
  left_join(
    imp16_elsa_complete1 %>%
      mutate(idauniq = as.character(idauniq)) %>%
      dplyr::select(idauniq, all_of(imputed_vars16)),
    by = "idauniq"
  )

ELSA_2016 <- elsa16_clean

stopifnot(nrow(ELSA_2016) == nrow(elsa_2016))
```

# ELSA Wave 9 (2018)
```{r}
# W9 specifics: structurally identical to W8 except
#   - Alcohol: scal7a replaced by scalcy (same 1=Yes/2=No coding)
# Everything else (dimarr, fqethnmr, scorgpo/nw/rl/…, headlph, lowercase
# core vars, 1=Excellent hehelf, binary "newly reported" eye/cognition vars)
# is identical to W8.
# ==========================================================================
elsa_core_w9 <- read_dta(file.path(data_dir, "wave_9_elsa_data_eul_v2.dta"))

# 1. Covariates ------------------------------------------------------------
elsa_cov_2018 <- elsa_core_w9 %>%
  transmute(
    idauniq,
    year       = 2018L,
    birth_year = if_else(indobyr > 0, as.numeric(indobyr), NA_real_),
    age_2018   = if_else(indager > 0, as.numeric(indager), NA_real_),

    Gender = case_when(indsex %in% c(1, 2) ~ as.integer(indsex),
                       TRUE                ~ NA_integer_),

    Race = case_when(fqethnmr == 1 ~ 0L, fqethnmr == 2 ~ 1L,
                     TRUE ~ NA_integer_),

    # No education variable in W9 — can be back-filled from W1–W5 later.
    Education = NA_integer_,

    # dimarr simplified 1–6 coding (same as W8)
    Marital_status = case_when(
      dimarr %in% c(2, 3)       ~ 1L,
      dimarr %in% c(1, 4, 5, 6) ~ 0L,
      TRUE                      ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # wpdes: 85/86/95 (not codeable / irrelevant / other) → NA
    Employment = case_when(
      wpdes %in% c(2, 3)           ~ 1L,
      wpdes %in% c(1, 4, 5, 6, 96) ~ 0L,
      TRUE                          ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    Smoking = case_when(heska == 1 ~ 1L, heska == 2 ~ 0L,
                        TRUE ~ NA_integer_),

    # W9: scalcy replaces scal7a (same 1=Yes/2=No coding)
    Alcohol = case_when(scalcy == 1 ~ 1L, scalcy == 2 ~ 0L,
                        TRUE ~ NA_integer_),

    Physical_activity = case_when(
      heacta %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 1L,
      heacta == 4            ~ 0L,
      TRUE                   ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # W9 social: same new names as W8
    Social_activity = case_when(
      scorgpo == 1 | scorgnw == 1 | scorgrl == 1 | scorgch == 1 |
      scorged == 1 | scorgsc == 1 | scorgsp == 1 | scorg95 == 1 ~ 1L,
      scorg96 == 1 ~ 0L,
      scorgpo == 0 & scorgnw == 0 & scorgrl == 0 & scorgch == 0 &
      scorged == 0 & scorgsc == 0 & scorgsp == 0 & scorg95 == 0 ~ 0L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, year, birth_year, age_2018,
         Gender, Race, Education, Marital_status, Employment,
         Smoking, Alcohol, Physical_activity, Social_activity)


# 2. Sensory variables ----------------------------------------------------
sensory_var_2018 <- elsa_core_w9 %>%
  transmute(
    idauniq,

    # --- Hearing (hehear: 1=excellent … 5=poor) ---
    hearing_loss = case_when(
      hehear %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 0L,
      hehear %in% c(4, 5)    ~ 1L,
      TRUE                   ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # --- Vision (heeye: 1=excellent … 5=poor, 6=registered/legally blind) ---
    vision_overall = case_when(
      heeye %in% c(1, 2, 3)    ~ 0L,
      heeye %in% c(4, 5, 6)    ~ 1L,
      TRUE                     ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # --- Cataract diagnosis (NEWLY reported at W9 — see warning above) ---
    cataract_diagnosis = case_when(
      heoptca == 1 ~ 1L,
      heoptca == 0 ~ 0L,
      TRUE         ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # --- Glaucoma diagnosis (NEWLY reported at W9 — see warning above) ---
    glaucoma_diagnosis = case_when(
      heoptgl == 1 ~ 1L,
      heoptgl == 0 ~ 0L,
      TRUE         ~ NA_integer_
    ),

    # --- Cataract surgery (direct question hecat: 1=Yes, 2=No) ---
    cataract_surgery = case_when(
      hecat == 1 ~ 1L,
      hecat == 2 ~ 0L,
      TRUE       ~ NA_integer_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, hearing_loss, vision_overall,
                cataract_diagnosis, glaucoma_diagnosis,
                cataract_surgery)


# 3. Dementia classification ---------------------------------------------
# NOTE: hedibad / hedibde are "newly reported" per wave (W4+ convention).
elsa_cog_2018 <- elsa_core_w9 %>%
  transmute(
    idauniq,
    year = 2018L,
    diagnosed_dementia = case_when(
      hedibad == 1 | hedibde == 1 ~ 1L,
      hedibad == 0 | hedibde == 0 ~ 0L,
      TRUE                        ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    iqcode_b = if_else(heiqb %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqb), NA_real_),
    iqcode_c = if_else(heiqc %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqc), NA_real_),
    iqcode_d = if_else(heiqd %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqd), NA_real_),
    iqcode_e = if_else(heiqe %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqe), NA_real_),
    iqcode_f = if_else(heiqf %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqf), NA_real_),
    iqcode_g = if_else(heiqg %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqg), NA_real_),
    iqcode_h = if_else(heiqh %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqh), NA_real_),
    iqcode_i = if_else(heiqi %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqi), NA_real_),
    iqcode_j = if_else(heiqj %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqj), NA_real_),
    iqcode_k = if_else(heiqk %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqk), NA_real_),
    iqcode_l = if_else(heiql %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiql), NA_real_),
    iqcode_m = if_else(heiqm %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqm), NA_real_),
    iqcode_n = if_else(heiqn %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqn), NA_real_),
    iqcode_o = if_else(heiqo %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqo), NA_real_),
    iqcode_p = if_else(heiqp %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqp), NA_real_),
    iqcode_q = if_else(heiqq %in% 1:5, as.numeric(heiqq), NA_real_)
  )

iqcode_cols <- paste0("iqcode_", letters[2:17])
iqcode_mat  <- as.matrix(elsa_cog_2018[, iqcode_cols])

elsa_cog_2018 <- elsa_cog_2018 %>%
  mutate(
    iqcode_n_valid  = rowSums(!is.na(iqcode_mat)),
    iqcode_mean     = if_else(iqcode_n_valid >= 1L,
                              rowMeans(iqcode_mat, na.rm = TRUE),
                              NA_real_),
    iqcode_dementia = case_when(
      is.na(iqcode_mean) ~ NA_integer_,
      iqcode_mean >= 3.4 ~ 1L,
      iqcode_mean <  3.4 ~ 0L
    ),
    dementia = case_when(
      diagnosed_dementia == 1 | iqcode_dementia == 1 ~ 1L,
      diagnosed_dementia == 0 | iqcode_dementia == 0 ~ 0L,
      TRUE                                           ~ NA_integer_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, year, diagnosed_dementia, iqcode_mean, iqcode_n_valid,
         iqcode_dementia, dementia)

# Wave 9 (2018) Dementia Classification — observed counts
# -------------------------------------------------------
# Total participants in Wave 9: 8,736
# Total dementia cases:         170  (1.95% prevalence)
#   Physician diagnosis only : 92   (of which 86 had no IQCODE data)
#   IQCODE ≥ 3.4 only        : 17
#   Both sources             : 61
# Missing dementia status:     4    (hedibad & hedibde both Refusal/DK and
#                                    no IQCODE data either)
#
# NOTE: hedibad / hedibde are "newly reported" per wave (W4+ convention) —
# cumulative status is recovered downstream by pmax across waves.
#
# Physician diagnosis (hedibad + hedibde, codes 0/1):
#   Yes: 153   No: 8,579   Missing: 4 (none rescued by IQCODE)
# IQCODE (16-item heiqb–heiqq, lowercase):
#   205 respondents with ≥1 valid item
#   8,531 with no IQCODE data (no informant / proxy interview)
#   Mean 3.62  |  Median 3.13  |  IQR 3.00–4.44
#   ≥ 3.4 classification: Yes 78  No 127  NA 8,531
```

# Frailty Index 2018-2019
```{r}
# 4. Frailty Index (49 items) --------------------------------------------
recode_mob_adl_w9 <- function(x) {
  case_when(x == 1 ~ 1L, x == 0 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_)
}
recode_dx_w9 <- function(x) {
  case_when(x == 1 ~ 1L, x == 0 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_)
}

# Mobility (Items 1–10)
mobility_w9 <- elsa_core_w9 %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, hemobwa, hemobsi, hemobch, hemobcs, hemobcl,
         hemobst, hemobre, hemobpu, hemobli, hemobpi) %>%
  mutate(across(-idauniq, recode_mob_adl_w9))

# ADL/IADL (Items 11–23): headlph present; headlho → headlhg
adl_iadl_w9 <- elsa_core_w9 %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, headldr, headlwa, headlba, headlea, headlbe, headlwc,
         headlma, headlpr, headlsh, headlph, headlme, headlho, headlmo) %>%
  rename(headlhg = headlho) %>%
  mutate(across(-idauniq, recode_mob_adl_w9))

# Diagnosed conditions (Items 24–36)
diagnoses_w9 <- elsa_core_w9 %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, hedimbp, hediman, hedimmi, hedimhf, hedimar,
         hedimdi, hedimst, hediblu, hedibas, hedibar, hedibos,
         hedibca, hedibps) %>%
  mutate(across(-idauniq, recode_dx_w9))

# CES-D (Items 37–44) — lowercase in W9
cesd_w9 <- elsa_core_w9 %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, psceda, pscedb, pscedc, pscedd,
         pscede, pscedf, pscedg, pscedh) %>%
  mutate(
    psceda = case_when(psceda == 1 ~ 1L, psceda == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    pscedb = case_when(pscedb == 1 ~ 1L, pscedb == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    pscedc = case_when(pscedc == 1 ~ 1L, pscedc == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    pscede = case_when(pscede == 1 ~ 1L, pscede == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    pscedg = case_when(pscedg == 1 ~ 1L, pscedg == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    pscedh = case_when(pscedh == 1 ~ 1L, pscedh == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    pscedd = case_when(pscedd == 2 ~ 1L, pscedd == 1 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    pscedf = case_when(pscedf == 2 ~ 1L, pscedf == 1 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_)
  )

# Other health (Items 45, 48–51)
other_health_w9 <- elsa_core_w9 %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, hehelf, hefla, hefrac, heji, mmpain) %>%
  mutate(
    hehelf = case_when(hehelf %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 0L,
                       hehelf %in% c(4, 5)    ~ 1L,
                       TRUE                   ~ NA_integer_),
    hefla  = case_when(hefla  == 1 ~ 1L, hefla  == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    hefrac = case_when(hefrac == 1 ~ 1L, hefrac == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    heji   = case_when(heji   == 1 ~ 1L, heji   == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
    mmpain = case_when(mmpain == 1 ~ 1L, mmpain == 2 ~ 0L, TRUE ~ NA_integer_)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, hehelf, hefla, hefrac, heji, mmpain)

# Merge & compute FI — vectorised
fi_items <- c(
  "hemobwa", "hemobsi", "hemobch", "hemobcs", "hemobcl",
  "hemobst", "hemobre", "hemobpu", "hemobli", "hemobpi",
  "headldr", "headlwa", "headlba", "headlea", "headlbe", "headlwc",
  "headlma", "headlpr", "headlsh", "headlph", "headlme", "headlhg", "headlmo",
  "hedimbp", "hediman", "hedimmi", "hedimhf", "hedimar",
  "hedimdi", "hedimst", "hediblu", "hedibas", "hedibar", "hedibos", "hedibca", "hedibps",
  "psceda", "pscedb", "pscedc", "pscedd", "pscede", "pscedf", "pscedg", "pscedh",
  "hehelf", "hefla", "hefrac", "heji", "mmpain"
)
n_fi_items <- length(fi_items)
stopifnot(n_fi_items == 49)

# Strict (I)ADL items removed in the sensitivity FI
# (Re-declared so this chunk is self-contained; identical across waves.)
iadl_items <- c(
  # ADL (6)
  "headldr", "headlwa", "headlba", "headlea", "headlbe", "headlwc",
  # IADL (7) — phone, money, meals, shopping, meds, house/garden, map use
  "headlma", "headlpr", "headlsh", "headlph", "headlme", "headlhg", "headlmo"
)
fi_items_noIADL   <- setdiff(fi_items, iadl_items)
n_fi_items_noIADL <- length(fi_items_noIADL)
stopifnot(n_fi_items_noIADL == 36)

# Merge components (single source of recoded items feeds both FIs)
fi_merged_w9 <- mobility_w9 %>%
  left_join(adl_iadl_w9,     by = "idauniq") %>%
  left_join(diagnoses_w9,    by = "idauniq") %>%
  left_join(cesd_w9,         by = "idauniq") %>%
  left_join(other_health_w9, by = "idauniq")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# (a) ORIGINAL frailty index — 49 items
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
fi_mat_w9 <- as.matrix(fi_merged_w9[, fi_items])

elsa_fi_2018_orig <- fi_merged_w9 %>%
  mutate(
    year         = 2018L,
    fi_n_valid   = rowSums(!is.na(fi_mat_w9)),
    fi_n_deficit = rowSums(fi_mat_w9 == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    fi_score     = if_else(
      fi_n_valid >= ceiling(n_fi_items * 0.8),
      fi_n_deficit / fi_n_valid,
      NA_real_
    ),
    frailty = case_when(
      is.na(fi_score)  ~ NA_integer_,
      fi_score >= 0.25 ~ 1L,
      fi_score <  0.25 ~ 0L
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(fi_score)) %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, year, fi_n_valid, fi_n_deficit, fi_score, frailty)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# (b) MODIFIED frailty index — (I)ADL items removed (sensitivity)
#     Addresses possible mediation by (I)ADL deficits on the
#     sensory-impairment → dementia pathway. Same ≥0.25 threshold,
#     same ≥80% completeness rule applied to the reduced 36-item set
#     (>= 29 of 36).
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
fi_mat_w9_noIADL <- as.matrix(fi_merged_w9[, fi_items_noIADL])

elsa_fi_2018_noIADL <- fi_merged_w9 %>%
  mutate(
    fi_n_valid_noIADL   = rowSums(!is.na(fi_mat_w9_noIADL)),
    fi_n_deficit_noIADL = rowSums(fi_mat_w9_noIADL == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    fi_score_noIADL = if_else(
      fi_n_valid_noIADL >= ceiling(n_fi_items_noIADL * 0.8),
      fi_n_deficit_noIADL / fi_n_valid_noIADL,
      NA_real_
    ),
    frailty_noIADL = case_when(
      is.na(fi_score_noIADL)  ~ NA_integer_,
      fi_score_noIADL >= 0.25 ~ 1L,
      fi_score_noIADL <  0.25 ~ 0L
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(fi_score_noIADL)) %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, fi_n_valid_noIADL, fi_n_deficit_noIADL,
                fi_score_noIADL, frailty_noIADL)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Combine both FI versions into a single per-person table.
# Original `elsa_fi_2018` interface is preserved (idauniq, year,
# fi_n_valid, fi_n_deficit, fi_score, frailty); sensitivity columns
# (fi_score_noIADL, frailty_noIADL) are added alongside.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
elsa_fi_2018 <- elsa_fi_2018_orig %>%
  full_join(elsa_fi_2018_noIADL, by = "idauniq")

```




```{r}
# 5. Merge 2018 data -----------------------------------------------------
elsa_2018 <- elsa_cov_2018 %>%
  left_join(sensory_var_2018, by = "idauniq") %>%
  left_join(elsa_cog_2018,    by = c("idauniq", "year")) %>%
  left_join(elsa_fi_2018,     by = c("idauniq", "year"))


# ==========================================================================
# 6. Multiple imputation (MICE) — ELSA wave 9 (2018/19)
# ==========================================================================
# Identical specification to waves 1-8 — see the design notes in the 2002
# block. Education is an all-NA placeholder at W9 and is detected and
# excluded automatically below.

analysis_covars18 <- c("age_2018", "Education", "Marital_status", "Employment",
                       "Smoking", "Alcohol", "Physical_activity", "Social_activity")

# ---- 6a. Imputation frame ----------------------------------------------
# birth_year is not a predictor (near-collinear with age); age is resolved
# deterministically where a birth year exists and pmm handles the residual
# cases. Wave 9 fieldwork spanned 2018-2019, so that value can be ±1 year.
imp18_elsa <- elsa_2018 %>%
  transmute(
    idauniq    = as.character(idauniq),
    age_2018   = coalesce(as.numeric(age_2018), 2018 - as.numeric(birth_year)),
    Gender     = factor(Gender, levels = c(1, 2)),
    Race       = factor(Race,   levels = c(0, 1)),
    Education  = ordered(Education, levels = c(0, 1, 2)),
    across(c(Marital_status, Employment, Smoking, Alcohol,
             Physical_activity, Social_activity),
           ~ factor(.x, levels = c(0, 1)))
  )

# Variables with no observed values (Education from W6 onward) cannot be
# imputed; drop them here and leave them untouched in the analysis data.
all_missing18 <- names(imp18_elsa)[colSums(!is.na(imp18_elsa)) == 0]
if (length(all_missing18) > 0) {
  message("ELSA 2018 — no observed values, excluded from imputation: ",
          paste(all_missing18, collapse = ", "))
  imp18_elsa <- imp18_elsa %>% dplyr::select(-all_of(all_missing18))
}
imputed_vars18 <- setdiff(analysis_covars18, all_missing18)

# ---- 6b. Quantify missingness (for the Methods text) -------------------
miss_pct18 <- sapply(imp18_elsa, function(x) mean(is.na(x)) * 100)
cat("ELSA 2018 — percentage missing per variable:\n")
print(round(miss_pct18, 2))

miss_cov18 <- miss_pct18[intersect(imputed_vars18, names(miss_pct18))]
miss_cov18 <- miss_cov18[miss_cov18 > 0]
if (length(miss_cov18) > 0) {
  cat(sprintf("\nMean missing across analysis covariates: %.2f%%\n",
              mean(miss_cov18)))
  cat(sprintf("Maximum missing: %.2f%% (%s)\n",
              max(miss_cov18), names(which.max(miss_cov18))))
} else {
  cat("\nNo missing values among analysis covariates.\n")
}

# ---- 6c. Imputation method per variable --------------------------------
meth18 <- make.method(imp18_elsa)
meth18["idauniq"]  <- ""
meth18["age_2018"] <- "pmm"
meth18[intersect("Education", names(imp18_elsa))] <- "polr"
meth18[intersect(c("Gender", "Race", "Marital_status", "Employment", "Smoking",
                   "Alcohol", "Physical_activity", "Social_activity"),
                 names(imp18_elsa))] <- "logreg"
# Variables with no missing values are not imputed (mice requirement).
meth18[colSums(is.na(imp18_elsa)) == 0] <- ""

# ---- 6d. Predictor matrix ---------------------------------------------
pred18 <- make.predictorMatrix(imp18_elsa)
pred18[, "idauniq"] <- 0
pred18["idauniq", ] <- 0

# GUARD: no incomplete variable may be used as a predictor without itself
# being imputed, otherwise NAs leak into every imputation model.
incomplete18 <- names(imp18_elsa)[colSums(is.na(imp18_elsa)) > 0]
stopifnot(all(meth18[incomplete18] != ""))

# ---- 6e. Run MICE: 20 imputed datasets, 10 iterations ------------------
set.seed(3)
imp_mice18_elsa <- mice(
  imp18_elsa,
  m               = 20,
  maxit           = 10,
  method          = meth18,
  predictorMatrix = pred18,
  printFlag       = TRUE
)

if (!is.null(imp_mice18_elsa$loggedEvents)) {
  cat("\nMICE logged events (ELSA 2018):\n")
  print(imp_mice18_elsa$loggedEvents)
}

# ---- 6f. Merge the completed covariates back ---------------------------
# Single completion (imputation 1), as in HRS. Only the analysis covariates
# are replaced; Gender, Race and the primary study variables keep their
# ORIGINAL values, including NAs.
imp18_elsa_complete1 <- complete(imp_mice18_elsa, 1)

elsa18_clean <- elsa_2018 %>%
  mutate(idauniq = as.character(idauniq)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-all_of(imputed_vars18)) %>%
  left_join(
    imp18_elsa_complete1 %>%
      mutate(idauniq = as.character(idauniq)) %>%
      dplyr::select(idauniq, all_of(imputed_vars18)),
    by = "idauniq"
  )

ELSA_2018 <- elsa18_clean

stopifnot(nrow(ELSA_2018) == nrow(elsa_2018))

```




```{r}
# Merge all waves into longitudinal datasets
# Put wave datasets into a list
dat_list <- list(
  elsa02 = ELSA_2002 %>% mutate(Education = as.integer(as.character(Education))),
  elsa04 = ELSA_2004 %>% mutate(Education = as.integer(as.character(Education))),
  elsa06 = ELSA_2006 %>% mutate(Education = as.integer(as.character(Education))),
  elsa08 = ELSA_2008 %>% mutate(Education = as.integer(as.character(Education))),
  elsa10 = ELSA_2010 %>% mutate(Education = as.integer(as.character(Education))),
  elsa12 = ELSA_2012 %>% mutate(Education = as.integer(as.character(Education))),
  elsa14 = ELSA_2014 %>% mutate(Education = as.integer(as.character(Education))),
  elsa16 = ELSA_2016 %>% mutate(Education = as.integer(as.character(Education))),
  elsa18 = ELSA_2018 %>% mutate(Education = as.integer(as.character(Education)))
)

elsa_long <- bind_rows(dat_list, .id = "source") %>%
  mutate(
    idauniq = as.character(idauniq),
    year    = as.integer(year)
  )

elsa_long <- elsa_long %>%
  mutate(
    age = coalesce(age_2002, age_2004, age_2006, age_2008, age_2010,
                   age_2012, age_2014, age_2016, age_2018)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-matches("^age_\\d{4}$"))

write.csv(elsa_long,
          file = "elsa_long.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)
```
